“We’ve been trying to see if we can reinforce the team. But some players were with a mindset of ‘holidays already’, some players were sometimes just asking for too much money, and we’re aware that our team is extremely competitive.

“We’ll go into the traditional transfer window after the tournament still with the biggest ambitions to see if we can reinforce the team even more.”

title: Anthony Joshua Arrived In Ghana For A visits To Ghanaian President, John Mahama
content:
Former world heavyweight champion Anthony Joshua, arrived in Ghana on Monday, 13th June 2025, which was was greeted with enthusiasm, expressing admiration for the country’s culture, hospitality, and organization for a visit to Ghanaian President, John Dramani Mahama at the Jubilee House.

President Mahama, during the meeting offer to Joshua a Ghanaian citizenship, as he said; “If you want us to give you a Ghanaian passport, we will give you,” highlighting Joshua’s iconic status.

Joshua, who has record of 28 wins and 4 losses with Olympic gold medal in 2012, he's preparing for his next match with potential opponents including Moses Itauma, Jared Anderson, or Deontay Wilder.

title: Remains Of Late Nigerian Boxer Arrive Lagos As NFSC Boss, Ikpea Call For Athletes Welfare Prioritize
content:
The remains of the 28-year-old Nigerian boxer Segun Olanrewaju, popularly known as “Success,” who tragically died during a bout in Ghana, has finally arrived at the Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Lagos on Tuesday amid tears, as crowd of mourners gathered to pay their final respects.

Among those present to receive the body were members of the Ghana National Supporters Union, the Nigeria Supporters Club, Olanrewaju’s family members, friends, fellow boxers, and a host of journalists who have followed the tragic case from the beginning.

Supporters from both Ghana and Nigeria stood in solidarity, waving flags and mourning together in honour of the fallen fighter.

Speaking with journalists at the venue, National Chairman of Nigeria Football Supporters Club, Rev. (Amb) Samuel Ikpea, in an emotion laden tone, described the death of the late boxer as a painful and unfortunate incident that could have been prevented. 

"There has been several reasons given by the people on what could have caused the death of Segun Olanrewaju. No matter the excuses or reasons, I believe the incident was avoidable, if necessary precautions had been taken.

"However, this is not the moment to share blames. What we all should do is to put on our usual garb of human kindness, love and support for the family of the late boxer, particularly, his wife and children.

"The late boxer was out to eke a living for his family before he met his untimely death. Therefore, as good people, we shouldn't let his family suffer," Ikpea advised. 

Olanrewaju died on 29 March after collapsing during a lightweight boxing match against Ghanaian opponent Jon Mbanugu at the Trust Sports Emporium in Accra.

title: National Sports commission congratulates New Record Breaker for longest Marathon
content:
The National Sports commission has congratulated Joshua Aiyenuro Babatunde, popularly called Tjosh for setting a new record for the longest professional hairdressing marathon held at the velodrome of the Abuja National stadium from 10th of June 2025 to 17th June 2025.

Chairman of the NSC, Mallam Shehu Dikko alongside the Director General of the sports commission , Hon Bukola Olopade, who were amongst the top dignitaries that visited him during the exercise to cheer and motivate him, congratulate him for showcasing another true spirit of the Nigerian youths which President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR, has continually prioritised.

"I am not surprised with this latest feat coming from another Nigerian youth because our youthful population are the most resilient, dogged and hardworking in the world.

"I want to specially congratulate him for putting Nigeria on the world map once again as a pacesetter and history makers in creative industry.

"I am thrilled that Tjosh achieved this because when he visited my office to inform me about it I saw a young man who is focused and determined to create his own path of Greatness.That was why we approved for him to use the velodrome and today we are happy he was able to achieve what he set out to achieve," Olopade stated.

title: WAFCON 2024: Super Falcons To Arrive In Portugal On Sunday, Face Ghana, Portugal For Pre-WAFCON Test
content:
Nigeria’s senior women’s national team, the Super Falcons, will arrive in Portugal on Sunday as part of their final preparations for the 2024 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON) in Morocco.

The team will face rivals Black Princesses of Ghana, and Portugal in a friendly ahead of the 2024 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations. The game against Portugal will be on Monday, 23 June, while encounter against Ghana will hold in Morocco.

The Black Princesses have set up camp in Benslimane, Morocco for their final preparations ahead of the WAFCON 2024 finals.

The friendly against the Portuguese women’s national team—who are also preparing for the UEFA Women’s Euro 2025—will serve as a crucial test for the nine-time African champions ahead of the continental showpiece.

Sources within the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) confirmed the travel plans on Wednesday, noting that the encounter will give head coach Justine Madugu an opportunity to assess his squad against top-tier European opposition.

Nigeria will face Tunisia, Botswana and Algeria in Group B, while Ghana have been drawn in Group C with holders Banyana Banyana of South Africa, Mali and Tanzania.

The Super Falcons will open their campaign against Tunisia at the Larbi Zaouli Stadium in Casablanca on Sunday, 5 July.

Morocco will host the biennial competition from Saturday, 5 July to Saturday, 26 July, 2025.

title: Osimhen’s Bicycle Kick Won Süper Lig Goal Of The Season
content:
The Nigerian and Galatasaray forward, Victor Osimhen’s overhead kick in Galatasaray’s 3-0 victory over Antalyaspor has been voted the 2024/25 Turkish Süper Lig Goal of the Season.

The goal which he scored on October 19, 2024, fixture in 13 minutes after he was introduced as a late substitute to replace Yunus Akgün in the 78th minute garnered 65.8% of the fan votes in an online poll conducted by the Turkish Süper Lig via its official X account to edged out teammate Kaan Ayhan free-kick that collect 34.2% votes in the final voting round.

“The most beautiful goal of the 2024–2025 Season in the Trendyol Super League was determined by your votes. Victor Osimhen!” the league announced on Tuesday. The goal was his third of the season following a late loan switch from Napoli, after being sidelined by the Italian club.

Despite arriving midway through the campaign, the 26-year-old forward produced an outstanding season, finishing with 37 goals across all competitions, including 26 in the Süper Lig.

title: World Cup Qualification: NSC Boss, Dikko, Optimistic About Super Eagles’ Qualification If South Afri
content:
In an interview with the UK-based Nigerian journalist, Austin Okon-Akpan, the Chairman of National Sports Commission, Shehu Dikko, believe that the Super Eagles can secure their spot at the 2026 FIFA World Cup to be hosted in the USA, Canada, and Mexico if FIFA docks South Africa points for fielding an ineligible player in their 2-0 win over Lesotho during qualifier match in March.

Bafana’s Teboho Mokoena had accumulated two yellow cards in the series and should have been suspended for the Lesotho match.

“With the way things are, it’s still in our hands, depending on the outcome of the disciplinary decision that’s expected soon.

“If the decision goes as everyone expects and we ourselves have faced a similar fate before it means we can still control our own future. If we win our remaining four games, we can make it.

“The rules are the rules; it’s not about Africa, it’s FIFA. There are no two ways about it. Otherwise, anyone could field a player and then say it was a simple error,” Dikko said.

title: 2027: APC Vice Chair, Salihu, States Reason For Endorsing Only Tinubu’s Without Mentioning Shettima
content:
In an interview on Channels Television’s Program ‘Politics Today’, the National Vice Chairman (North-East) of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Mustapha Salihu, has clear the air following a wave of backlash over his endorsement to only President Bola Tinubu for second term in office comes 2027 without mentioning Vice President Kashim Shettima during the recent APC Northeast Stakeholders’ Summit in Gombe State.

The National Vice Chairman who narrowly escaped attack from violent mob for his statement during the summit, stressed that the APC’s internal nomination process allows only one presidential candidate to emerge during the primaries and the candidate would later solely has the constitutional right to select a running mate even though he consulted the party leaders and stakeholders.

He also stress that the misinterpretation and ill-reporting by the media cause the people outburst as the last paragraph before the endorsement was omitted.

“I think this trouble is largely caused by the constant misinterpretation and ill-reporting by the media. 

"You should have played my speech fully or even read the last paragraph before the endorsement.

“The last paragraph of my speech before the endorsement was eulogising the Vice President, even recognising him as our son, whom we are very proud of. We stand by him. I even mentioned all the ministers and other juicy appointments given to North-East indigenes, and thanked Asiwaju for that before calling for his endorsement as the sole candidate of the APC.

“There is no joint ticket during party primaries, only the presidential candidate emerges, and it is entirely his prerogative to choose a running mate after becomes the party flag-bearer even though the party and stakeholders may be consulted, but constitutionally, it is solely the candidate’s right.

“Some people thrive on creating tension. We call them ‘crisis entrepreneurs,’ they manipulate situations like this to create confusion and benefit from it.

“Party business isn’t conducted on the platforms of social media or pages of newspapers. We operate through the party office. These rumours are simply not reflective of the reality within the party,” he stated.

title: Tinubu Commits To Autonomy Amid INEC Rejection Of PDP NEC Meeting Notice
content:
President Bola Tinubu during the groundbreaking ceremony for the new Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) headquarters in Abuja, has said that the new edifice symbolises more than just infrastructure but represents the nation’s dedication to credible elections and institutional independence. Describing the project as a testament for Nigeria’s commitment to democracy and institution autonomy.

“Today’s ceremony is not merely about bricks and mortar. It is about the strength of our democracy, our institutions’ independence, and the future of our electoral integrity.

“INEC remains the backbone of Nigeria’s democratic journey, and this structure will reflect its dignity, responsibility, and national significance.

“The FCT Minister has taken another bold step in ensuring the protection of our democracy by initiating this laudable project. I salute his courage as I am proud of him. Democracy is not a destination but a journey. Let us strengthen our institutions, safeguard our freedoms, and protect the future together,” the president said.

The project, expected to be completed within 24 months, will feature modern facilities to support electoral processes, training, and technological advancements.

Meanwhile, the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) rejected the notice sent to it by the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) for its National Executive Committee (NEC) meeting for vioating the requirement of Part 2(12) 3 of the Regulations and Guidelines for Political Parties, 2022.

In response to the PDP request, INEC in a letter addressed to the PDP acting National Chairman and signed by INEC acting secretary Haliru Aminu, said the party’s national chairman and secretary are required to jointly sign the notice for the NEC meeting as stated in the Regulations and Guidelines for Political Parties, 2022.

”The commission draws your attention that the notice is not in compliance with the requirement of part 2(12)3 of the Regulations and Guidelines for Political Parties, 2022, that provides ‘the National Chairman and National Secretary of the Party shall jointly sign the notice of convention, congress, conference or meeting end submit same to the Commission.’ Be guided," INEC stated.

title: National Sports Festival Gains Momentum, As Corporate Giants Pledge Sponsorship For The 23rd Edition
content:
In line with the vision of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s Renewed Hope agenda, the National Sports Festival has entered a new phase of growth, as corporate giants continue to pledge their support for the 23rd edition of the Games, set to be hosted by Enugu State in 2026.

In a landmark agreement, PremiumTrust Bank and BetKing have committed as sponsors for the 23rd edition of the Games, setting the stage for what is projected to be the most successful and impactful festival in the history of the Games.

The announcement followed a high-level meeting in Enugu between the Director General of the National Sports Commission (NSC), Hon. Bukola Olopade, Enugu State Governor Peter Mbah, and PremiumTrust Bank Managing Director Emmanuel Efe Emefienim, CON and the MD of BetKing, Gossy Ukanwoke.

The discussion focused on key elements of the upcoming festival—from infrastructure, logistics, sponsorship, youth development and legacy programming.

The decision by key sponsors to invest in Enugu 2026 was also largely influenced by the visionary leadership of Governor Peter Mbah, whose commitment to infrastructure renewal, youth empowerment, and innovation in governance has inspired confidence in the state’s readiness to host a world-class Games. Stakeholders at the meeting commended his bold agenda for transforming Enugu into a hub for investment and development.

PremiumTrust Bank, under the leadership of Managing Director Emmanuel Efe Emefienim, CON, has emerged as the headline sponsor of the 2026 Games.

Also, BetKing, led by Gossy Ukanwoke, was confirmed as a major sponsor, further underscoring the private sector’s growing confidence in the nation’s sports ecosystem.

Director General of the National Sports Commission, Hon. Bukola Olopade stated that the agreements serve as a direct reflection of the President Tinubu administration’s drive to reposition sports as a vital part of national development with a buoyant sports economy that would lead to increased job creation, youth engagement, and infrastructure investment.

“This is a turning point for Nigerian sports,” said NSC DG Hon. Bukola Olopade. “We are witnessing the real impact of the Renewed Hope agenda. Sport is no longer being seen as a recreational afterthought—it’s now viewed as a national asset.”

PremiumTrust Bank which played a leading role in the successful hosting of Gateway Games Ogun 2024, returns as the headline sponsor, further solidifying its role in the growth of grassroots and elite sports in Nigeria.

“We are not only unlocking opportunities for our athletes but also establishing a credible path for sports to contribute to national GDP, employment, and related valuechain,” Hon. Olopade added.

Since assuming office, the new leadership of the NSC under Mallam Shehu Dikko as chairman and Hon. Bukola Olopade as Director General, has aggressively pursued the vision of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, who declared sports a core pillar in Nigeria’s economic renewal strategy.

title: CREDICORP: NIM To Serve As Credit Profile Anchor; Passport, Driver’s License, House Rent Affected
content:
During a Press confrence organized by the Presidential Media Team at the State House in Abuja on Tuesday, the Managing Director of the Nigerian Consumer Credit Corporation (CREDICORP), Uzoma Nwagba, has announcement that theThe federal government plans to introduce a comprehensive reform that will connect Nigerians' credit scores with their National Identification Numbers (NIN) in order to create a cohesive, transparent, and accountable credit system that ensures every citizen is included in financial oversight.

The system will also boost lender confidence, as it will improve repayment because borrower failure to repay the loan will affect their passport, driver’s license, or even rent a house. 

“This is a fundamental shift in how credit works in Nigeria. Your NIN will now serve as the anchor for your credit profile. Whether you borrowed from a commercial bank, a microfinance institution, or a digital lender, that data will now be traceable and carry real consequences.

“If you default on your loan, it could affect your ability to renew your passport, your driver’s license, or even rent a house. There will be no hiding place,” he stated

title: FG Has Unveils Registration Portal For 2025 National Youth Confab For Interested Individuals
content:
The minister of Youth Development, Ayodele Olawande, in Abuja on Monday announced that the federal government has formally launched the 2025 National Youth Conference registration portal, also known as Youth Confab 2025 for interested Youhs.

According to him, the conference will be youth-led, inclusive, and non-partisan, aiming to bring together young Nigerians from every ward, community, state, and diaspora to unite and co-create the future of the nation.

Nigeria’s has a population of above 70% under the age of 35 which is an asset for the country if properly managed.

The minister outlined a multi-level participatory structure for the Confab, including diaspora virtual engagements, consultations in all 360 federal constituencies, zonal consolidation meetings across the six geopolitical zones, and a national conference in Abuja. He urged young people to move from protest to policy, from problems to solutions, and from challenges to progress.

The six thematic pillars to guide deliberations are; Governance and Political Participation; Economic Transformation and Job Creation; Education and Skills; Technology and Innovation; Climate Change and Energy Transition; and Social Inclusion and Security.

He reiterated that the launch of the portal marks the beginning of a series of critical activities, including virtual consultations, submission of policy papers, constituency-level dialogues, and zonal consolidations, all culminating in a National Conference in Abuja. While maintaining that the Confab format was carefully designed to accommodate Nigeria’s diverse youth population, with an emphasis on inclusion, respect, and equity.

He said 36,000 youths are expected to participate at the federal constituency level alone, while 370 delegates will attend the zonal meetings. Nigerian youth in the diaspora will also contribute their perspectives through online platforms, making it a truly global initiative.

The delegate selection process will be merit-based and transparent to ensure broad representation and legitimacy. To promote inter-generational dialogue, 90% of the participants will be youths aged 18 to 35, with the remaining 10% comprising older Nigerians. A 50:50 gender balance will be enforced, and special attention will be given to persons with disabilities and other marginalized groups.

“At the launch ceremony, I noted that the National Youth Conference will be executed through a multi-level participatory process which includes virtual engagements with the diaspora, constituency-level consultations, zonal consolidation meetings, and a culminating national conference in Abuja.

“I also emphasized that the implementation of the conference will be anchored on the principles of transparency, respect, inclusivity, and innovation, urging every young Nigerian to seize this opportunity to transition.

“I want to use this medium to appreciate President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for his commitment and dedication to youth development in the country.

“The implementation of this process will be anchored on transparency, inclusive, and innovation. Young Nigerians, students, entrepreneurs, creatives, artisans, professionals, and the diaspora are encourage to visit the newly launched portal to register and engage meaningfully," Olawande said.

title: Transfer Update: Super Eagles Players Next Destinations
content:
According to the latest update from Scotland, Nigerian forward Cyriel Dessers has agreed personal terms with Greek Super League side AEK Athens in a deal worth of approximately €1.8 million per year as he moves closer toward a summer transfer away from Rangers.

He joined Rangers from Italian side Cremonese in 2023 for £4.5 million, and expected to hold out for a transfer fee in the region of £5 million.

Dessers found the net 28 times in all competitions during his spell with the Gers last season.

Another Super Eagles and FC Nantes winger, Moses Simon is on the cusp of securing a transfer to another French Ligue 1 side before the end of the week according to a reports from France.

Simon, who joined Nantes from UD Levante, was a key player for the team, delivering consistent and impressive performances.

He's set to complete a move to newly promoted Paris FC before the week runs out. Paris FC secured promotion to the French top flight at the conclusion of last season after spending several years in the lower division.

title: Nigerian Striker Made History In MLS
content:
Former Flying Eagles forward Ibrahim Aliyu made history with his latest strike for MLS side Columbus Crew as he scored his second goal of the season in the Crew’s 2-1 win over Vancouver Whitecaps, finding the net after just 68 seconds of play — the second-fastest goal in the franchise’s regular-season history.

The 23-year-old forward joined Columbus Crew in April from fellow MLS team Houston Dynamo and has made eight league appearances for the Black and Gold.

title: 2025 African Zonal Championship: Nigeria To Face Egypt, Others For 2026 World Championship In China
content:
Nigeria Sitting Volleyball Federation has confirmed it’s participation for the Men's 2025 African Sitting Volleyball Zonal Championship against host Kenya with five other African countries as they prepared for the 2026 World Championship in China.

The participating countries in the Zonal Championship which scheduled to hold in Nairobi, Kenya from the 1st to the 10th of July, 2025 are Egypt, Libya, Kenya, Algeria, Nigeria, Rwanda and Zimbabwe.

Meanwhile, four countries have confirmed their participation in the women’s event. They’re: Kenya – Host, Congo, Rwanda and Zimbabwe.

Both the men’s and women’s teams will enter a 15-day residential training camp starting today (Monday), aimed at building team cohesion and sharpening skills ahead of the tournament.

The top two teams in both the men’s and women’s categories will qualify automatically for the 2026 Sitting Volleyball World Championships, scheduled for July 10-17 in Hangzhou, China.

title: AFCON 2025: Guinea Football Federation Drags CAF To Court of Arbitration for Sport For Their Failure
content:
On Monday, the Guinean Football Federation (FGF) has formally lodged an appeal against the Confederation of African Football (CAF) before the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS), having failed to secure a spot at the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations schedule to take place in Morocco later this year, 

The controversy centers on the match’s validity, alleging that Tanzania fielded a player wearing a jersey number different from the one listed on the official team sheet during a 1-0 loss to Tanzania on November 19, 2024 which condemned the Guinea National team to third place in their group, forcing them to watch the tournament from home .

Tanzanian defender Muhamed Ibrahim Ame wore number 26 instead of number 24 during the match, which the Guinea argued that the administrative error should be called into questioning the match’s fairness and hoped to be handed a walkover and eventual qualification.

The CAF Disciplinary Board initially ruled the complaint admissible in form but unfounded in substance, stating that a jersey number inconsistent with the team sheet did not constitute a major violation. Subsequently, the CAF Appeals Board upheld that decision, a conclusion the FGF made public on Monday.

The Guinean federation accuse the decision, stating that there are serious breaches of most procedural right such as been denied access to the case file, prohibited from submitting key evidence, excluded from crucial deliberations among others, which they its against fair ruling.

Determined to pursue justice, the FGF turned to the CAS in Lausanne, trusting it o guarantee a fully fair procedure in compliance with international standards of sports justice and to provide a remedy for the unfair process it fell victim to.

title: Oyo State Govt Honour 27 Years Old Promise Made To 3SC’s 1998 Title-Winning Squad
content:
Engr. Seyi Makinde, the Governor of Oyo State, has restored honour made to members of the victorious 1998 Shooting Stars Sports Club (3SC) team by the then-military administration of the state, Compol Amen Oyakhire, 27 years ago.

The gesture recognizes the exceptional achievements of the 3SC squad, who, in 1998, won both the Nigerian Premier League and the West African Football Union (WAFU) Cup—the latter being Nigeria’s only continental club title to date. Their double triumph remains one of the most celebrated feats in Nigerian club football history.

Following their success, the then Military Administrator of Oyo State, Compol Amen Oyakhire announced a reward of ₦1 million and a plot of land for each player and official. While the cash rewards were reportedly disbursed, the land allocations were never fulfilled—until now by the current Oyo State administration.

of the victorious 1998 Shooting Stars Sports Club (3SC) team—honouring a promise made 26 years ago by the then-military administration of the state, BSNSports.com.ng reports.

Governor Makinde known for his commitment to justice and equity took it upon himself to revisit the matter, after investigating the cause of the prolonged delay, he officially approved the allocation of plots of land to all members of the team and officials, living or late.

The plots will be allocated by the Ministry of Lands and Urban Development, which will also issue Certificates of Occupancy (C of O) to the beneficiaries.

“This is a government that redresses historical injustices, it is only fitting to honour those who brought pride to Oyo State and Nigeria with dedication and excellence,” a statement from the Oyo State Government read.

Among the beneficiaries were Sunday Adu (Captain), Andrew Aihkomogbe, Shanka Ugwah, Eric Ejiofor, Late Dimeji Adenekan, Niyi Elegbede, Samuel Yamta, John Benson, Leye Akinde, Late Mojeed Azees, Late Pius Daniel, Rafiu Salaudeen, Bauldwin Bazuaye, Golden Ajeboh, Sunday Ilevbare, Allain Njoh Njoh, Peter Obanor, Ochuko Otos, Shobayo Adesina, Kazeem Tijani, Kola Ademola, Friday Christopher, Late Coach Jossy Ladipo, Late Chairman Bode Oyewole, Barr. Owolabi Salami.

title: Nigerian Referee Makes The List Of 18 Officials Selected To Officiate At 2025 WAFCON
content:
The Confederation of African Football (CAF) has named Nigerian referee Yemisi Eunice Akintoye among the 18 officials selected to officiate at the 2024 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON) in Morocco schedule to take place from Saturday, July 5 to Saturday, July 26, 2025.

Akintoye, from the Lagos State Referees Council, was among the women referees from Africa picked some weeks ago for the preparatory courses.

The course featured “extensive technical assessments, physical fitness tests, and decision-making evaluations under match-like conditions”, ensuring only the best officials made the final cut.

After a successful outing at the preparatory courses, the 2021 FIFA badged referee was selected for the WAFCON in Morocco.

Akintoye is not a stranger to high-profile tournaments, having officiated at the CAF Women’s Champions League, WAFU B U-20 Championship, and WAFU B Women’s Champions League.

title: 2026 World Cup: Australia Make It 11th Nation To Qualify
content:
In the race for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, schedule to hold in USA, 11 countries have now officially qualified for the event.

Australia after a comeback victory over Saudi Arabia has now make them the 11th nations to have qualified.

Saudi Arabia took an early lead in the 19th minute through Abdulrahman Al-Aboud, but Australia responded with goals from Connor Metcalfe and Mitch Duke to secure the comeback win.

The Australia qualification make it their sixth consecutive appearance at the global tournament.

Australia, Jordan and Uzbekistan is now among the latest teams to joined South Korea, Japan, New Zealand, Iran, and Argentina, who had already punched their tickets to the tournament.

Co-hosts USA, Canada, and Mexico are also confirmed participants, having qualified automatically as hosts.

title: Nationwide Protest: Protesters Mobilise As Tinubu Addresses NASS On Democracy Day
content:
Following President Bola Tinubu cancellation of the previously scheduled nationwide broadcast in commemoration of Nigeria’s 26th Democracy Day anniversary, and instead choose to deliver his address at a joint session of the Senate and House of Representatives today, has gave ‘Take It Back Movement’ an opportunity to stage protest at the National Assembly as against earlier location.

On Wednesday, Director of Information and Public Relations, Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, Segun Imohiosen, said; “Due to President Bola Tinubu’s scheduled attendance at the National Assembly Joint Session, the Presidential National Broadcast on June 12 has been cancelled. President Tinubu will deliver his address from the National Assembly.”

On the update, the rally organisers said they resolved to carry out a demonstration at the National Assembly, Abuja and 19 other locations across the country during the June 12 celebrations to make the politicians know the hardship citizens are going through under the two year of the current administration.

Speaking with The PUNCH on Wednesday, National Coordinator, Take It Back Movement, Juwon Sanyaolu, said the shift in protest location did not alter the objective of the demonstration.

“That we earlier said the protest would hold at the Eagle Square doesn’t foreclose the fact that Nigerians cannot organise themselves at the National Assembly to protest the two years of misrule under Tinubu.

“The unprecedented hardship and insecurity we have experienced under his government are alarming. So, Nigerians will be turning out nationwide to protest against this, and the National Assembly is one of those spaces where Nigerians can exercise their constitutional rights. We are encouraging Nigerians to move there in their numbers tomorrow (today).

“All Nigerians from different walks of life have been mobilised, Nigerians are coming to the streets tomorrow (today) to demand an end to bad governance.

“Nigerians have nothing to lose. Nigerians have been beaten and battered. We are like people who are on the ground; we should have no fear of falling. It is also their constitutional right to protest.

“They have no reason to fear. The worst has happened, and the only way to stop the escalating level of our sorrow, tears and blood they are witnessing is to actually do something by protesting tomorrow. We have nothing to fear and we have nothing to lose but our chains.”

“Presently, there has been a nationwide attack on organisers, but we are not deterred. The Bauchi state executives of TIB are being hounded by the police.

“In Gombe, Cross-River, Edo and Lagos, our coordinators are being hounded. We are convinced the only way to end the era of worse governance is defiance; that is what we are going to be doing fearlessly.

“Preparations are in order. Many Nigerian youths, who have expressed frustration over the spate of killings in the country, mass unemployment, and underfunded education, have shown commitment to participate in the protest.

“Other civil society organisations have also committed to mobilising their members. Expect thousands on the streets of Abuja.

“Again and again, men of our security agencies have shown themselves to be uncivilised by attacking protesters unprovoked. Our call to them is to at least pretend they are civilised.

“There is no reason to bring lethal weapons to the protest grounds. Take them to Sambisa or Plateau State to combat the real insecurity, not against protesters who are civilly demanding their rights,” he stated.

title: Presidency Blasts Ndume, Issued Him Warning Over Reckless Statement On TV
content:
The Presidency has issued Senator Mohammed Ali Ndume a stern warning over an unguarded utterances and allegation made against the ruling party.

The lawmaker representing Borno South Senatorial District during a television program said that a cabal has hijacked Tinubu’s government, and that the administration is now dominated by kleptocrats and kakistocrats, the statement Presidency described as reckless.

The Special Adviser to President Bola Tinubu on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga, while reacting to the allegations accused Ndume of making a sweeping statement without providing any scintilla of proof, this should not command respect of any right thinking person.

“Ndume is entitled to his opinion, as a lone-wolf opposition within the APC, though he most often gets his facts wrong or builds his thesis on a specious, faulty foundation.

“Like he lied about General Buratai being ambushed by terrorists. A ranking Senator making reckless statement on TV cannot command the respect of any right thinking person.

“His allegation that kleptocrats and kakistocrats dominate the government is just too sweeping. And he made it without providing any scintilla of proof.

“Kakistocrats? Does he know the word’s meaning, or does he just like bandying terms?

“This President has many competent aides, many of whom were accomplished professionals before coming to work for the government.

“And they are doing a damn good job, reengineering the country’s economy to ensure it is put on a solid foundation for sustainable growth,” Onanuga said.

title: 2027: Lagos Group Pushes For Tinubu, Ambode Ticket
content:
Lagos-based socio-political organisation, known as South West Political Renaissance Group (SWPRG) has said it would support the re-election of President Bola Tinubu and the return of former governor of the state, Mr. Akinwumi Ambode, for a second term comes 2027 general elections.

In a statement by its publicity secretary, Dr. Sylvester Oguntuase, the group said President Tinubu had demonstrated his preparedness to lead Nigeria to massive wealth creation, economic growth and national unity, and therefore stood behind him for second term while also calling for the return of Ambode, who is the first governor of Lagos to rule only one term since the return of democracy in 1999.

“President Tinubu in all honesty had demonstrated his preparedness to lead Nigeria to massive wealth creation, economic growth and national unity. We are unequivocally saying that both President Tinubu and His Excellency former governor Ambode are unapologetically our choices for 2027.

“Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu had consolidated on the achievements of Ambode who handed over to him in 2019, it is time for Ambode to have his fair share in the Lagos Government House again in the spirit of fairness.

“Ambode, a fine gentleman, a patriot and a true party man who has remained loyal to his party despite injustices should be recognised and rewarded. It can only begin with offering him the right to first refusal of APC governorship ticket in Lagos 2027. We are committed to mobilising our members and entire Lagosians to back these two candidates who have indeed made us proud,” the group said.

title: Super Eagles Defender Praises Okoye’s Performance Against Russia
content:
Russia-based Super Eagles defender, Brian Idowu, speaking to Match TV, has praised goalkeeper Maduka Okoye for his outstanding performance in Nigeria’s international friendly match against Russia.

Idowu acknowledged that Russia were the better side on the day but credited Okoye’s brilliance for keeping Nigeria in contention.

"I think Russia played better and probably deserved the win more. They had more scoring chances but their finishing let them down. Maduka Okoye made some excellent saves and really bailed us out,” he said.

title: We Faced A Strong Opponent – Chelle Reflects On Russia Draw, State What The New Call up Must Do
content:
Super Eagles head coach Eric Chelle acknowledged the quality of their opponents following Nigeria's 1-1 draw against Russia in Friday’s international friendly game, while also shared his thoughts on what newly invited striker Olusegun Olakunle needs to focus on to elevate his game.

“It was a tough match because we faced a very strong team. Russia has a solid squad with technical quality and they put us under a lot of pressure.

“They capitalized on their first-half chances. We also had opportunities, but their goalkeeper made crucial saves,” he said.

Following the match, Coach Chelle offered both praise and constructive feedback on Olakunle who plays his club football in Russia and debuted for the Super Eagles during an international friendly against Russia on Friday.

“He has many qualities, he’s swift, keeps possession well, and has a strong character. But like every player, he must keep working hard and continue developing,” he stated.

The coach’s comments come as encouragement for the young forward, who was part of Nigeria’s squad at the 2019 FIFA U17 World Cup in Brazil.

With the friendly behind them, the Super Eagles now turn their focus to the 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers in September.

Nigeria will host Rwanda in Uyo before heading to South Africa for their next fixture.

title: 2026 World Cup: The Ten Countries That Has Officially Secure Their Spot
content:
In the race for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, schedule to hold in USA, at least 10 countries have now officially qualified for the upcoming event.

On Thursday, Jordan and Uzbekistan made history by securing their first-ever World Cup appearances, while South Korea booked their 11th consecutive spot at the global tournament.

Despite being held to a 0-0 draw by the United Arab Emirates in Abu Dhabi, Uzbekistan claimed the second automatic qualification spot in Group A, finishing behind Iran with one game still to play.

Following this development, South Korea, Jordan and Uzbekistan joined Japan, New Zealand, Iran, and Argentina, who had already punched their tickets to the tournament.

Co-hosts USA, Canada, and Mexico are also confirmed participants, having qualified automatically as hosts.

In Asia, six teams have secured direct qualification. Meanwhile, UAE and Qatar who finished third and fourth respectively in their group will advance to the next stage of qualifiers where six teams will battle it out for the final two spots.

title: Nigeria Is Lucky For The Draw; Russia Coach New Rate Of Super Eagles Among The Continent
content:
The Russia national team head coach, Valery Karpin, while speaking after the match against Super Eagles has claimed that Nigeria national team was fortunate to come away with a 1-1 draw in their international friendly played on Friday.

Following their 1-1 draw with Nigeria, Karpin expressed his dissatisfaction with the result, insisting that his team dominated the game while the Super Eagles posed little threat. He then rated Super Eagles as a stronger side than Zambia which they thrashed 5-0 earlier in the week in another friendly game.

"Absolutely everything — from pressing to ball control — was in our favour I can’t recall a single dangerous moment from Nigeria, except maybe a mistake during our build-up. Do you remember one? Maybe I’ve just forgotten.

“We had chances — Melekhin after a free kick, Barinov following a run from the back. Nigeria didn’t create any real threats.

“Even the goal we conceded wasn’t something they built; there was no real pressure leading up to it,” he said.

Despite his stand after the match, he rated Nigeria team above Zambia and Kenya.

"They are all very athletic, powerful, strong teams. But Cameroon and Nigeria are clearly a level above Zambia and Kenya — even the FIFA rankings confirm this. You can't compare them. Nigeria and Cameroon are much more interesting teams," he added.

title: Wilfred Ndidi Appreciate Former Coach Ugbade With A Brand New Car
content:
Super Eagles midfielder, Wilfred Ndidi in a heartwarming display of gratitude, has surprised his former grassroots coach, Nduka Ugbade, with a brand-new car.

The emotional gesture which has captured the attention of football fans across Nigeria and beyond, highlights the deep bond between the 28-year-old, who recently suffered relegation to the English Championship with former Premier League winners Leicester City at the end of the 2024/2025 and coach Ugbade who played a pivotal role in shaping his early career.

The moment Ndidi presented the car to Ugbade was nothing short of emotional. Videos circulating on platforms like X show Ugbade, a former Nigeria U-17 national team coach and ex-international, visibly moved as he received the keys to his new vehicle.

Fans described the moment as “beautiful” and “emotional,” with many noting how rare such acts of gratitude are in modern football.

Ugbade, 55, was a member of the Nigerian team that won the inaugural edition of the FIFA U-17 World Cup in China, then known as the Kodak FIFA U-16 World Tournament, defeating West Germany 2-0 in the final. He went on to feature in all cadres of the national team, playing six matches at the U-17 level, and another six games at the U-20 level, scoring a solitary goal before making five appearances for the Super Eagles.

He transitioned into coaching after officially hanging up his boots in 2003, and he led several domestic outfits. He also had a short stint in charge of Nigeria’s U-17 team nicknamed the Golden Eaglets, where he oversaw four matches at the helm during the AFCON tournament campaign held in Algeria in 2023, in which the country crashed out in the quarter-finals to their Burkina Faso counterparts.

title: International Football Association Board Announced 5 Changes In Football Rule For 2025/26 Season
content:
The International Football Association Board (IFAB) has confirms five major significant updates made to the rules of the Football Game following some complaints.

The changes are expected to take effect in the 2025/26 season, and will be debut at the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup, hosted in the United States.

The modification includes;

1. Goalkeeper Ball Possession Time: Goalkeepers will now have a maximum of 8 seconds to hold the ball. If exceeded, the opposing team will be awarded a corner kick, as against the previous indirect free kick.

2. Ball Drop Situations: When play is stopped with the ball outside the penalty area, possession will be given to the team that clearly had control. If unclear, the restart goes to the team that last touched the ball.

3. Contact Outside the Field of Play: if a substitute, coach, or dismissed player accidentally touches the ball while it's going out of play, the restart will be an indirect free kick. No cards or disciplinary action will be taken.

4. VAR Communication Flexibility: Competitions now have the option to allow referees to verbally explain VAR decisions to the crowd, or keep them private, depending on the tournament's rules.

5. Assistant Referee Positioning: Assistant referees will now position themselves along the penalty spot line rather than the goal line to improve judgments on goal-line decisions and offside calls with VAR support.

Additional Innovations:

Referee Body Cams: FIFA will trial referee body cameras at the Club World Cup, giving fans unique, real-time views from the referee’s perspective.

Referee Communication Protocols: Only team captains will be permitted to speak with the referee in select situations, aiming to boost respect and reduce crowding around officials.

title: Reuben Abati's Fireback At Lere Olayimika And Wike Over Questionable Character
content:
Dr. Reuben Abati's has responded to the allegations made against him by the Minister of FCT, Nyesom Woke spokesperson, Lere Olayinka's during an interview on Arise News' The Morning Show, dated Friday, June 6, 2025.

In a statement released by him on Saturday, he said he has never approached Minister Nyesom Wike to beg for money to settle any corrupt cases. Adding that he was not Rotimi Amaechi's spokesperson, nor did he have his phone number.

"I have never approached Minister Nyesom Wike to beg for money - that is a lie. If anyone - including an ex-partner - went to him under false pretences to solicit funds in my name, place a clear disclaimer. Such actions were not authorised by me, and Minister Wike reserves every right to call it out as fraud.

“Like many others, I was invited by the EFCC for questioning - a lawful and procedural engagement. At no time was I asked to return any money. In fact, the EFCC under Former Chairman, Ibrahim Magu later apologized to me.

“Lere Olayinka clearly misused the word

"hubris" — a basic dictionary reference would have sufficed. I will not indulge further in responding to him directly; he is not my peer. I await a more meaningful conversation - if any - from his principal, not his proxy.

“Am not Rotimi Amaechi's spokesperson, nor do I have his phone number. That's a fabrication.

“I was not absent from The Morning Show on Friday to avoid any discussion. I was engaged at a pre-scheduled book review for "Oprah Benson - Live and Legend", a 550-page publication by Dr.

Udu Yakubu. It was an honourable intellectual commitment.

”I stand firmly by everything I said regarding Minister Wike. He is a public official occupying a public office. He is, and should remain, subject to public scrutiny. Nobody in public service is above accountability.

”On the matter of Late Buruji Kashamu, it is important to state that the allegations against him were never proven in any court of law. Until his death, he was never convicted of any crime, either in Nigeria or abroad. Persisting in amplifying unproven accusations against the deceased is in poor taste and ethically questionable.

”My heartfelt appreciation goes to my diligent team - Rufai Oseni, Vimbai, and our wider crew - for standing tall with professionalism and poise.

And to my ever-supportive wife, Kikelomo Atanda-Owo Abati, your strength remains my anchor. May God bless Nigeria with true transparency, integrity, and boldness in public discourse," the statement reads.

title: Why Alaafin Of Oyo did not visit Ooni Of Ife – Alaafin P.A
content:
The perceived rift between the Alaafin of Oyo, Oba Abimbola Owoade and Ooni of Ife, Oba Adeyeye Ogunwusi escalated on Tuesday when Oba Owode visited Oluwo of Owo palace and ignore the stool of Ooni.  

The controversy was further fuelled by Oluwo, who declared that Alaafin was superior to all other traditional rulers and titles in Yorubaland.

Reacting to the development, in an interview with Punch, Oba Owoade’s Personal Assistant, Kolade Oladele, has explained why the monarch did not visit the Ooni of Ife, Oba Adeyeye Ogunwusi, during his recent trip to Osun State.

According to the palace, Oba Owoade had intended to visit the Ooni as the first point of call during the visit. The Alaafin’s protocol officer had contacted the Ooni’s palace to inform them of the visit but was informed that Oba Adeyeye was unavailable as he’s out of the country.

He maintains that there is no rift between Alaafin and the Ooni. Saying Alaafin doesn’t have time to begrudge anybody. What is paramount to him is the unity and development of the Yoruba race, and he is committed to achieving that.

“We didn’t ignore the Ooni during the visit. We reached out to the palace but were told that Ooni wasn’t around. Ooni’s palace was the first point of call in our initial itinerary, but we had to visit the Oluwo first because of the development.

“I always tell people that there is no rift between Alaafin and the Ooni. Baba (Alaafin) doesn’t have time to begrudge anybody. What is paramount to him is the unity and development of the Yoruba race, and he is committed to achieving that.

“We didn’t visit Ooni the other time because Alaafin’s protocol officer, who reached out to Ooni’s palace, was told that Baba wasn’t around. I want to tell you that we will pay an appreciation visit to Ooni and Governor Ademola Adeleke very soon. Alaafin isn’t fighting anybody,” Oladele said.

Meanwhile, the Director of Media and Public Affairs at the Ooni’s palace, Moses Olafare, said there was no official notification from the Alaafin’s palace about the planned visit to Oba Ogunwusi.

“We were not notified that Alaafin was coming to visit Ooni. Nobody contacted us either through letter or phone call before Baba travelled out of the country.

“What we got was from one of our security operatives, who informed us that somebody called him from the Alaafin’s palace to ask if Baba was around, and he told the person that we were not around. Everybody knew we were not around. There was no notification or any form of communication suggesting that Alaafin was coming to visit Ooni before we left the country,” he said.

title: International Friendly: We're In Russia For Business – Super Eagles Assistant Captain
content:
William Troost-Ekong,  the Super Eagles assistant captain, has made it clear that the Nigerian team are in Russia strictly for business and not for sightseeing.

The Saudi-based defender made this statement during a press conference, as he expressed confidence in the team’s readiness to secure victory.

“This isn’t my first time in Moscow or Russia—I’ve played in Krasnodar, Volgograd, and other cities back in 2018.

“We took a brief walk around the city yesterday and visited Red Square, but make no mistake—we’re here to work. This is not a tourist trip. The coach and I have already gone over our game plan for the match,” Ekong said.

The match is scheduled to take place at the Luzhniki Stadium on Friday, with Nigeria set to take on a strong Russian side.

title: Utaka Urges Chelle To Hand Dessers More Playing Time
content:
Former Super Eagles forward John Utaka, while speaking with Brila FM has called on Nigeria's head coach, Eric Sekou Chelle, to offer more playing time to Rangers striker Cyriel Dessers, who had an impressive season with Rangers by scoring 29 goals, and also made a strong impact in the recent Unity Cup outings.

“He’s a good finisher. I watched his goal against Ghana and was impressed by how composed he was.

“He showed real quality scoring, that type of goal takes maturity. I believe it’s time he’s given more chances with the national team,” Utaka said.

Dessers did found the net against the Black Stars of Ghana and provided an assist in the match against Jamaica’s Reggae Boyz, showcasing his attacking prowess during the recent Unity Cup held in London.

title: Russia Unveils 31 Players For Super Eagles Showdown, Chelle Explains Purpose Behind The Clash
content:
After several days of rigorous training, Russia’s head coach Valery Karpin has released the final squad for the upcoming international friendly against Nigeria’s Super Eagles.

Over 40 players were invited to camp in preparation for the highly anticipated clash before trimmed the list down to 31 players, including four goalkeepers, the final squad also features four newcomers.

Reacting to the upcoming match, Super Eagles head coach Eric Chelle, during a press conference on Thursday in Moscow, has shared the rationale behind the friendly game against Russia. 

“Although it’s a friendly, we have serious goals: first, we want to win; second, we aim to use this match to prepare for upcoming tournaments and qualifying games.

“The Russian national team is very strong, with many high-caliber players. They play an intense, aggressive, and technically sound game.

“Right now, I’m focused on developing a solid plan for the match,” said the Super Eagles boss.

The match is scheduled to take place at the Luzhniki Stadium on Friday, with Nigeria set to take on a strong Russian side.

title: Transfer Update: Super Eagles Boniface, Christantus, Osimhen, Others, Massive Offers
content:
Turkish Super Lig giants Fenerbahce have submitted a substantial offer for Nigerian striker Victor Boniface, following a key role he played in Bayer Leverkusen’s impressive campaign last season, despite battling with recurring injuries.

Earlier this week, the Bundesliga club set a €50 million price tag on Boniface. Meanwhile, reports from Turkey indicate that Fenerbahce has come forward with a €40 million bid for the talented attacker. 

Should the transfer go through, Boniface would become the latest in a line of Nigerian players to represent the Istanbul-based club.

Al Hilal submit official bid to Napoli for Victor Osimhen as top target. Proposal worth €65m fixed fee plus €5m add-ons, decision up to Napoli. This follows story revealed on Al Hilal in contact with Osimhen over salary/personal terms. But news has it that he rejected the AlHilal's €26m offer which similar to their last summer bid and demanding €40m per year before he can even considers a move.

Anything less will not be taken into account, his priority remains UCL, as revealed in early May on @TEAMtalk, and only a monster bid can change his mind.

In new development, Galatasaray are pushing hard to keep him, ready to trigger his release clause and offering €20m per year, including bonuses, to convince him to stay. They claim he feels at home in Istanbul and is in love with the passion of the fans, but admit it may not be enough.

Nigerian international and Getafe attacker Christantus Uche, after an impressive breakout season, has caught the attention of Premier League sides Brentford and Leeds United.

Brentford has already opened formal negotiations with Getafe in a bid to secure the 22-year-old’s signature, while Leeds United is also ramping up efforts to lure the talented midfielder to Elland Road.

Both clubs are eager to bolster their midfield options with a dynamic, young player who offers both immediate impact and long-term potential.

Uche, one of La Liga’s standout performers this season, featured in 38 competitive games—including 32 league appearances—for Getafe. 

He scored four goals and registered seven assists, cementing his status as one of the club’s key players.

His stellar form not only made waves in Spain but also earned him a debut call-up to the Super Eagles, where he featured in the recently concluded Unity Cup in London.

title: Akwa Ibom State: Defection Drama As Akwa Ibomites Oppose Gov Umo Eno During A Town Hall Meeting
content:
Governor Umo Eno of Akwa Ibom State defection saga turn to dramatic event during a town hall meeting held in Ikot Abasi Local Government Area of the state when he announce his defection and claim that he’s assured that the people will go with him to All Progressives Congress Party before met with opposition from the crowd.

Speaking at the Town Square Meeting with the Ikot Abasi Federal Constituency on Wednesday, the governor said he had conducted extensive consultations and was convinced that “it is time to move from the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) to the All Progressives Congress (APC)” in order to align the state with the ruling party at the federal level but was met with resounding opposition from the crowd as they echo NO! to his bids.

“We’re progressively moving forward, linking Akwa Ibom to the center. And I know you’re going with us. Are you going with us, so we can connect to the center?” Eno asked. However, a thunderous “No!” response erupted from the audience, overshadowing the handful of “Yes” voices, creating a tense atmosphere in the crowded venue at the Ikot Abasi Local Government Grounds.

Despite the pushback, Governor Eno continued to make the case for defection as he continue to say; “We thank you for your support. I’ve gone round to consult… And so we have done enough consultation. The time has come that we will move. And we will go to where God is leading us.

“Do not be afraid. Believe in us. Believe in President Bola Tinubu because the future is bright. We are already a minority state in Nigeria. If we come again and start breaking ourselves into pieces, we become minority of the minorities and cannot get anything.”

title: CAF And TECNO Announce New Sponsorship Agreement For CAF Africa Cup Of Nations 2025 And 2027
content:
The Confédération Africaine de Football (“CAF”) and TECNO concluded a Sponsorship Agreement making TECNO the Official Global Partner of the TotalEnergies CAF Africa Cup of Nations (“AFCON”) Morocco 2025 and TotalEnergies CAF AFCON Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda 2027.

The new Agreement was announced in Nairobi Kenya, one of the host countries of the TotalEnergies CAF AFCON 2027 by the CAF General Secretary, Véron Mosengo-Omba and TECNO Vice President, Shiming Jiang.

The announcement between TECNO and CAF follows TECNO’s successful partnership with CAF during the TotalEnergies CAF Africa Cup of Nations Cote d’Ivoire 2023, where TECNO was the exclusive smartphone sponsor for this competition. This partnership resulted in unprecedented growth in engagement and reach for TECNO and increased TECNO’s commitment to African football. 

CAF President Dr Patrice Motsepe said: “The impressive growth and success of the TotalEnergies CAF Africa Cup of Nations has resulted in several exciting sponsorship agreements being concluded by CAF with African and international partners. The partnership with TECNO will contribute to the TotalEnergies CAF Africa Cup of Nations, which is the biggest sporting event in Africa, continuing to grow and reach new markets and audiences. On behalf of CAF and its 54 Member Associations, we would like to thank TECNO for investmenting in African football.”

The Vice President of Transsion Holdings, Benjamin Jiang said: “This renewed partnership is a testament to the deep trust and shared success we’ve built with CAF. In our previous collaboration, we witnessed how football ignited passion and inspired dreams, and how AI-powered smart technologies became powerful tools to connect and empower millions across Africa. That’s why this partnership goes beyond the game—it stands as a symbol of ambition and a platform where young people can shine, united by an unstoppable spirit of progress. It reflects our shared vision of harnessing AI-driven innovation to shape a brighter future for Africa. This renewed collaboration marks a significant milestone in TECNO’s journey forward.”

TECNO’s role as Official Global Partner and Exclusive Partner in the Smartphone category will deepen its engagement and enhance its visibility benefiting from additional media and social media activation rights that will enable TECNO to connect more closely with young people and share the joy of football and inspire a shared spirit of daring and progress across Africa.

Additionally, TECNO will continue its “Dream Field Renovation” Campaign in collaboration with CAF, launched in 2024 with the goal of renovating 100 football fields across Africa by 2028. 

This initiative aims to promote healthy living, foster youth engagement and ensure access to quality playing fields in underserved communities, reflecting TECNO’s “Stop at Nothing” ethos.

 CAF website.

title: Chelle Outlines Steps Super Eagles Must Take To Reach 2026 World Cup
content:
Nigeria’s Super Eagles head coach, Eric Chelle, has outline key steps that Super Eagles must take if ready to qualify for the upcoming 2026 FIFA World Cup in USA.

Chelle, said; “We have a crucial objective in September. I saw this period as an opportunity to give several players a chance to prove themselves, and I’m proud of the way they responded. With just two or three training sessions, they gave everything. That’s the reality.

“We scored goals, created chances, and showed good signs in our overall play. But we still have work to do. There are weaknesses we need to fix. We must grow stronger as a group and as a team especially if we’re serious about reaching the World Cup.

“What matters most now is playing together, in both attack and defence. We have to keep improving, both physically and mentally. We must become true warriors on the pitch.”

With four games remaining in the qualifying series, the Super Eagles will host Rwanda and travel to face South Africa in September. By October, they will play away to Lesotho and at home against Benin Republic.

title: WAFCON 2024: Coach Malele Boast Of Botswana Physical And Tactical Readiness Against Nigeria Team
content:
Botswana head coach, Alex Malele, while reacting to the 2024 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON) Group games that includes Nigeria, Algeria, Tunisia, and Botswana has expressed that despite the strength and the unique of their opponents especially the Nigeria team pose, they are ready to face all opponents both  physically Tactical.

“All the groups are tough in my opinion. There’s no easy group. If you look at Group A, it’s even more competitive because it includes the host nation.

"Group C has the defending champions. In Group B, like last time, we’ve got Nigeria again." Malele pointed out the contrast in playing styles between their group opponents.

“Nigeria’s style of play is very different from Algeria and Tunisia. The latter two are very tactical, while Nigeria blends tactical discipline with physical power.

“We’ve prepared to face both types of teams. Now, the goal is to find a way to qualify for the next round,” he said.

title: African Player Of The Year Award Is A Privilege – Nigeria Forward Say
content:
The Nigerian Super Eagles and Atalanta winger, Ademola Lookman, during an interview on Arise TV, describes the African Player of the Year Award as a profound honor, while expressed deep gratitude for the recognition and reflected on the significance of joining an elite group of African football legends.

“It’s amazing. Honestly, I won’t lie to you — it’s a privilege to have it,” he said.

“I accept it with immense pride. I’ve seen the great players who have received this award, some of the biggest names in football. To now be counted among them is truly a blessing.”

title: FIFA U17 World Cup: Flamingos Draw In Group D To Face Canada, Two Others
content:
Nigeria's U17 women's football team, Flamingos, will face one of their stiffest challenges in Group D of the ‎FIFA U17 Women’s World Cup schedule to kick off in Morocco later this year.

The draw, held on Wednesday, 4 June, at the Mohammed VI Football Academy in Rabat saw the Flamingos drawn in Group D alongside Canada, France and Samoa. 

‎For the very first time, this ninth edition since the competition was launched in New ‎Zealand 17 years ago will feature 24 countries, and as well be the first time U-17 Women’s World Cup will be held on African soil.

Group D overview

France, the winner of 2012 edition return for their fourth appearance. They remain a force to reckon with in youth tournaments and will be aiming to add another title to their cabinet.

Nigeria, the African giants and the continent’s most consistent teams are making their seventh appearance in this year edition. Flamingos had struggled to get past the quarter-final stage until 2022, when they broke new ground.

Canada, making their eighth appearance, in 2018 they narrowly missed out on a medal with a fourth-place finish. The team is mix of physicality and tactical.

Samoa enters as one of the tournament’s four debutants, having sealed qualification through a triumphant run at the 2024 OFC U-16 Women’s Championship. While they may appear as underdogs, their presence adds a wildcard element to the group.

Group A: Morocco, Brazil, Italy and Costa Rica 

Group B: Korea DPR, Mexico, Cameroon and Netherlands  

Group C: United States, Ecuador, China and Norway 

Group D: Nigeria, Canada, France and Samoa 

Group E: Spain, Colombia, Korea Republic and Cote d’Ivoire

Group F: Japan, New Zealand, Zambia and Paraguay

title: Qatar Airways named Official Airline Partner of FIFA Club World Cup 2025™
content:
FIFA and Qatar Airways are pleased to announce a new agreement whereby the premium carrier will become the Official Airline Partner of the inaugural FIFA Club World Cup™. The multiple award-winning airline will join a selection of top brands on the new grand stage of global football and will feature prominently in the tournament branding, as well as offering fans exclusive experiences at the tournament.

“We are thrilled to deepen our partnership with Qatar Airways as we embark on this exciting new chapter with the FIFA Club World Cup – a truly historic moment for world football,” said FIFA President Gianni Infantino.

“Their passion for excellence and ability to connect people around the world make them the perfect partner for this incredible new tournament, which will bring together 32 of the world’s top clubs for a celebration unlike anything we’ve seen before. Truly, and for the first time, club football will unite the world – and Qatar Airways will be a key partner in making this happen.”

Qatar Airways Group’s Chief Executive Officer, Engr. Badr Mohammed Al Meer, said: “The new agreement with FIFA underlines what we value most – teaming up with the pinnacle of football to bring fans closer to the action. The presence of Qatar Airways at this groundbreaking tournament goes beyond branding, as we look to elevate the fan experience and connect them through our global network of more than 170 destinations, with 13 gateways in the United States. We are proud to be here and to play our role in uniting players, officials and fans through the power of football and global travel.”

The FIFA Club World Cup 2025 will see 32 of the world’s top clubs compete across 12 venues in the United States. The drama kicks off on Saturday, 14 June, with Lionel Messi’s Inter Miami CF facing Al Ahly FC at Hard Rock Stadium. The action-packed month will culminate in what promises to be a historic final in New York New Jersey on Sunday, 13 July.

In addition to its partnership with FIFA, Qatar Airways sponsors participating clubs Paris Saint-Germain and FC Internazionale Milano, who will begin their FIFA Club World Cup journeys in Los Angeles on Sunday, 15 June and Tuesday, 17 June respectively.

For the first time ever, each of the 32 participating teams will be competing for the title of the greatest club team in world football. Every match at the tournament will be broadcast live and for free on DAZN, the world’s leading sports entertainment platform.

Fifa Media

title: Super Eagles Squad Make Several Changes Ahead Of Russia Clash Due To Injuries, Personal Withdrawals
content:
The camp of Nigeria National Team, Super Eagle roster shaken due to injuries, personal withdrawals, and administrative challenges face by players which forced the Head Coach Eric Chelle to make several changes to the squad ahead of the international friendly game against Russia.

In Goalkeeping: the goalkeeping department remains stable despite the absence of first-choice shot-stopper Stanley Nwabali, who was unavailable due to bereavement. Maduka Okoye of Udinese and Amas Obasogie of Tanzania’s Singida Black Stars will now compete for the number one jersey.

In Defensives: the likes of captain William Troost-Ekong, Bright Osayi-Samuel, Bruno Onyemaechi, Semi Ajayi, and Igoh Ogbu will now includes Remo Stars’ Sodiq Ismaila and Brentford FC’s Benjamin Fredericks in defense as Nottingham Forest’s Ola Aina withdrawn for personal reasons.

In midfield: Wilfred Ndidi’s injury has opened door for Enugu Rangers’ Saviour Isaac to team up with Frank Onyeka, Raphael Onyedika, Fisayo Dele-Bashiru, Christantus Uche, and Papa Daniel Mustapha in the midfield spots.

In the Attack: Samuel Chukwueze and Kelechi Iheanacho has been excused from the squad base on family reasons, Spain-based Sadiq Umar is sidelined because of injury, and Nathan Tella is unavailable due to delays in renewing his UK passport. As a result, Victor Boniface, Simon Moses, and Tolu Arokodare, Olakunle Olusegun of Krasnodar FC’s, are now the front line.

The international friendly game between Super Eagle of Nigeria and Russia National Team is scheduled to hold on Friday, June 7 at Moscow’s iconic Luzhniki Stadium.

title: Super Eagles Set For First Training In Moscow As Two New Players, Bruno, Olusegun Join 18 Others
content:
Ahead of the international friendly game with Russia, the camp of Nigeria’s senior male team, Super Eagles, has come alive with most invited players are already in camp. The team is scheduled to hold their first training session on Tuesday in Moscow against Friday showdown.

The training camp officially opened on Monday with the arrival of 18 players from London, where the team recently participated in the 2025 Unity Cup tournament. Two additional players, Bruno Onyemaechi and Olakunle Olusegun join the squad on Tuesday morning, bringing the total number of available players to 20.

Players in camp by Tuesday including Maduka Okoye, Amas Obasogie, William Troost-Ekong, Semi Ajayi, Igho Ogbu, Benjamin Fedrick, Bright Osayi-Samuel, Fisayo Dele-Bashiru, Moses Simon, Frank Onyeka, Chrisantus Uche Raphael Onyedika, Tolu Arokodare, Victor Boniface, Bruno Onyemaechi, Olakunle Olusegun, home-based players of Isaac Saviour, Papa Mustapha, Sikiru Alimi and Ismaila Sadiq.

Nigeria heads into this friendly on a high note, having emerged champions of the Unity Cup for the second consecutive time. The team edged past arch-rivals Ghana in the semi-final before securing a dramatic 5-4 penalty shootout victory over Jamaica in Saturday’s final, following a 2-2 draw in regulation time.

The friendly with Russia’s senior men's team will be held at the Luzhniki Stadium, Moscow, on Friday, 6th June 2025.

title: NFF Confirmed The Appointment Of Italian Coach Riccardo Bardine
content:
The Nigerian Fencing Federation (NFF) as part of a newly launched four-year strategic partnership between the NFF and the Italian Fencing Federation has appoints the esteemed Italian coach Riccardo Bardine to lead the national team at the 2025 African Senior Fencing Championships, set to be held in Lagos from June 25 to 29.

The collaboration aims to fast-track the growth of fencing in Nigeria through technical assistance, training, and knowledge-sharing initiatives, as the newly appointed coach is expected to bring his wealth of experience as a certified fencing trainer, strength and conditioning specialist, with added expertise in Paralympic sports on the table.

Renowned in international fencing circles, the 39-year-old coach Bardine will arrive in Lagos in June to lead an intensive two-week training camp for both Nigerian coaches and athletes.

title: Transfer: Okocha Advises Osimhen On Next Move
content:
As speculation intensifies over the next move of the sensational Super Eagle and Galatasaray forward, Victor Osimhen, Nigeria football legend Jay-Jay Okocha has offered him a guidance ahead of summer transfer window.

He urged Osimhen to consider the emotional and professional satisfaction he has found in Turkey, suggesting that staying at Galatasaray could be a wise decision, even if it means making personal sacrifices when speaking to Turkish broadcaster TRT Spor via Haberler.

“Turkey is a great place to play and live football. Sometimes, you may need to make sacrifices when making decisions in football. Osimhen had a great season at Galatasaray. Ultimately, he is happy there. Why shouldn’t he stay with the team? I love Turkey. He loves it too,” he the former Fenerbahçe playmaker stated.

When asked if he had any inside knowledge on Osimhen’s next destination, Okocha remained reserved. “I don’t know, but wherever he decides to go, I wish him the best.”

Osimhen, recently concluded his one year loan at Galatasaray from Napoli, breaks records, scored 37th goals in the season, won Turkey league and cup titles.

While Osimhen has yet to publicly made know his next move, his agent has reportedly received a new contract offer from Galatasaray worth €15m per year, a €3m increase on his current earnings, which would make him the highest-paid player in the club’s history.

Galatasaray’s head coach Okan Buruk praised Osimhen contribution and expressed hope that he would remain with them. While fans has also launch a global #staywithus campaign that included a billboard message in Times Square.

title: Presidency began internal approval processes to settle N2tn power debt
content:
According to the Special Adviser to the President on Energy,  Eriye Onagoruwa, during the second Nigerian Electricity Supply Industry Stakeholders Meeting of 2025, hosted by the Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission on Monday, Presidency in an efforts to stabilise Nigeria’s power sector has moves to resolve the N2tn legacy debt owed to electricity generation companies before the end of the coming quarter.

Onagoruwa said the Presidency recognises the urgency of addressing the debt overhang, which has strained GenCos and impeded electricity supply nationwide. She revealed that alternative debt instruments are being explored due to the Federal Government’s current fiscal constraints.

“We are empathetic to what GenCos are facing. We are exploring alternative debt instruments, and I can confirm that both the Coordinating Minister of the Economy and the Debt Management Office are aligned with this effort. Internal approvals are currently underway.

“I hope by the next NESI meeting, I will be able to share a clear update,” she said.

The Senate Committee on Power recently raised concerns over the liquidity crisis bedevilling the power sector, lamenting that the tariff shortfalls in the industry indicated that the government owes about N200bn to electricity-generating companies every month, stating that since this year, the government has not paid the power producers which has raised the debt to about N800bn.

Gencos had earlier issued a warning to the Federal Government over the continued accumulation of debts now totalling over N4tn.

title: Emergency Rule In Rivers State Is Against My Wish – Wike
content:
The former Governor of Rivers State and current minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, during a media chat with selected journalists in Abuja on Monday has refuted the claims of supporting President Tinubu’s declaration of emergency rule in Rivers State, maintained that he has no personal conflict with Governor Sim Fubara who gave himself to be the tool for those who could not fight him to fight him.

He distanced himself from the president Tinubu emergency rule declaration, an act he describe as tool to save and protect Governor Fubara amid impeachment threats.

 “I do not have any crisis with Fubara. Rather, the governor, unknown to me, gave himself to be the tool for those who could not fight me, to fight me.

“I am not the president who declared a state of emergency. If Mr President had called me, I wouldn’t have agreed. I have never supported it.

 “The declaration was to save the governor because he was almost impeached,” he said.

On the crisis resolution, the minister deferred to presidential authority: “He, Tinubu, knows when to lift it. He has everything on his table. I don’t know,” he concluded.

title: How Russian Coach Assesses Super Eagles With Osimhen, Lookman Absence
content:
The Super Eagles of Nigeria departed England for Moscow on Sunday night as they gear up for an international friendly against Russia National Team scheduled for Friday, June 6 at the iconic Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow for their first-ever senior-level meeting.

The newly crowned Unity Cup champions will arrive in Moscow in the early hours of Monday in almost a four-hour flight from London to Moscow via Morocco as they continuing their preparations for the upcoming 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers.

The Russia’s national team head coach, Valery Karpin, in his remark has acknowledged that the Super Eagles remain a strong team and still poses a significant threat even in the absence of key forwards Victor Osimhen and Ademola Lookman who were left out of the squad by Nigeria’s coach Eric Chelle.

"Of course. I repeat, I would have liked to see Osimhen and Lookman play to test our team against the best. But their absence certainly does not make Nigeria fundamentally weaker," Karpin said in an interview with Komsomolskaya Pravda.

Super Eagle recently concluded their participation in the 2025 Unity Cup invitational tournament in London, where they emerged champions after defeated Jamaica 5-4 in a penalty shootout at Brentford’s Gtech Community Stadium following a 2-2 draw in regulation time having previously edged out rivals Ghana with 2-1 in the semifinals.

title: Coach Chelle Shifts Focus To Russia Showdown After Coast In Victory, Adjusts Super Eagles Squad
content:
Following Nigeria’s triumph in the Unity Cup title in London after a dramatic penalty shootout victory over Jamaica with 5-4 in a penalty shootout following a 2-2 draw in regulation time having previously edged out rivals Ghana with 2-1 in the semifinals, Super Eagles head coach Eric Chelle has turned his attention to the upcoming clash against Russia scheduled for June 6 at the Luzhinki Stadium in Moscow.

Speaking to reporters after the win, Chelle emphasized his commitment to maintaining a winning mentality as the team prepares for their next challenge.

“Now we head to Russia, and our goal is clear, to win. We’re not just making the trip for the sake of it; we’re going there to secure a result..

“Mentally, it still feels like we’re in Jamaica — that game took a lot out of us. But now, we must shift our focus.

“Playing away is never easy. That’s why we’re emphasizing the mental aspect. That was my message to the players: we need to show the football world our mindset and our hunger.

“We’re moving forward with the same ambition, go to Russia, get the win, and return to Abuja with pride,” Chelle said.

In quest for victory, the Head Coach as well made a slight changes to the Nigeria’s senior national team roster. The squad restructured to incorporate new names not featured in the Unity Cup tournament.

The updated list includes three additions: Saviour Isaac, Ismaila Sodiq, and Sikiru Alimi. While Isaac is making his first appearance in this international window, both Sodiq and Alimi were involved in the Unity Cup campaign.

The team is now set to travel to Russia as they continue preparations for upcoming competitive fixtures.

title: Super Falcons Vs Cameroon Indomitable Lionesses Match Postponed Again
content:
The much-anticipated international women’s friendly football game between Nigeria’s Super Falcons and Cameroon’s Indomitable Lionesses has once again been postponed, just hours before kickoff  despite been scaled down to a single match which ought to take place on Monday, June 2, at the MKO Abiola Stadium, Abeokuta due to logistic issue .

The first of the two-legged was originally scheduled for last weekend, with first leg expected to take place on Saturday in Ikenne before call off due to inability of the Cameroonian to solve the logistic problem. The second leg was then rescheduled to take place at MKO Abiola Stadium, Abeokuta on June 2, which has now postpone again to June 3 at same venue according to the latest update from the Falcons' media team.
