title: Golden Eaglets zoom into semi finals At The 22nd National Sports Festival
content:
Five-time world champions Golden Eaglets has made their way into the semi finals of the football event at the 22nd National Sports Festival tagged “Gateway Games Ogun 2024” in Ogun State.

Abdulmuiz Adeleke, who netted the first goal in the 2-1 win over Edo State on Monday, came up big with a brace against Ebonyi State in Friday morning’s quarter-final encounter, which the Eaglets won 5-0 to sail into the last four.

Mohammed Imrana, scorer of the second goal against Edo State, was also among the goals, though he was unlucky to bag a red card in the closing minutes of the encounter. Destiny Samuel and Emmanuel Ochigbo were the other scorers.

On Thursday, the Flamingos drew 0-0 with Lagos State. They lead their group B with five points, ahead of Friday evening’s final group stage clash with Enugu State, who are pointless.

Delta and Lagos State are fast on the Flamingos’ heels with four points each.

Osun State leads the four-team group A with seven points, with Ogun and Edo States on five and four points respectively.

title: Delta dominates taekwondo and Reclaims medals Top Spot at the Gateway Games 2024
content:
At the ongoing 22nd National Sports Festival, tagged the Gateway Games 2024, Delta State has reaffirmed its supremacy as the overall champion at the five-days taekwondo event held at Ilisan Town Hall as the defending champion clinching an impressive haul of five gold, two silver, and four bronze medals.

Delta’s dominance was very evident, secured gold in the male and female team events, as well as the pair event.

Apart from the taekwondo success, the National champions Olusola Olowookere and Kolade Paul added to the Delta state tally with gold medals in the men’s lightweight and middleweight divisions respectively to helping Team Delta top the medal table.

In the swimming events, Delta's athletes made an emphatic statement. Duke Eniyekenumi delivered a composed performance to clinch gold in the men’s 200m backstroke, while Akiayefa Timipame-ere demonstrated remarkable versatility, topping the podium in the women’s 200m individual medley. These early victories reinforced the state’s formidable aquatic pedigree and gave their medal count a powerful boost.

Team Delta state has garnered a total of 76 Medals consisting of 35 gold, 12 silver and 29 bronze medals overtaking Team Bayelsa who has won 66 medals; 33 gold, 16 silver and 17 beonze.

Trailing Delta in the taekwondo standings were Oyo State which finished second overall with three gold, four silver, and four bronze medals, while Osun State came third, securing three gold, one silver, and two bronze medals.

Host state Ogun placed fourth with two gold, five silver, and three bronze medals. Bayelsa and Rivers States also claimed two gold medals each, but Bayelsa edged ahead with two silver and six bronze medals, compared to Rivers’ lower medal count.

Speaking on the quality of competition, Victor John, Technical Director of the Nigeria Taekwondo Federation, praised the event’s competitiveness and the emergence of promising new talent.

“I’m excited by the hunger and potential shown by the new athletes. We’ve identified several for the national camp. While many are still raw, with proper training and exposure, they can become world-class competitors,” John said.

“This year’s festival showcased high-quality bouts across all weight categories. We hope this momentum continues across states to build a strong national team for future events like the African Games and Olympic qualifiers,” he added.

title: Team Oyo Excels At National Sports Festival Gateway Games 2025 With Multiple Medals
content:
Team Oyo delivered an outstanding performance today at the ongoing National Sports Festival Gateway Games 2025, racking up a series of medals across para athletics, darts, powerlifting, and kickboxing events.

In the Shot Put F57 Men’s category, Omenogor Ikechukwu threw his way to a silver medal, reinforcing Oyo’s growing dominance in field events.

The track events brought further success as Adebisi Abdullahi and Adebayo Kokoomo sprinted to silver and bronze, respectively, in the 100m T12/13 final, thrilling spectators with a photo-finish race.

Team Oyo also secured double silver medals in the Walk Race (Men and Women) through the determined efforts of Ishaih Noah and Inemest Joy, keeping the state’s athletic hopes alive and well.

In Para Powerlifting, Oyo State made a bold statement of strength with two gold medals: Rita Ferdinand triumphed in the 79kg category, while Dauda Ibrahim claimed victory in the 59kg class, pushing Oyo further up the medal table.

The Darts events brought more accolades, with the duo of Adeyemi Saheed and Williams Grace winning silver in the 701 Mixed Doubles. Adeyemi added to his tally by winning gold in the 1001 Men’s Singles, followed by Alao Adedolapo who secured silver, giving Oyo an impressive one-two finish.

Meanwhile, in Kickboxing, Quadiri Balikisi Olasubomi showcased impressive skills and resilience to earn a bronze medal in the fiercely contested -52kg female category.

With today’s commendable medal haul, Team Oyo continues to make a strong impression at the Gateway Games 2025, reflecting the depth of talent and preparation invested in the athletes.

title: Team Ogun's Male and Female cricket vie for bronze medals at National Sports Festival
content:
Team Ogun's male and female cricket teams have been condemned to the bronze medal matches of the T20 cricket at the ongoing Gateway games. The two host teams lost their respective semi-finals on Friday in disappointing fashions.

The male team will face Team Oyo in the bronze medal match on Saturday after losing to Team Edo in the semifinals by nine wickets. Team Oyo lost to Kaduna in their own semifinals.

The host cricket teams will hope to contribute to Team Ogun's medal overall with a double-bronze medal in the third place matches as the women's team hope to cap an impressive campaign off with bronze after losing to Team Lagos on Friday in the semifinals.

Team Lagos secured a place in the Gold medal match with an eight runs win and will face Edo in the final. Team Ogun women will on Saturday play for a bronze medal match against their counterparts from Akwa Ibom.

title: Gateway Games: Nsc Dg Hails Team Ija As Swimming Prospect Abili Promises Olympics Podium Performance
content:
National Sports Commission Director-General Hon. Bukola Olopade is pleased with the performance of the Invited Junior Athletes (IJA) at the 22nd National Sports Festival Ogun 2024 so far.

A visibly excited Hon. Olopade spoke after the medal presentation to IJA swimmer Aidan Dumuje Abili at the venue of the swimming event. Abili has won three medals so far (two silver and one bronze).

His words, "It gladdens my heart to see the immediate impact of this new IJA project we initiated at the NSC. We decided to give these kids an opportunity to compete at the elite level and so far they are proving that age is only numbers. With the performances we are seeing in this Festival, one can only wonder what they will turn in in the years ahead with even more exposure. They have shown zero fears at this Games. Quite commendable."

Abili is thankful to the NSC for the opportunity afforded the junior athletes to feature at the National Sports Festival.

"I have not participated at this level before. On behalf of the other IJA athletes, I thank the NSC for this opportunity. I have learnt quite a lot here. This exposure will surely help me in my career", he said.

He promised to take advantage of the Gateway Games participation to put Nigeria on the podium in future global events.

"I have my eyes now on the Youth Olympics. After that I will target the Olympics in the years ahead. I will do my best to make sure I put Nigeria on the podium in appreciation of this opportunity. We have to make this IJA experience count", he added.

Abili, a triple gold medalist at the 2024 National Youth Games, won two silver medals in the 50m backstroke and 100m backstroke and bronze in the 200m backstroke

title: Gateway Game 2024: Team Rivers Qualified For The Semifinal After Beating Plateau Basketball Team
content:
Team Rivers basketball team defeated Team Plateau 63-58 to book their place in the semifinal of the ongoing National Sports Festival 2024.

The match, played at the Alake Sports Centre, Abeokuta, saw Team Plateau winning two quarters while Rivers led in the last quarter.

Team Plateau won the first quarter 20-13, lost the second quarter 33-31, and in the third quarter, it was a tie at 47-47, but Team Plateau lost the final quarter, bringing the score to 63-58.

Meanwhile Team Plateau has won twenty medals so far in the ongoing event,four gold,three silver and thirteen bronze medals.

title: Battle Of Supremacy: Oyo State House Of Assembly Protest Over Council of Obas And Chairmanship
content:
Following the presentation by House Committee on Local Government and Chieftaincy over the proposed amendment to reverted to a rotational chairmanship among the Alaafin of Oyo, the Olubadan of Ibadanland, and the Soun of Ogbomoso, the House has been facing backlash.

The bill struck out the permanent presiding officer role initially vested in the Alaafin of Oyo, and also recommended that 10 beaded crown-wearing Ibadan obas, Samu and Agbakin be included as members of the Council of Obas and Chiefs.

The bill initially proposed making Alaafin the permanent chairman, with Olubadan and Soun serving as concurrent chairmen in that order of ranking during Alaafin’s absence, but generated heated arguments among the traditional rulers and stakeholders in the state when pass its second reading on the floor of the House last week Thursday.

The Olubadan and Soun, insisted on maintaining rotational chairmanship with the Alaafin and urged the Assembly to reverse its decision of making Alafin sole chairman of the traditional rulers, while some other traditional rulers in the state also criticised the Assembly for expanding the council to include 10 more Ibadan Obas. The act they perceived it will further give Ibadan more dominance as it witness in political space. 

Kicking against the rotational clause, and wanted a sole chairmanship for Alafin, the lawmakers representing Oyo East and Atiba constituencies, Olorunpoto Rahman and Gbenga Oyekola, respectively stage a walked out while the House was deliberating on the recommendation of the committee on Tuesday.

In a sideline interview with newsmen, Rahman said; “We should be guided by the truth in whatever law we make. Everyone knows the position of the Alaafin. We are not out of touch with history.

“Alaafin is a paramount ruler. We should not make a law for political convenience. We should make a law that can stand the test of time. We should make a law that will align with history.

“We are not satisfied with the process by the committee. There was neither a public hearing nor stakeholder engagement. There is no instance where they invited anyone from Oyo to speak on this bill. I have serious issues with that.”

On the issue of inclusion of 10 beaded crown-wearing Ibadan obas, Samu and Agbakin as members of the Council of Obas and Chiefs. The Palace of the Olugbon of Orile-Igbon in a statement by the Media Consultant, Bisi Oladele, faulty the bill, stated it lack adequate consultation. 

“The actions on the bill so far clearly ignored the relevance of traditional rulers in Oyo State. It is openly based on political patronage. For such an important bill that seeks to revive and do justice to the council of obas and chiefs, the key stakeholders are the traditional rulers, who should have been adequately consulted before it was packaged.

“Should the bill be passed, indigenes of Oyo, Ogbomoso, Oke-Ogun and Ibarapa zones will again become second-class indigenes in their own state, just as Ibadan indigenes have been dominating other parts of the state politically.

“The city has produced governors since 1999, except for the late Adebayo Alao-Akala.

“While there is a need for the council to be revived and strengthened, it should not be skewed in favour of a particular zone to further dominate other zones.

“It should reflect fairness, justice, equity, and possess the capacity to promote peace among traditional rulers in the state,” the statement read.

title: Gateway Games 2024 Fire Outbrake: Disaster Prevented At Venue Of 22 National Games Festival
content:
The panic that trails diesel tanker explosion at Alake Sports Complex in Ijeja, Abeokuta—one of the primary venues of the ongoing National Sports Festival in Ogun State have been put to rest following the swift action by actors that prevented it to cause any damage.

The incident occurred shortly after 3:00 p.m. when a gas truck delivering fuel to power the complex’s generating set reportedly caught fire. Eyewitnesses said the sudden blaze sent athletes, officials, and spectators fleeing in alarm.

The Special Adviser to the Ogun State Governor on Media and Strategy, Kayode Akinmade, in a statement, confirmed the incident and clarified that the incident involving a diesel tanker that resulted in a fire outbreak, the fire was immediately put out to prevent any damage.

“The incident this afternoon involving a diesel tanker close to one of our facilities for the National Sports Festival was very unfortunate. We thank God that the fire was immediately put out to avert any casualties.

“To this end, we want to assure all our athletes and the people of the state of safety and that there is no cause for alarm as the situation is under absolute control,” the statement read.

title: 22nd National Sports Festival: NSC Disqualifies Six Registered Athletes For Antidoping Test

title: Gateway Games 24: FCT Face Host After Thrash Borno, Lagos Walkover Ondo In Male Football Match
content:
At the ongoing 2024 National Sports Festival, (NSF) in Ogun State, the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) male football team defeated Borno State Counterpart with 4-1 goal margin.

In the game played this morning at the training pitch of Remo Stars in Ikenne saw forward, Paul Joseph recorded the first hat-trick of the competition. Paul scored the three goals in the first half to ensure that the 2018 champions of the National Sports Festival football event had a commanding grip on the match.

Team Borno State try a comeback with a goal in the second half but Titus Meshach Waziri ensured that the game was put beyond the "Home of Peace" boys as he made it 4-1 on the 75th minute.

Speaking after the victory, Assistant Coach of the FCT and former Super Falcons star, Coach Mary Godspower Benny told journalist that the result put the team in good stead going into the football event.

"We emphasized the importance of starting on a good note and the players stocked to the game plans. Although we should have won with greater margin, but being the first game, we will go back and work on our lapses before our next game on Tuesday," she said.

FCT will face host state, Ogun State in their 2nd group match on Tuesday by 8am.

In other results, Team Kano defeated Team Kwara 2-1, Ebonyi 2 vs Team Ogun 1, Team Lagos 3 vs Team Ondo 0 (Walkover) asTeam Ondo didn't show up for their game.

title: Beyond Expectation, Gateway Games 2025 Opens in Grand Style
content:
The 22nd edition of the National Sports Festival, tagged “Gateway Games 2025,” was officially declared open on Sunday, May 18, at the MKO Abiola International Stadium in Abeokuta, Ogun State. The opening ceremony, rich in color, culture, and celebration, marked the commencement of Nigeria’s biggest sporting event.

Originally slated for November 2024, the festival faced several postponements before finally kicking off in May 2025. Vice President Kashim Shettima formally opened the event, joined by a host of dignitaries including former President Olusegun Obasanjo, ex-governors Segun Osoba and Gbenga Daniel, and former House Speaker Dimeji Bankole.

The evening dazzled with live performances from musical heavyweights Davido and Asa, the latter of whom also rendered stirring versions of the national and Ogun State anthems. The Loud Urban Choir and other cultural troupes added vibrant traditional flair, while the official theme song, composed by Bayo Adepetan, resonated through the stadium.

Over 10,000 athletes from across Nigeria’s 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory are competing in 33 sports. A special feature this year is the Invited Junior Athletes (IJA) team, showcasing emerging talents and future stars.

Governor Dapo Abiodun expressed confidence in Ogun State’s preparedness, citing major infrastructural improvements and cultural readiness for the historic event. He emphasized the role of the festival in promoting unity, sportsmanship, and youth development.

The ceremony concluded with a breathtaking fireworks display, signaling the start of two weeks of sporting action and national celebration in the Gateway State.

title: Gateway Games 24: Let It Reign! This Will Be One Of The Best Sports Festival Ever - Olopade Boast
content:
In a spirited address, the Director General of the National Sports Commission, Hon. Bukola Olapade has assured the 22 National Sports Festival delegates of a colourful and groundbreaking event that will set new standards in the history of the games.

He emphasized that the festival will not only be a celebration of sports but also a testament to integrity, love, focus, discipline, and unity.

“Let medals be won with honor, not by crook,” he admonished, stressing the importance of fair play and true sportsmanship.

He also expressed profound gratitude to the Chairman of the NSC, Mallam Shehu Dikko, and Governor of Ogun State, Prince Dapo Abiodun, for their unwavering dedication to the success of the festival and tremendous support in mobilizing resources and empowering all stakeholders.

“Mallam Dikko has shown immense commitment and love for this project. That spirit must be cascaded down to every athlete and official.

"In same manner, Governor Dapo Abiodun, has been very supportive tremendously, mobilizing resources, excellent logistics and empowering all stakeholders to place Ogun state on the national and international sports map.

“Welcome to my story — a game I bid for, a journey that has my name written all over it," he stated.

title: 22nd National Sports Festival: Davido, Asa Set To Perform At Opening Ceremony
content:
Director General of the National Sports Commission, NSC, Hon Bukola Olopade who doubles as the Chairman of the Main Organising Committee of the 22nd National Sports Festival, tagged Gateway Games, 2024, has announced that two of Nigeria's finest music Super stars Davido and Asa will perform live at the highly anticipated Opening ceremony of the Games at the MKO Sports Arena schedule for today Sunday 18th, by 5 PM.

He also said apart from the A list Artists that will be performing, world class activities and cultural displays have been lined up to light up the Games in order to ensure the Game remain one of the best organised festivals.

"This is our own Olympics and from start to finish, the festival must portray that global feel, both in competition and organisation. This is why the National Sports Commission and the Ogun State Government have put up a World class event to mark the Opening ceremony today.

"I have spent the last two years saying Ogun state will host the best Festival but doubters never believed. Beyond the aesthetic you are seeing here today, which confirms to everyone what I have been saying, from the opening ceremony to the Games proper, you will be seeing the best.

"Also Beyond that, this is the first NSF ever that the first two days will be rancour free from hostel and feeding, So I am very excited about everything and what is even coming up later today in the Opening Ceremony.

"I might not reveal all but I can tell you that Davido will be closing it up and Asa will be starting it. However I will not disclose what will be in-between. Nigerians should just stay glued to their Television because they are about to witness an opening ceremony like never before", he concluded.

title: Transfer: Real Madrid Signed Dean Huijsen For £50m
content:
Bournemouth defender, Dean Huijsen has signed five years contract with Real Madrid. The agreement will run until June 2030

Medical tests successfully completed in London last night as all formal documents have now been sealed. The Spanish club will pay his £50m release clause in three installments

Huijsen salary will be €9M per year before taxes at Real Madrid, reports Sky, and expected to play the FIFA Club World Cup with Madrid..

A number of Europe top clubs in the likes of Newcastle, Chelsea, Liverpool and Arsenal were among those keen to pursue the 20-year-old, but Huijsen's priority was always a move to the Bernabeu, returning to Spain where he grew up playing for Malaga's youth team.

The Spain international who joined Bournemouth from Juventus last summer for £12.6m, has made 34 appearances in all competitions this season, scoring three times.

In their farewell message, Bournemouth praise Huijsen's impact in the team, said: "The centre-back, who joined the Cherries from Juventus last summer, has been instrumental in the club's record-breaking campaign, which has seen Andoni Iraola's side already break their highest points tally in the Premier League."

Juventus will receive 10% cut of Huijsen's fee.

title: Crystal Palace Beat Man City, Lift FA Cup, Put Hope In Dash
content:
Crystal Palace on Saturday defeated Manchester City to win their first ever major trophy in history after edging the blues 1-0 in the FA Cup final match played yesterday.

The defeats means there will be no trophy this season for Pep Guardiola and Manchester City who are still fighting for Champions League qualification in the Premier League.

Eberechi Eze scored the game’s only goal in the 16th minute at Wembley against the seven-time winners while Dean Henderson saved a penalty from Omar Marmoush.

title: Lookman Received Double Honour, Makes Serie A Team Of The Season-Full List
content:
Super Eagles and Atalanta forward, Ademola Lookman has been nominated for Serie A Player of the Month of May and makes it to the official list of Seria A Team of the Season.

He was nominated alongside five other players which include Riccardo Orsoloni (Bologna), Khenphren Thuram (Juventus), Scott McTominay (Napoli), Manu Kone (AS Roma) and Santiago Gimenez (AC Milan) for the individual accolade.

The 27-year-old has 20 goal contributions (15 goals and five assists) in 30 league games this season, and broke his six-game goal drought after scoring in La Dea’s 2-1 victory over AS Roma on Monday.

Though Napoli has the highest numbers of players in the Team of the Season with the likes of Romelu Lukaku, Scott McTominay, Alessandro Buongiorno, Giovanni Di Lorenzo and Amir Rrhamani, Ademola Lookman and teammate Mateo Retegui feature for Atalanta.

Inter Milan stars Marcus Thuram, Nicolo Barella, Alesandro Bastoni , Federico Dimarco also made the selection.

Christian Pulisic and Tijjani Reijnders are the two AC Milan players on the list.

The other players are Riccardo Orsoloni (Bologna), Nico Paz (Como), Moise Keane (Fiorentina), Mattia Zaccagani (Lazio), Evan Ndicka (AS Roma), Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), Che Adams (Torino), David De Dea (Fiorentina), Manuel Locatelli and Khéphren Thuram.

title: Transfer: List Of Super Eagles Players And Potential New Club
content:
As season wind down, different cubs are seeking ways to improve their squads, show interest in players they thought best for the club ahead of the new season.

Below are some of the Super Eagles players that may allegiance to new club

Wilfred Ndidi: Saudi Pro League outfit Al Ahli have expressed interest in signing the Leicester City midfielder as he’s expected to leave the King Power Stadium this summer following Leicester City’s relegation from the Premier League.

Arriyadiyah made known that Al Ahli have already established contact with Ndidi’s representatives and are hopeful of convincing the Nigeria international to make the switch to Asia.

The 28-year-old, who still have two years left on his contract with the club has a £9m release clause in his contract.

Cyriel Dessers: Greek Club AEK Athens has expressed interest in the services of the Super Eagles’ and Scottish Premier League player ahead of the summer transfer window.

Dessers could leave Scottish Premier League outfit, Rangers at the end of the season despite his impressive scoring form for the club this season.

The 30-year-old after joined Rangers from Serie A club, Cremonese two years ago for €4.5m has scored 28 goals in 54 appearances across all competitions for the Light Blues in the current campaign.

Reports from Greece are suggesting that AEK Athens have made him one of their targets for the new season.

The Nigerian has two years left on his contract with Barry Ferguson’s side.

Sky Bet Championship club Middlesbrough have confirmed Kelechi Iheanacho’s return to Spanish club, Sevilla after joined them on loan in January.

The 28-year-old moved to the Riverside Stadium in search of regular football after falling out of favour at Sevilla.

The Nigeria international scored one goal and registered two assists in 15 league appearances for Michael Carrick’s side, missed only one game against Stoke City.

title: Federal Government Declares Free Education At All Federal Science & Technical Colleges (FSTC) 25/26
content:
In the spirit of Renew-hope agenda of President Tinubu led administration, the Federal Government of Nigeria has eliminated all fees at the 33 Federal Science and Technical Colleges (FSTC) starting from the 2025–2026 academic year.

Tinubu fulfill another campaigns manifesto of total education overhauling for greater nation and economy opportunities.

Now the children of common man can now access best technical and science skills at no cost.

List of the 33 Federal Science and Technical Colleges in Nigeria:

  1. FSTC Yaba – Lagos State
  2. FSTC Ilesa – Osun State
  3. FSTC Kafanchan – Kaduna State
  4. FSTC Uyo – Akwa Ibom State

  8. FSTC Tungbo – Bayelsa State
  9. FSTC Doma – Nasarawa State

  23. FSTC Usi-Ekiti – Ekiti State
  24. FSTC Ogugu – Kogi State

  30. FSTC Garki – Jigawa State
  31. FSTC Kuta – Niger State
  32. FSTC Biliri – Gombe State
  33. FSTC Otukpa – Benue State

The 2025–2026 academic year Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) program will begin in August 2025.

TVET provides a practical approach to education, giving students credentials and abilities that are highly sought after in today’s labor market.

Benefits of TVET Programs

TVET programs are intended to assist students in gaining specialized skills in a wide range of industries, such as construction, engineering, hospitality, and healthcare, among many others!

By enrolling in this program, children will gain the following:

1. Free Tuition for the 3 years of Training in the College

2. Free Accommodation for the 3 Years of Training

3. Free Meals for the 3 Years of Training

4. Industry-Relevant Skills for Immediate Employment

5. Job Readiness as Courses are Aligned with Labor Market Needs

6. Self Employed Opportunity as Graduates are able to work for themselves

7. Students shall be paid Monthly Stipends for their upkeep.

8. Upon Completion of Studies in 3 years, Students Shall Have Access to Federal Grants or Loans to Start Their Enterprise

9. Students upon graduation will obtain a National Business and National Technical Certificate.

10. Students upon graduation will obtain the Second Certificate in National Skills Qualification Certification (NSQ).

11. The Two Certificates Shall Have Worldwide Acceptability for Those Who Want to Practice Their Enterprise or Vocation Overseas

Wish to Apply?

1. Visit any of the Federal Science and Technical Colleges (FSTC) to register.

2. Registration fee per student is N4,200 (four thousand, two hundred naira) only.

3. Upon payment of the registration fee, the FSTC staff shall assist candidates to complete registration online.

4. Registration of candidates shall end on Thursday, 12th June 2025.

5. Entrance examination shall hold on Saturday, 14th June 2025, at the selected Federal Science and Technical College FSTC, at 9am.

6. No late registration shall be allowed.

7. Age bracket allow for reintegration is between 13 to 20 year old.

title: National Sport Festival: Ogun State Cricket Teams Boast Of Medals Potential
content:
The chairman of the Ogun State Cricket Association, Mr Oludare Kuforiji (FCA), on Saturday while speaking ahead of Sunday opening ceremony of the 22nd National Sports Festival in Ogun State has revealed the preparedness of the state's male and female cricket teams to gun for medals.

He revealed that the association camped the teams in two different stages of camping and also prepared three different fields to allow the teams train.

The 3 different match pitches are to allow good playing days and early completion of matches as cricket will be hosting 3 different events : ODI, T-20 and 6 aside, presenting opportunity to compete for 6 gold medals - 3 for male and 3 for female at this festival.

"Ogun State Cricket teams have been in a state close camp since a month with much support and complement from the Cricket Association. Having been camped at the cricket pavilion all this time.They were moved to the government arranged venue at Ikenne late evening yesterday to join the rest of the state contingents as the festival proper starts Tuesday next week," Kuforiji said.

He also commended the President of the Cricket National Body, Mr Uyi Akpata, Ogun State Cricket Association, FSK Nigeria Limited, and Corporate sponsors for their support and aids at various levels.

Cricket matches will run for nine days starting from the 20th of May till 29th of May.

title: Flying Eagles Landed In Cairo For A Clash Against Egypt
content:
Nigeria's U20 national team, the Flying Eagles, after fail to book their place in final to battle for Gold medal has arrived in Cairo in preparation for their third-place showdown against tournament hosts Egypt at the 2025 CAF U-20 Africa Cup of Nations.

The team landed by approximately 5:00 p.m. local time yesterday and will resume training on Saturday as they aim for Bronze medal against Egypt on Sunday.

The seven times CAF U-20 Africa Cup of Nations Champion loss 1-0 to South Africa's Amajita in the semifinals match held at the Suez Canal Stadium in Ismailia, while Egypt also suffered 1-0 loss to Morocco in their semifinal game.

title: CAF Finalized Plan To Unveil Brand New Champions League Trophy
content:
The Confederation of African Football (CAF) as part of the campaign promises made by the CAF President during his re-election bid has released update to drop the old version of the prestigious CAF Champions League trophy and present a brand new design.

An official update from CAF’s headquarters in Cairo, Egypt, confirms that the new trophy will be launched on May 22, 2025 in a ceremony expected to take place in Johannesburg, South Africa, during the first leg of the Champions League final between Mamelodi Sundowns and Egypt's FC Pyramid.

With this new development, Al Ahly of Egypt will be the last club to lift the outgoing version.

title: Nottingham Forest Release Updates On Awoniyi Injury And Internal Probe
content:
Nottingham Forest is set to conduct an internal investigation into the medical team's handling of Super Eagles striker Taiwo Awoniyi's injury, which on Sunday ultimately resulted in him being placed in an induced coma after underwent first surgery to repair a ruptured intestine.

The 27-year-old Nigeria international sustained serious abdominal injury during Nottingham Forest’s 2-2 draw with Leicester City on Sunday when collided with the post in the 88th minute as he attempted to get on the end of a cross from Anthony Elanga.

The medical staff attended to him but allowed him to continue playing, a decision that has received significant criticism in the aftermath.

The club's experienced doctor, Dr. Prithish Shyam Narayan, along with other medical staff and coaches, will be questioned to provide the hierarchy at the City Ground with a comprehensive understanding of the events that transpired before any decisions are made.

The club has confirmed that he is recovering well and very fast, as the Nottingham Forest manager Nuno Espírito Santo provided an encouraging update on him ahead of the club’s final Premier League match of the season against Chelsea at the City Ground.

Speaking during his pre-match press conference ahead of Forest’s upcoming clash with West Ham United, Espírito Santo shared positive news regarding Awoniyi’s recovery.

“He had surgery and thank God it went well. He’s now under observation, we’re still waiting for the doctors to allow visits, but his family is with him. We are concerned, of course, but optimistic.

“The information we have is that he’ll need at least five days of observation. Hopefully, all goes well, and next week he can rejoin the team and be around us again.

“Believe me, he’s a wonderful boy. It’s been a very tough season for him, and we all feel deeply for him,” said the Forest boss.

title: AFCON U20: Newcastle United Team Arrive Egypt To Scouts Flying Eagles, Other Talents
content:
In an effort to expand the club’s scouting network and identifying young prospects from across Africa, the Newcastle United's scouting team has touched down in Egypt to assess emerging talent at the ongoing U-20 Africa Cup of Nations.

The move which is part of a broader recruitment strategy led by Newcastle’s sporting director, Paul Mitchell could soon pave way for some outstanding players to the English Premier League.

The tournament, which began with 13 teams, is now down to the final four. Nigeria's Flying Eagles are among the semifinalists and are set to face host nation Egypt in the third-place match after falling to South Africa in the semis.

title: Five Principle NFF Must Adopt To Avoid Flying Eagles World Cup Failure
content:
The statistic of Nigeria’s Flying Eagles at the ongoing 2025 CAF U-20 Africa Cup of Nations in Egypt is not very impressive despite managed to qualify for the FIFA U-20 World Cup coming up in Chile this year after picked semi-final ticket.

From the five games played, the seven-time African champions recorded two wins, two draws, and one loss with zero goals aggregate, edging Tunisia 1-0 in their opener, drawing with Morocco (0-0) and Kenya (2-2), and advancing to the semifinals after a dramatic penalty shootout win over Senegal, following a goalless draw in extra time.

The team scored just three goals and conceded the same number from open play throughout the tournament, highlighting several areas that need urgent attention ahead of the World Cup this September.

1. Squad selection and in-depth

From the starting XI, only about six players in the truly stood out, while many substitutes failed to offer adequate competition or impact, raising concerns over overall team quality and selection integrity.

2. Midfield and Attack Overhaul

Without a comprehensive overhaul, the team risks underperforming on the global stage as the current team midfield and attacking units lack excellent creativities, control, and clinical finishing, making it difficult for the team to sustain pressure or capitalize on openings.

3. Poor attack to finish build-up works

While the team managed decent build-up play, the forwards consistently struggled with delivering decisive final passes to break down defenses which severely hampered their goal-scoring opportunities.

4. Lack of competiveness in the lead striker position

The team’s over-reliance on lone striker Kparobo Arierhi as they lack a strong alternative in the striking role left the attack predictable and ineffective. A more balanced and competitive forward line is essential.

5. Technical Crew Reinforcement and Structured Camping

To enhance team cohesion and tactical clarity, the NFF must initiate early preparations for the World Cup. An extended training camp will give coaches the time to integrate new players, fine-tune strategies, and build a more synchronized squad.

More also, the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) should consider appointing an experienced technical adviser to support or restructure the current bench as the current coaching staffs tactical approach was often questionable throughout the tournament in-game management and strategic adaptability.

title: Tolu Arokodare Dedicates Latest Award To Nigerians
content:
The Super Eagles and KRC Genk forward, Tolu Arokodare who won the 34th Ebony Shoe award for 2025 has dedicated the award to Nigerians.

Tolu Arokodare was able to clinch the prize after an impressive season, netting 20 league goals for the Belgian side over the last five nominees which comprises teammate Zakaria El Ouahdi, Noah Sadiki of Union SG, Nigeria international Raphael Onyedika of Club Brugge, and Canada-born Nigerian striker Promise David who plays for Union SG.

Reflecting on the honour, Arokodare acknowledged the stiff competition and expressed pride in his achievement.

“There were a lot of good players nominated, so to come out as the winner is special. I’m proud of myself, the club, my family, my friends, and the Genk fans. This is not just for me—it’s for Nigerians too,” he said.

Ebony Shoe award is an award for best player of African descent in the Belgian Jupiler Pro League given annually.

title: Three Referees Banned For Life Over Match-Fixing
content:
The Rwanda Football Federation (FERWAFA) has issued lifetime bans to referees Amida Hemedi, Ally Uwimana, and Djihadi Mbarute for their alleged involvement in match-fixing activities within the domestic football league.

The trio reportedly conspired to manipulate matches in the Rwanda Premier League on multiple occasions.

Amida Hemedi is believed to be the ringleader behind the scandal and has been identified as the central figure coordinating these illicit activities, which are in direct violation of football regulations and was stripped of her FERWAFA refereeing credentials.

Ally Uwimana was penalized for allegedly encouraging fellow referees to place bets on matches they were officiating, while Djihadi Mbarute is accused of acting as an intermediary, receiving payments from individuals looking to influence match outcomes.

"Based on the decision of the refereeing commission meeting held on December 16, 2024, which found you guilty of misconduct incompatible with the values of refereeing — specifically your role in connecting referees with individuals involved in match-fixing — I am writing to inform you that you are hereby dismissed as a FERWAFA referee effective immediately," FERWAFA Secretary-General Adolphe Kalisa stated.

title: South-East PDP Caucus Threaten The Party If Ever Snub Their Son Again
content:
The Peoples Democratic Party crisis worsens on Wednesday as the South-East Zonal Caucus in a communiqué read by Zonal Chairman, Chief Ali Odefa, after the Zonal Executive Committee meeting held at the Government House in Enugu threaten mass defection should the party continue to rebuff its nomination of Sunday Udeh-Okoye as National Secretary.

The leadership tussle over the National Secretary position began after the 2023 general elections and escalated in December 2024 when a lower court and the South-East PDP caucus named former National Youth Leader, Sunday Udeh-Okoye, to the post which was initially accepted by the PDP governors, BoT, and National Working Committee before later directed the South-East to nominate a new candidate and endorsed Setonji Koshoedo as acting National Secretary on April 14 and ratified by the NWC at it 600th meeting on April 29.

However, the South-East remains adamant, maintaining that Udeh-Okoye is the rightful occupant of the position.

Reading the caucus communiqué, Odefa stated: “The South-East ZEC exhaustively deliberated on the directive of the NWC and came to the conclusion that it offered a sure pathway to peace, unity, stability, and progress of our party. Consequently, the ZEC unanimously recommended Hon. Sunday Udeh-Okoye as the candidate to complete the term of office of the National Secretary.

“The South-East has consistently served as a stronghold of the PDP from inception. In PDP’s near three-decade existence, we have given our loyalty and all to the party.

“Currently, while the party has been losing key members post-2023 general elections, the South-East PDP is at the vanguard of strengthening the party by rallying major opposition figures such as in Enugu, where the Labour Party gubernatorial candidate, two LP House of Reps members, and numerous Assembly members have joined the PDP.

“We hope that this time, the position of the South-East PDP regarding the Office of the National Secretary is accorded the honour and immediacy it deserves. Otherwise, the South-East PDP, as a family, will be compelled to reconsider our relationship with the PDP going forward.”

title: Benue State Scouting Project Finale Set to Hold Later this Month
content:
The grand finale of Benue state scouting project which is a grassroot football project aimed at discovering raw football talents within the state by offering them a seamless platform to play professional football locally and internationally, has now been scheduled to commence from Monday, the 26th to Friday the 30th May 2025. 


The project which kicked started in May 2024 with a zonal screening of players in the 3 senatorial zones of Benue state including players from the camp of Internally Displaced People (IDP), recorded about 120 players, who had been camped at the Aper Aku transit camp, since November 2024. These players had the privilege of being trained by Nigerian Born Ex-England international player who also played for FC Wimbledon, Norwich City and Aston Villa, Ambassador John Fashanu and took the players through the elimination process.


The organisers Ontrade Solid concept limited, in partnership with Zalen foundation, and the ministry of Humanitarian and Disaster Management, the organizers commended and praised His Excellency, the executive Governor of Benue state Rev Fr Dr Hyacinth Alia for endorsing this laudable initiative through the Deputy Governor Barr Sam Ode, alongside the commissioner for Humanitarian Hon Ephraim Kunde.


The convener Helen Aisha Ogenyi acknowledged the enormous support of the majority leader of the Benue state House of Assembly Hon Tiseer Sateer, for his dogged support in ensuring the project Sees the light and achieve its desired result. His strong believe for grassroot sport and unwavering passion for this displaced people were his driving force. From the media desk, the Director General Radio Benue Mr Teeseer Mnzulugha also showed his massive support by ensuring the project get the needed publicity, similarly the organizers also acknowledged the tremendous support from the Executive Secretary of Benue state Emergency Agency Dr sir James Iorpuu for supporting the boys with palliative and also granting them access to the camp to carry out their activities 


The convener, has also acknowledged the partnership of Ann Ogoza Ugye ,the Executive Director zalen foundation for her enormous support in creating zalen fc the first IDP football club aimed at discovering and promoting raw football talents in the camp 


The grand finale will feature European giant Milan Martinovic, a FIFA player agent, agent of former Chelsea player and goalkeeper Peter cezh. Mr Martinovic is an attorney of law with over 25 years in practice. He is also the current special Adviser to the minister of sports in the kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Mr Milan Martinovic will be coming to select players from the grand finale to play professionally in Europe.


Similarly, the project coordinator Mr Franklyn Imonah, a Sport consultant and journalist of over 9years experience has concluded arrangements with some top Nigerian clubs in the Nigeria Premier Football League (NPFL), Nigeria Nationwide League(NNL) AND Nigeria Youth League (NYL) and other football academics to absorb the players who would not make it to Europe. As a seasoned football agent affiliated with over seven(7) international clubs, currently, he is making progressive arrangements to get some of the players to play in Egypt, South Africa, Serbia, France, Cyprus and China as clubs are currently waiting to receive them.


The organizers assured the players that "none of them will be left behind or return back to their local clubs or IDP camp" as they are working round the clock to see that their future is secured through sport.


Recently, the project got endorsement from the Managing Director Benue investment and property company and Benue state chapter of the Sport writers Association of Nigeria SWAN. 


The organizers are happy that the event is coming at the time His Excellency who is a passionate lover of football will be marking his 2nd year in office. He will be gracing the event as a show of love and support towards his children.

title: Awoniyi Abdominal Injury Raises Concerns Over 'Late Flag' Offside Law
content:
The injury suffered by Taiwo Awoniyi during Nottingham Forest’s 2-2 draw with Leicester City on Sunday when collided with the post in the 88th minute as he attempted to get on the end of a cross from Anthony Elanga has raised questions about the future of the offside law.

During the incident a replays showed Elanga was offside in the build-up.

A new protocol on offside was introduced by the International Football Association Board (IFAB) for the 2020-21 Premier League season following the introduction of the video assistant referee (VAR).

While the law did not change, assistant referees were told to keep their flag down if they felt there was an immediate scoring opportunity until the outcome - either a goal or possession of the ball by the defence.

This is to ensure where the assistant referee makes an error on an offside decision, it doesn't impact on the goal being ruled out incorrectly. “Sadly, this practice does expose players to risks," former Premier League referee Keith Hackett told BBC Radio 5 Live.

Former England women's midfielder Fara Williams also called for reviewed of the law.

"When it is marginal, then I get it. When an offside is so clear and obvious, I think it is the duty of the assistant referee to put their flag up and stop play.

"In this scenario it happened on the halfway line. This has been a time bomb waiting to go off in terms of someone getting seriously injured. Awoniyi got that horrific injury because of it.

"I am totally against it and I feel most players are as well. It is a rule that nobody likes and I am sure it will be assessed in the summer," Williams said.

title: Awoniyi Out Of Coma, Underwent Second Surgery
content:
The 27-year-old Nigeria international and Nottingham Forest forward, Taiwo Awoniyi who was  in an induced coma on Monday after having first emergency surgery done on a serious abdominal injury has woken up and underwent the second stage of the operation, including closing the wound, on Wednesday – a process that was successful.

He spent Tuesday in an induced coma as medical staff monitored his progress as part of the procedure.

Awoniyi sustained the injury during Nottingham Forest’s 2-2 draw with Leicester City on Sunday when collided with the post in the 88th minute as he attempted to get on the end of a cross from Anthony Elanga.

He sustained a ruptured intestine in the incident but responding very well to the treatment as he had the second stage of the operation including closing the wound done on Wednesday.

Awoniyi received lengthy medical attention on the pitch after the collision, and he appeared to inform medics that he could continue, but soon became clear he was still feeling the effects of the collision while on the field.

Speaking to BBC Sport, consultant colorectal surgeon Professor Gillian Tierney said injuries similar to the one suffered by Awoniyi can be fatal.

"The injury is really serious. It is potentially life-threatening. It is very easy to miss at the point of contact and can take hours to diagnose.

"In a hospital setting we would send a patient for a CT scan which could take up to 10 hours.

"If it occurred to an athlete who was super fit, very muscular and was running on adrenaline then I think it would be extremely understandable to miss it. Fluid leaking from the intestine would not be easy to diagnose straight away.

"Surgery is usually required and the stomach would be opened up. The mortality stat is 9%. So if an athlete - who went through the procedure - was really fit, they would stand a good chance of being OK.

"It would be different if the operation occurred for an 80-year-old, who has other health issues," said Tierney.

On his part, Mr Harpaul Flora, consultant vascular and general surgeon at The London Clinic, said ruptured intestines are "a pretty rare injury. It's either a compression of the abdominal wall which has led to tearing and liquid seeping out - or the tear of an artery.

"Neither of those would be able to be diagnosed without a scan, there may have been bruising.

"It can be life-threatening. If it wasn't treated by a hospital it can give you an infection. It could then lead to sepsis, which is a life-threatening consequence.”

title: CAF U20 AFCON: Semifinal Kick off Time, Date, Venue Of Nigeria Vs South Africa
content:
The Flying Eagles of Nigeria will go head-to-head with South Africa in the semi-finals of the TotalEnergies CAF U-20 Africa Cup of Nations Egypt 2025, as both nations continue their pursuit of continental success after qualifying for the FIFA U-20 World Cup.

In the quarter-final, the seven-time African champions, Flying Eagles booked their place in the semifinals through a 3-1 victory over Senegal in a penalty shootout after the match ended goalless in extra time. While their semifinal opponents, South Africa, edged past DR Congo with 1-0.

The semi-final is expected to be tightly contested, with set-piece opportunities and bench contributions likely to influence the outcome. Nigeria’s flexibility and mental toughness—evident in their victory over Senegal—could give them a slight edge.

As the two nations prepare for a high-stakes clash, Nigeria will look to enhance their storied U-20 AFCON legacy, while South Africa seeks to carve out a significant achievement of their own.

The Flying Eagle standout midfielder, Suleiman Alabi, has sent a message of intent to upcoming opponents South Africa, expressed his delight and made it clear that the team’s eyes are now firmly on the continental title.

“I’m very happy with the win, qualifying for the World Cup is a dream comes true for me. Now, our focus is on the remaining matches — we’re determined to win the AFCON,” Alabi said.

The semi-final match will take place at Suez Canal Stadium in Ismailia on Thursday, May 15, at exactly 4 PM (Nigerian Time) and 6:00 pm local time. 

Nigeria, South Africa, Morocco and Egypt have qualified to represent Africa at the 2025 FIFA U20 World Cup in Chile.

title: Flying Eagles Hit Training Ground On Wednesday in preparation for Semifinal against South Africa
content:
The Nigeria U-20 national team, Flying Eagles, will hold their first training session today, Wednesday evening as they prepared for semi-final show against South Africa on Thursday.

The team will undergo a recovery and tactical training session at 6:00 p.m. local time (4:00 p.m. Nigerian time) at Ismailia, Egypt.

In the quarter-final, the seven-time African champions, Flying Eagles booked their place in the semifinals through a 3-1 victory over Senegal in a penalty shootout after the match ended goalless in extra time. While their semifinal opponents, South Africa, edged past DR Congo with 1-0.

Other semifinal on same Thursday is the hosts Egypt vs Morocco.

title: Nigeria And Nottingham Forest Striker Taiwo Awoniyi In Coma After First Phase Of Abdominal Surgery
content:
Nottingham Forest and Super Eagle forward, Taiwo Awoniyi is in an induced coma after having first emergency surgery on a serious abdominal injury.

The 27-year-old Nigeria international sustained the injury during Nottingham Forest’s 2-2 draw with Leicester City on Sunday when collided with the post in the 88th minute as he attempted to get on the end of a cross from Anthony Elanga.

The incident led to an on-pitch discussion between Forest owner Evangelos Marinakis and Nuno Espirito Santo as the former was left furious with how the medical staff’s handled the injury.

Awoniyi was then taken straight to hospital for the surgery after the accident, had surgery done on Monday night and remains in hospital, with the rest of the procedure set to be completed on Wednesday.

In a statement earlier on Tuesday, Nottingham Forest officially confirmed that Nigerian forward Taiwo Awoniyi has successfully undergone surgery.

“The club can confirm that Taiwo Awoniyi has had urgent surgery following the abdominal injury sustained during Sunday’s match against Leicester City. Everyone at Nottingham Forest sends their best wishes to Taiwo.

“Awoniyi's injury was a powerful reminder of the physical risks in the game and why a player's health and wellbeing must always come first. We will provide further updates when appropriate,” the statement read.

title: Egypt 2025:  We Aim For Trophy! Zubairu Promises More Composed Flying Eagles Against South Africa
content:
Flying Eagle Coach, Aliyu Zubairu has assured that Nigeria's U20 squad will perform even better when they face South Africa's Amajita in the first semi-final of the ongoing CAF U20 Cup of Nations in Ismailia on Thursday evening.

Pundits have praised the seven-time champions for dominating their challenging quarter-final match against Senegal at the same venue on Monday, where they eliminated the Cup holders with a 3-1 victory in a penalty shootout.

“I believe we are going to have a great semi-final against the South Africans. I can guarantee that our approach will be much better since the anxiety regarding our FIFA World Cup qualification is no longer an issue. It was a tense 120 minutes for both our team and the defending champions on Monday.

“We now have the World Cup ticket and are quite happy about it. Against South Africa, we will play with great determination and composure as we aim for the trophy, without the tense atmosphere we faced in the last match. Of course, we are aware of the rivalry between Nigeria and South Africa and what this match means; we will prepare for a real battle," Zubairu said.

Nigeria stopped Senegal 3-1 on penalties after both teams played out a scoreless draw in 120 minutes of action at the Suez Canal Stadium in Ismailia Monday afternoon securing qualification for the FIFA U20 World Cup ticket in the process..

“This is a big win for Nigeria, but we are not celebrating yet. We came here with a goal — to qualify for the World Cup and challenge for the title. One box is ticked, now we keep pushing.

“We can all see that the team has been progressing and getting better with each match. We will go all out against the South Africans,” he added.

In addition to their seven titles, Nigeria has finished as runners-up on two occasions (1999 and 2007) and won bronze medals twice (2009 and 2013).

title: Move Now - Amokachi Urges Osimhen To Consider Premier League, State Reasons
content:
The Super Eagle Striker, Victor Osimhen who is currently trading on loan at Turkish Super Lig champions Galatasaray from Napoli has attract a lot of top tier clubs across Europe, includes Premiership due to his excellent performances in the ongoing season.

In Galatasaray, the 26-year-old has further underlined his status as one of the best strikers in the world by registering 33 goals and eight assists in 38 appearances across all competitions for the Yellow and Reds.

Former Nigerian international, Daniel Amokachi, could not stay salient as he charges his compatriot to consider a move to England, joining a Premier League team.

“It would be nice to see him (Osimhen) play in the best league in the world—the EPL—because any league that Osimhen plays in, he would flourish, no doubt about that.

“He has the quality in him; he has the warrior in him. He is a player that any club in the world would love to have,” he said.

title: Super Eagles Arokodare Won 2025 Ebony Shoe Award In Belgium
content:
Out of the final five nominees, the Super Eagles and KRC Genk forward, Tolu Arokodare has won the 34th Ebony Shoe award for 2025.

The award which was presented during the gala of the African Awards 2025 at the Tangla Hotel in Brussels on Monday is for best player of African descent in the Belgian Jupiler Pro League given annually.

The final five nominees were Tolu Arokodare, and Zakaria El Ouahdi of KRC Genk, Noah Sadiki of Union SG, Nigeria international Raphael Onyedika of Club Brugge, and Canada-born Nigerian striker Promise David who plays for Union SG.

After switch from French Amiens SC to KRC Genk in January 2023 he has scores 20 goals and six assists in the Jupiler Pro League this season with a chance to become top scorer in the remaining two matches of the season.

Other Nigerians who have won the award are Daniel Amokachi (1992, 1994), Victor Ikpeba (1993), Godwin Okpara (1995) and Celestine Babayaro (1996) and Paul Onuachu (2021).

title: China Seeks Better Collaboration With National Sports Commission After Denied Nigerian Athletes Visa
content:
The Chinese Government has intensified bilateral relationships with the Nigerian Government through the National Sports Commission, NSC, following the visa glitch that led to Team Nigeria withdrawing from the World relays in Guangzhou, China.

On May 8, the NSC announced that Nigeria would miss the 2025 World Athletics Relays in Guangzhou, China, due to visa complications.

The commission said the Chinese consulate in Nigeria failed to issue visas to seven Nigerian athletes based in the US to participate in the 2025 World Athletics Relays, the incident that Chinese embassy describes an “accident”.

Yang Jian Xing, the Chinese Culture Counselor during a diplomatic visit to the leadership of the National Sports Commission (NSC) on Tuesday expressed regrets over the visa challenges that prompted Nigeria to withdraw from the World relays and pledged China's commitments to the country's vision for Sports Development.

"I want to describe what has happened as an accident and we are sorry and we regret it in its entirety. We are here to let the Sports Commission know that the Chinese Government holds Nigeria of high esteem".

"We are open to better collaboration with the National Sports Commission to boost diplomatic ties of both China and Nigeria in terms of Sports Training and Exchange programs".

"Once again I want to assure you that from next time we will try our best for this not to repeat itself again and we will also like to create a special channel for a China and Nigeria Sports Communication", he added.

Chairman of the National Sports Commission, NSC, Mallam Shehu Dikko, said the Commission has accepted the gestures of regrets by the Chinese Government and are ready to foster better collaboration for the future.

"We are very happy to receive officials from the Chinese Embassy in our office today and it shows the Chinese Government genuine disappointment for what happened which for us is a huge sign of better things to come between both countries especially in Sports".

"We should at all times try to create positives out of things like this and we are happy that this has further strengthened our relationship with the Chinese Embassy".

The Director General of the NSC Hon. Bukola Olopade reiterated the Commission's desire to build stronger sporting ties with China and allowed the incident of the visa glitch to serve as a springboard to a robust working relationship.

"Your humility and diplomacy is the best I have seen anywhere and I am very grateful that you best described the incident between the AFN, the Commission and your embassy as an accident and we have all agreed to take it as such and move forward to better things".

"I want to thank you for everything and for the request for exchange programs and training for our media and Sports men and women. This is truly worthy of note. We are looking forward to a bigger and better relationship between Nigeria and China", he concluded.

title: Official: Brazil Announce Carlo Ancelotti AS The New Head Coach
content:
After months of speculation, the Brazil’s men’s national football team get the first foreign national manager to take charge of the world’s most successful side since 1925 as they announced Carlo Ancelotti officially as the head coach.

The deal was finalized after amicable negotiations involving the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF), with Diego Fernandes playing a key role in facilitating the agreement.

The Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) announced the news in a statement on Monday, welcoming Ancelotti, a man they described as a “legend” of the game, and expressing excitement about “a new era of success” under his leadership.

“This landmark moment sees the coming together of two icons – the only five-time Fifa World Cup champions and a coach with an unmatched record across Europe’s elite competitions.

“The CBF extends its sincere gratitude to Real Madrid and [president] Mr [Florentino] Pérez for the cordiality and sportsmanship shown in facilitating the coach’s release during his contract term, allowing this new chapter to begin with mutual respect and cooperation between the teams,” the statement read.

Ancelotti, 65, had one year remaining on his contract with Real Madrid, but all parties reached a consensus to allow him to begin his new position ahead of Brazil’s next round of World Cup qualifiers on May 26 after his final match with Real Madrid against Real Sociedad in La Liga.

He will oversee the team’s campaign for the 2026 World Cup, which will be held across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, with the goal of securing Brazil’s sixth title.

The Italian manager will succeed Dorival Junior, who was dismissed in March after 14 months in charge. Ancelotti’s first match at the helm will be a qualifier against Ecuador on June 6.

title: NSC Announce Organizing Committee For 3rd African U18/U20 Athletics Championships
content:
The National Sports Commission (NSC) has officially constituted the Local Organising Committee (LOC) for the 3rd combined African U18/U20 Athletics Championships, scheduled to hold from July 16 to 20, 2025, in Abeokuta, Ogun State.

The LOC comprises fifteen distinguished professionals with proven expertise in sports administration and corporate affairs. Their appointment underscores the Commission’s commitment to delivering a world-class championship that meets global standards.

The African U18/U20 Athletics Championship is a premier continental event that brings together over 500 junior athletes from across Africa. With participation expected from 53 countries, the championship is a major event in the African athletics calendar.

Director General of the NSC, Hon. Bukola Olopade, will serve as Chairman of the Organising Committee, while the Ogun State Commissioner for Sports, Hon. Wasiu Isiaka, has been appointed Vice Chairman.

According to Hon. Olopade, hosting the 3rd edition of this prestigious biennial championship reflects the new direction of sports under the leadership of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, positioning Nigeria as a destination for international sporting events.

“This speaks to the sports economy, this speaks to hospitality, this speaks to wealth creation and this speaks to infrastructure development.”

Hon. Olopade further attributed the successful bid to host the championship to the availability of world-class sports infrastructure in Ogun State. The state’s MKO Abiola International Stadium, upgraded for the Gateway Games, was a key factor in securing the hosting rights.

“The Sports facilities in Abeokuta are world class and hosting the U18/U20 African Championship is one of the benefits of hosting the National Sports Festival and I must once again thank the Governor of Ogun State, Dapo Abiodun, for his Sporting Vision,” he added.
