Mr. Dele Oyewale, the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) Head of Media and Publicity in a statement on Wednesday has stated that the agency has  arrests 10 officers over the alleged theft of operational items they could not account for as directed by the Executive Chairman, Ola Olukoyede.

“Ten officers of the Lagos Zonal Command of the EFCC are currently being detained in connection with the investigation of some missing operational items involving them.

“These officers, who were arrested last week on the directives of the Executive Chairman, Mr. Ola Olukoyede, are being questioned over the theft of items they could not account for.

“Investigators are making significant progress, and those found guilty will be subjected to internal disciplinary processes.

“Their detention was part of ongoing efforts to rid the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission of corrupt practices,” Oyewale said.

A source, who spoke on condition of anonymity disclosed stoles items has he said, “The operatives stole foreign currency, gold, and other exhibits when broke into the exhibit room.”

This is not the first measure taken under the leadership of the agency Chairman, Mr. Ola Olukoyede to rid off the organization bad eggs. Just some days ago the EFCC disclosed the dismissal of 27 personnel for involvement in fraudulent activities.

title: Condition Eric Chelle Must Meet Before Be In Charge Of Super Eagles At 2025 AFCON
content:
Apart from the mix-feeling that trails the appointment of the new Super Eagles Coach, Éric Chelle by the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF), there is required condition for the Malian former national team coach to meet before he can be in charge of the Super Eagles when the 2025 African Nations Cup Kicks off in Morocco.

Chelle's short term contract agreement with the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) may not be extended if he fails to qualify Nigeria for the 2026 FIFA World schedule for USA, Canada and Mexico, despite being in a difficult situation of Group C qualification table.

The short term contract will end in October 2025, same month the 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifier ends. And if fail to qualify the Nigeria National Team for the FIFA World Cup, he may not be in charge of the Team  at Morocco 2025 African Nations Cup.

The 2025 AFCON will begin on 21 December 2025 and run until 18 January 2026, that is two months after the conclusion of 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifier.

The table leader got automatic ticket, while others will face play-off before qualify. Nigeria is 5th on the Group C log with three points from four matches that has Rwanda as table topper, South Africa in second, Benin Republic is third with seven points apiece. While Lesotho is fourth with five points.

title: Transfer: Ola Aina To Manchester City?
content:
Manchester City, according to reports from GiveMeSport is evaluating whether to make a bid for the Nottingham Forest and the Super Eagles defender, Ola Aina before the transfer deadline in early February as a potential replacement for Kyle Walker, whose performance has declined during the current season.

Aina is currently engaged in contract negotiations with Nottingham Forest. Meaning, a transfer fee will need to be agreed upon with the club if City who is reportedly planning to gauge his interest before submitting any formal offers can successfully sign him this month.

At the moment, City sits below Forest in the Premier League table, trailing by six points with more than half the season remaining.

title: Nigeria Football Federation Revealed Amount The New Super Eagles Coach, Eric Will Receive Monthly
content:
Eric Chelle, the former coach of Mali’s senior men’s national team, and the newly hired Super Eagles Coach by the Executive Committee of the NFF following the recommendation of Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) Technical and Development Sub-Committee during a meeting held in Abuja on Thursday, 2nd January 2025, which was later endorsed on Tuesday, 7th January has reported to receive $55,000 equivalent of N84,984,900.00 as monthly salary.

The new Super Eagles Coach expected to arrive in Nigeria on Saturday with two assistants and to be unveiled next Monday in Abuja according to NFF. The two assistants will collect $5,000 per month while the Head Coach, Eric pockets $50,000 every month.

Chelle is expected to begin his tenure with the home-based Eagles ahead of the Championship of African Nations (CHAN) commencing from 1st February, 2025, taking place in Tanzania, Kenya and Uganda. But primary objective is to guide the Super Eagles to secure a spot in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, with key qualifying matches scheduled for March.

title: Pandemonium in Mali as Government frowns at its FA over signing of Chelle as Super Eagles New Coach
content:
Even as the appointment of Eric Chelle by the Nigeria Football Federation is still generating mixed reactions from Nigerians, the former Mali coach appointment seems to have put the Malian Football Federation in serious problems with the Military Government of the Country.

While many Nigerians have not fully come to terms with the quality of the French born Coach , it just seems those who know his qualities are already biting their fingers for not holding on to him.

In Mali as we speak , Football fans in the country are bashing the Malian FA after the news broke that the NFF had signed their Former Coach .

When Eric Chelle left the Malian team after the 2024 AFCON, for many Malians and even the Malian players, it was a shock and a big mistake to have allowed him

 to leave.

In Eric Chelle's two year stint in Mali, his Team played one of the best attacking football any Malian national team has ever played. And his results were very visible for everyone to see on the continent with 14 wins , 5 draws and just 3 losses in his 22 games in charge.

He was on the verge of leading Mali to a semi-final place in the last AFCON before losing narrowly to the eventual winner ,the host, the Ivory Coast in the Quarter finals in Extra time.

This was why an average football fan in Mali loves him so much and still found it absurd that he was allowed to go in the manner in which he left.

It was later that Malians discovered that the reason why he left was because the FA were tired of his toughness and none interference principle when it comes to manipulations and selection of players.

Many top football people in the Malian FA never liked him for this and this was why when the Malian FA announced his departure, the Malian Government persuaded him to come back but he was very reluctant to go back .

And now that the biggest black Nation in Africa , Nigeria appointed him , the reality of the mistake of letting him go last year , just suddenly dawn on the Malian Government once again.

Unfortunately it is too late now because it has been a long term ambition of Eric Chelle to manage the Nigeria Super Eagles which he strongly believes have the best players and talents on the continent to dominate the AFCON and even make history at the World cup.

title: Home Based Super Eagles Will Camp Abroad For 2025 CHAN Preparations - NFF
content:
The Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) President, Ibrahim Gusau said the home based Eagles will have a foreign camping and quality friendly matches before moving to the venue of the 2025 Championship of African Nations Cup.

Gusau said the federation is very much aware of their responsibilities to prepared the Super Eagles B ahead and give them all support they deserve for great performance at the 2025 CHAN schedule for Tanzania, Kenya and Uganda, begins on 1st February, 2025.

"We deliberately want them to have a place where they can be fully camped and settled without any distraction and then where they are going to spend about two weeks there from there we look for a venue that they will have a foreign camping where they okay quality friendly matches before moving to the venue of the tournament.

"So we are very much aware of our responsibilities and will give them the preparations they deserve,” He said.

title: Malian, Chelle, Take Over Home Based Eagles From Indigenous Coach After Qualify Them For 2025 CHAN
content:
The president of Nigeria Football Federation, Ibrahim Gusau has confirm that the newly appointed Super Eagles Coach, Eric Chelle will take over Super Eagles B team  from  Head Coach, Daniel Ogunmodede, after the later qualify them for 2025 CHAN scheduled for Tanzania, Kenya and Uganda

The Nigeria's home-based Eagles after a massive victory with a 3-1 over rival Ghana some weeks ago at the Godswill Akpabio Stadium in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, qualified for the 2025 Championship of African Nations competition.

Gusau stated that Chelle will take charge of the Home-Based Super Eagles ahead of the competition which begins on 1st of February, 2025, so as to give him the opportunity to see quality home based players to be invited and injected into the main Super Eagles team.

"We (NFF) came up with a policy that whoever emerges as Super Eagles Coach will manage the Home based Eagles. 

"You can not be given the opportunity to manage a team comprising of home based players and tell us you can't get one or two players that can be injected into the senior national team. We saw what happened in the last match we played against Ghana for them to qualify for the CHAN finals. A lot of people look at it that there's hope in Nigeria football because we saw Nigerian spirits especially in the last matches in Ghana and Uyo," Gusau told NFF TV

The NFF had announced the appointment of Chelle, a former coach of Mali’s senior men’s national team, expected to assume his duties with immediate effect, on the endorsement of NFF Technical and Development Sub-Committee recommendation by the the Executive Committee of the NFF during a meeting held in Abuja on Thursday, 2nd January 2025, which was later ratified on Tuesday, 7th January.

His first assignment is to resume with the Home based Super Eagles who would be participating in the 2025 Championship of African Nations Cup (CHAN) schedule to begins on 1st February, 2025.

title: NFF Confirms Super Eagles New Head Coach - Details Of His Profile
content:
Following the recommendation of Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) Technical and Development Sub-Committee, the Executive Committee of the NFF has approved the appointment of Mr. Éric Sékou Chelle to be the Head Coach of Super Eagles, the Nigeria’s senior men national football team.

Recall that, last week the official of the Nigeria Football Federation confirmed that the new coach for Super Eagles will be announced soon. Probably, this January. Stating that nothing will stop them (NFF) from unveiling a coach for the Super Eagles this month. “We have to take a decision for a coach to be named this month because he has to first of all familiarize himself with the players following tough assignment ahead of him," a top official said.

Chelle, a former coach of Mali’s senior men’s national team, will assume his duties as the Super Eagles Head Coach with immediate effect, base on the endorsement of NFF Technical and Development Sub-Committee recommendation by the the Executive Committee of the NFF during a meeting held in Abuja on Thursday, 2nd January 2025, which was later endorsed on Tuesday, 7th January.

Chelle, the Head Coach for the Aiglons of Mali since 2022 came very close to a place in the semi-finals, before loss to hosts and the eventual winners Cote d’Ivoire 2-1 at extra time, after leading by a lone goal until the final minute of regulation time at the last 2023 Africa Cup of Nations finals in Cote d’Ivoire.

The 47-year-old, born on November 11, 1977, is of Ivorian, French, and Malian heritage, featured for Martigues, Valenciennes, Lens, Istres and Chamois Niortais in France during his playing career, and had coached clubs such as GS Consolat, FC Martigues, Boulogne and MC Oran.

His primary objective is to guide the Super Eagles to secure a spot in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, with key qualifying matches scheduled for March.

title: FCT Sports Council Deputy Director inducted Into The Wall of Fame
content:
The Federal Capital Territory Sports Council Deputy Director, Iyiola Ogundele, has been inducted into the Ex-University of Ibadan Footballers Association Wall of Fame during their Annual Reunion Ceremony held recently at the University.

Ogundele, a skilled goalkeeper, was a member of the 1990 University of Ibadan football team that won the soccer gold medal at the NUGA games in University of Calabar, the only soccer gold medal the university has ever won. And also represented Nigeria at the World University Games in Sheffield, England (1991), playing up to the quarterfinals.

The current FCT Deputy Director of Sports had played for Nitel Ilorin, ISO Glass FC Ibadan, and NEPA FC Lagos, Doyin Babes Ilorin, and NEPA Umuahia before joined the Federal Capital Territory Authority as a Sports Officer in 1997.

title: Chikere assumes office as Executive Director, Edo Sports Commission
content:
As Edo State officially kick-starts the 2025 working year in full fledge, Mrs Sabina Chikere made a historic return to the Edo State Sports Commission on Monday, 6th January, 2025, resuming her role as Executive Director

Sabina was on the 18th of December, 2024, appointed by the Governor of Edo State, Senator Monday Okpebholo, to steer the Operational and Sports Development affairs of the state.

As the former Permanent Secretary of the commission, Sabina brings a wealth of experience and expertise to the table. Her appointment as Executive Director makes her second-in-command to the Executive Chairman, Honourable Desmond Enabulele.

Hon. Enabulele warmly welcomed Mrs Sabina back to the commission, and although her office is still being prepared, he assured that the facilities’ department is working out a comfortable and well-equipped space for her.

The new office will have all the necessary amenities, reflecting her important role in overseeing Operations and Sports Development as stipulated by the Commission's Act and in line with world's best practices.

Mama Bendel's as popularly called impressive track record speaks for itself. As General Coordinator and Permanent Secretary of Sports under former Governor Godwin Obaseki, Mrs Sabina drove significant development and achieved numerous successes.

Her no-nonsense approach and dedication to excellence have earned her the nickname, “The Working One."

With her expertise and experience, Mrs Sabina is expected to play a pivotal role in revitalizing the nosediving sports in the state 

The commission's board members, including Edo North representative, Hon. Frank Ilaboya; Edo South representative, Baldwin Bazuaye; and Edo Central representative, Odianose Anthony Ikuenobe, Esq., are expected to provide their full support to Mrs Sabina and Hon. Enabulele.

With this strong team in place, the Edo State Sports Commission is poised for a bright and successful future.

title: APC, Obidients engaged in a war of words over alleges threat to life
content:
The ruling All Progressives Congress and supporters of the Labour Party presidential candidate in the 2023 election, Peter Obi, engaged themselves in a war of words following the Sunday’s interview on Arise Television, where the National Publicity Secretary of the APC, Felix Morka, claimed that the former Anambra governor had “crossed the line” in his recent criticism of President Bola Tinubu’s administration, the phrase Obi supporter claims is threat to the life .

Mr. Morka on the program said: “Mr Obi is shooting from the hip. He is not looking or taking an aim. He just shoots widely like the Wild Wild West movies we used to see back in the day. He is absolutely irrational in his thinking about a man who was governor for eight years and left nothing to remember in Anambra State by way of legacy.

“Now that he didn’t win, he is sulking. Rather than get a perspective or figure out why he lost so he can do better in the future, he thinks he can bring down the government by simply being maliciously deceptive. That is wrong.

“I am not somebody to go on the offensive in that manner, but Mr Peter Obi has crossed the line so many times, and I think that at this point, he has come to him whatever he gets.”

Reacting in an exclusive interview with The PUNCH, the National Coordinator of the Obidient Movement, Yunusa Tanko, made know their stands with Obi, challenge the APC to make counter allegation to the issues they were raising with facts if available instead of threat.

“That is a threat. If they make the move (to arrest Obi), it will boomerang on their government. In a democratic setting, Obi did not in any way impugn anybody’s integrity, nor did he cross any line. We are not making any false allegations.

“But if they threaten anybody with some level of impunity, believe me, the Nigerian people will react negatively to them. They must learn to accept it. If they have a counter-allegation to the issues we are raising, they should be provided with facts.

“Obi only spoke to the issue that concerns every Nigerian, which he has a right to. So, what this simply means is that what we have been accusing them of, gagging, arresting and then maiming people to the level of intimidation and impunity, is what they are planning to administer on Nigerians starting from this January just because people have spoken against bad governance.

“We stand firmly with Peter Obi and his vision for a just, equitable and prosperous Nigeria. We call on Nigerians to resist this slide into authoritarianism by continuing to demand accountability, justice and the protection of democratic values. Finally, we urge the security services to not sweep such threats under the carpet as they had done in previous times but engage Mr Morka to elucidate on his utterance.

“Furthermore, the ruling party called to order their mouthpiece and members at large to desist from actions that could heat up the polity. In addition, the government of the day should foster an environment of noble ideas to shape our national discourse and not threats. They must be seen to be tolerant of criticism.

“The level of impunity and attack they put on the previous government of the PDP was worse than this and they are getting less of that criticism in their own government. So, criticising them is a way of uplifting the standards of our democracy. We Nigerians have the right as covered under the constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, to speak to issues,” he said.

title: EFCC Confirm dismissal of 27 officers for violates the agency codes and conduct
content:
The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) spokesman, Dele Oyewale, in a statement on Monday, said the anti-graft agency sacks 27 of its corrupt staffs last year 2024. According to him, the dismissed officers followed recommendations from the EFCC Staff Disciplinary Committee who indicted them for misconduct and fraudulent activities, after been ratified by the EFCC Chairman, Ola Olukoyede.

“In its quest to enforce integrity and rid its fold of fraudulent elements, the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission dismissed 27 officers from its workforce in 2024.

“Their dismissal, following the recommendation of the Staff Disciplinary Committee of the EFCC, was ratified by the Executive Chairman, Ola Olukoyede.

“The core values of the commission remain sacrosanct and will always be upheld in combating corruption and ensuring accountability at all levels.

“The commission also wishes to alert the public to the sinister activities of impersonators and blackmailers using the name of its Executive Chairman to extort money from high-profile suspects being investigated by the EFCC,” the statement read.

Oyewale further emphasised that EFCC Chairman is a man of integrity who cannot be influenced by monetary offers.

“Olukoyede remains a man of integrity who cannot be swayed by monetary influences. The public is enjoined to report such disreputable elements to the commission.

“Suspects under investigation for economic and financial crimes, who have failed to compromise their investigators, often resort to blackmail. These blackmailers should not be given any attention,” he added.

The anti-graft agency also said it was investigating “a trending $400,000 claim of a yet-to-be-identified supposed staff of the EFCC against a Sectional Head.” Revealed that two members Ojobo Joshua and Aliyu Hashim, were recently arraigned before Justice Jude Onwuebuzie of the Federal Capital Territory High Court in Abuja for allegedly contacted a former Managing Director of the Nigerian Ports Authority, Mr. Mohammed Bello-Koko, demanding $1m to secure a “soft landing” in a non-existent investigation.

title: NYSC Exclusion: HND graduates protest against marginalization
content:
Following the exclusion of Full-time Higher National Diploma graduates who previously completed their part-time National Diploma in the registration for the National Youth Service Corps scheme (NYSC) second stream of Batch C mobilization which began on Monday, January 6, has triggered widely protest by the affected.

The affected graduates gathered at the NYSC secretariat in Lagos early Monday morning to voiced against the proposed exclusion, holding placards with messages like ‘Say No To Discrimination in NYSC’ and ‘Equal Rights for All,’ calling for their inclusion in the NYSC mobilization process.

One of the protesters, Majaro Temitope, Yaba College of Technology HND graduate who spoke on behalf of the graduates, fault the proposed exclusion.

“Many of us here did ND part-time and later switched to full-time HND. We were not told there is a policy that will deny us the opportunity to serve, despite the struggles we faced during our ND years.

“We’ve already written to the Director-General and JAMB about this matter. We just hope the Federal Government and Ministry of Education will review this unfair policy, especially since the registration has already started and we have yet to register,” Temitope said.

Responding to the protesters, the Lagos NYSC Coordinator, represented by Assistant Director, Ehimuenma Itohan, assured the protesters that their concerns has been duly noted and forwarded to the Director-General at the national headquarters for quick action.

“Your protest has been duly noted, and we have escalated your grievance to the highest level of management in NYSC. The Director-General is a father figure who deeply cares about the concerns of the youth, and I assure you that he will consider all aspects of the matter in line with the existing guidelines and policies,” Itohan said.

title: Coach Gets A Motorbike From Minister of Sports For Qualifying Team For CAF Competition
content:
The Central African Republic team coach Sebastian Ngato, in a surprise twist got a motorbike for qualifying his country for 2024 Championship of African Nations (CHAN) from the country Minister of Sports on Sunday afternoon.

CAR is one of the debutants who qualified for the competition at the expense of much established countries.

The country sports minister handed a motorbike which was adjudged the most expensive in the country to the coach as a reward for his achievements.

title: Defects Saga: El-Rufai Addresses Decamping Reports
content:
Malam Nasir El-Rufai, the immediate past governor of Kaduna state, on his verified X page while reacting to the reports of his defection to People’s Democratic Party (PDP), has denied decamping to the opposition Party or any other political party and has threatened legal action against those he called peddlers of fake news.

“Please disregard the patent lies and rumours about my political affiliation. I have referred the lead peddlers of the fake news for further action by my lawyers,” the former governor wrote while asked the public to disregard the report.

Similarly, one of his aides who did not want his name mentioned, in a telephone interview described the rumoured defection of his boss to any political party as false and pure handwork of mischief makers.

“It is the handwork of mischief makers. I don’t want to discuss the mischief maker‘s social media posts, but the report is false. The former governor did not join PDP or any other party,” the aide said.

title: NDLEA Arrested Nollywood Filmmaker And Renowned Socialite Drug Cartel
content:
NDLEA operatives has made known that its has arrested a Lagos socialite, a Nollywood filmmaker and other individuals linked to major illicit drug activities across the country.

The operatives stormed the Okota mansion of 61-year-old Aishat Elediye, a well-known Lagos socialite, leading to her arrest and interception of a white Izuzu truck with one of her driver, Abideen Adio, 41, carrying 44 jumbo sacks of imported cannabis, weighing 1,540 kilograms.

In a separate operation the agency said the operatives also arrested a motivational speaker and US-trained Nollywood filmmaker, Emeka Mbadiwe in a Lekki hotel following the arrest of his associate, Uzoekwe Ugochukwu James.

Femi Babafemi the NDLEA spoke person while disclosed the updates, he said: “A well-known Lagos socialite, Aishat Elediye, also know as Alhaja Ajoke was arrested when the operative stormed her Okota mansion. One of her staff member, Abideen Adio, 41, driver, was as well arrested after the agency intercepts a white Izuzu truck carrying 44 jumbo sacks of imported cannabis, weighing 1,540 kilograms.

“Alhaja Ajoke is a businesswoman who imports fabrics and shoes from China but beneath is a massive illicit drug trade. She is also recognised as the Iyalaje of Blessing Sisters, an influential club of society women in Lagos.”

“NDLEA officers on Friday, December 27, 2024, arrested a US-trained Hollywood and Nollywood filmmaker, Emeka Mbadiwe, who is also a motivational speaker at his Lekki Hotel room following the arrest of his partner, Uzoekwe Ugochukwu James.

“James was arrested the same day at a warehouse in Ajao Estate, Ikeja, where he was sent by Mbadiwe to collect a shipment of 33 parcels of Loud, a strong strain of cannabis weighing 17.30 kilograms, which arrived at the import shed of the Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Ikeja on December 24, 2024, from the United States on a Delta Airline flight, concealed in large wooden boxes,” he added.

He said operatives also cracked down on a ring of young dealers producing drug-laced cupcakes in Ilorin.

“In Kwara State, a fresh graduate, Khadijat Abdulraheem, 24, and a 20-year-old student of the University of Ilorin, Ayomide Morakinyo, were on Sunday, December 29, 2024, arrested by the NDLEA operatives at the Tanke-University of Ilorin Road, Oke Odo, Ilorin based on credible intelligence that they were producing and selling drug-laced cupcakes to students in the community.

“When their apartment was searched, 42 pieces of drugged cakes were recovered from them,” Babafemi said.

title: VAT Is Unconstitutional, The Tax Reform Bill Prepared Is To Prevent Looming Dangers – Oyedele
content:
Taiwo Oyedele, the Chairman of the Presidential Committee on Fiscal Policy and Tax Reforms, on Sunday, during a live television programme on Arise TV to discuss the tax reforms proposed by President Bola Tinubu, has said when the 1999 constitution was introduced, value-added tax (VAT) was missing, but the government continued to collect the VAT which was introduced in 1993 and implemented in 1994 by the military to replace the sales tax that was being done by states. The position which can be challenge at the court of law, as matter of fact two state are currently in court on the issue.

Oyedele stated that if the case goes in favour of River and Lagos state? That is the equivalent of 100 per cent derivation. For us, we believe these tax reforms will prevent that. We said if we get states to start collecting VAT in Nigeria, it will be chaotic for business because we know for a fact that states in Nigeria will not respect input-output.

If the government want the current Value Added Tax structure to be kept as it is given the controversies, then the team was willing to oblige. I can tell you, as we speak today, if they want us to keep the current VAT formula, we’ll keep it 100 per cent. So, the fact that people keep using the problem we are trying to solve against us, is what I need to understand, he said.

“There were two comments that Mr President made. His first point is that we have to do tax reforms. We cannot continue with the laws of the colonial era and hope that Nigeria will become a developed country. This tax system is holding us back. Then after a few other questions, someone asked a question again about whether he was willing to move and make a compromise, and he said, ‘Yes’. So his point is that we have to carry out tax reform.

“That is what is non-negotiable, otherwise, we will be missing out on a significant opportunity to move Nigeria forward. But in terms of the details of those bills, everything is up for grabs. I can tell you, as we speak today, if they want us to keep the current VAT formula, we’ll keep it 100 per cent. So, the fact that people keep using the problem we are trying to solve against us, is what I need to understand.

“We are saying today that Lagos State is getting the benefit for calls made in Kano, Kwara, in Ekiti. We say, let’s change that. And then you come out and say they want to take what we are doing in Kano to Lagos.

“It seems to me that the more we explain it, the more people try not to understand because a lot of people don’t even understand the current position of the law.

“Let me quickly explain what the problem is, the value-added tax was introduced in 1993 by the military. Implementation started in 1994 and that was to replace the sales tax that was being done by states.

“The people that put the Constitution together pretty much replicated 1979’s. In 1979 there wasn’t VAT. So in 1999 when they introduced the constitution, VAT was missing, but the government continued to collect VAT. Some states like Rivers State and Lagos State are in court saying that VAT should be collected by the state because they feel that they are not getting enough for the contribution they are making into the VAT pot, and therefore if they collect it as a state tax, they will be better off.

“That is the equivalent of 100 per cent derivation. For us, as we’re working on these tax reforms. We said if we get states to start collecting VAT in Nigeria, it will be chaotic for business because we know for a fact that states in Nigeria will not respect input-output.

“So we said, how can we make everybody at least comfortable and address inequity? What did we identify? As of today, when companies remit their VAT, they tend to remit from their head office because that’s where they have the finance department. So MTN, BUA, Dangote, Airtel, all the banks, most of them are headquartered in Lagos. Some of the oil companies are headquartered in Rivers State,” he stated.

In October 2024, Tinubu introduced four Tax Reform Bills to the National Assembly to overhaul Nigeria’s tax system. The Bills – the Nigeria Tax Bill 2024, the Tax Administration Bill, the Nigeria Revenue Service Establishment Bill, and the Joint Revenue Board Establishment Bill – were to consolidate existing tax laws, streamline tax administration, and enhance revenue generation.

The proposed legislation has faced stiff resistance from various players in the country, as people argue that it would favour one section of Nigeria at the expense of others.

title: NFF's: World Cup Winner's Account Hacked
content:
The former Nigeria Football Federation General Secretary, Fanny Amun Facebook page has been hacked.

Confirming the update, the former FIFA U17 world cup winner wrote, "Please, l got distress calls from people requesting same but PLEASE IGNORE. The (Facebook) page was hacked in the past hour. Amb fanny AMUN MON without EY. Happy new year to all please circulate same." 

Some of his Facebook friends the hacker contacted also advised the general public to be cautious with messages coming from the suspected hackers. He wrote, "Please, I am sure coach Fanny Amun Facebook account has been hacked, Please, be cautious of any message from him , he is not the one. His messenger entered my DM and was asking for my WhatsApp number, to give me free Data, I just know it was scam.

Fanny Ikhayere Amun (born 1 October 1962) is a Nigerian former football player and coach. 

In 1993, Amun coached the Nigeria national under-17 team at the 1993 FIFA U-17 World Championship in Japan, helping the team win the competition. He coached the under-20 team in 1995 at the 1995 African Youth Championship, hosted by Nigeria.

Amun was appointed assistant coach of the Nigeria national team for the 1998 FIFA World Cup in France. He was Secretary-General for the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF).

Amun retired as an Assistant Director in the Federal Ministry of Sports in 2007.

title: Super Eagles Set To Unveil Coach - Official
content:
Since the stepped down of Super Eagles coach, Finidi George months ago, the three times African champions have been without substantial manager to manage it’s affair. The NFF's Technical Director, Austin Eguavoen has been acting on interim capacity and has led the 2023 AFCON finalists to qualify for the 2025 African Nations Cup.

The former Ajax winger resigned his position as the team head coach after crucial meeting with the then Minister of sports, Senator John Enoh and Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) regarding the chances of the Super eagles qualifying for the 2026 World cup after the team's disappointing performance against South Africa and Benin as well poor preparations towards qualification for the 2025 AFCON.

On his part, Samson Siasia, former Super Eagles coach, while addressing the situation surrounding the management team in the Super Eagles, called on the Nigeria Football Federation to priorities hiring a local manager for the national team, and correct the error of allowing single person to be the Coach and Technical Director at same time.

The Bayelsa born ex-Nigeria, Siasia while gave the advice in Abuja during a novelty football match honouring Shehu Dikko, Chairman of the National Sports Commission aid Eguavoen shouldn’t be Super Eagles Coach and Technical Director at same time, believing hiring a foreign coach would be a mistake as well.

In a new twist, the official of the Nigeria Football Federation has confirm that new coach of Super Eagles will be announced soon. Probably, this January, a top official of the NFF has hinted. 

“Nothing will stop us (NFF) from unveiling a coach for the Super Eagles this month. We have to take a decision for a coach to be named this month because he has to first of all familiarize himself with the players following tough assignment ahead of him," the source said.

In the same vein, former NFF President, Amaju Pinnick told Channels Sports that "NFF will announce an enterprising coach soon. “Any moment from now, I am sure they would be announcing a coach, an enterprising coach at that,” Pinnick told Channels Television Sports Tonight.

The new coach when announced will now oversee the remaining part of the 2026 World Cup qualifiers.

Nigeria are second from bottom in Group C with three points from four matches.

They resume their campaign in Rwanda before a home game against Zimbabwe in March.

title: NNPCL: Invitation To Rehabilitated Refineries Plants Disrespectful - Obasanjo
content:
The Ex-President Olusegun Obasanjo has berated the invitation extended to him by the Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation Limited in an interview on Channels Television on Thursday, during which the ex-president recounted failed efforts to privatise oil plants in the country. Describing the invitation as disrespectful.

Recalls, Obasanjo had expressed his frustration over the mismanagement of the refineries and failure of his successor rejected a sum of $750m offer from the Chairman of the Dangote Group, Aliko Dangote, to manage the Port Harcourt and Kaduna refineries. Noting that despite significant expenditure since 2007, no results had been achieved.

“When I was president, I wanted to do something about the three refineries we have: Port Harcourt, Warri, and Kaduna. Aliko got a team together after I asked Shell to come and run it for us. And Shell said they wouldn’t. I said, ‘Please come and take equity’, they said no. I said, ‘Okay, don’t take equity, come and run it’, they said no.

“Aliko got a team together and they paid $750m to take part in PPP (Public–Private Partnership) in running the refineries. My successor refunded their money, and I went to my successor; I told him what transpired; he said NNPC said they wanted the refinery and they could run it, and I said, ‘But you know they cannot run it.

“But I was told not too long ago that since that time, more than $2bn had been squandered on the refineries, and they still would not work,” Obasanjo said. 

In response, the NNPCL spokesperson Femi Soneye insisted that the refineries were working and invited the former president for a tour of the Port Harcourt and Warri refineries if want to confirm.

“We extend an open invitation to former President Obasanjo for a tour of the rehabilitated refineries to witness firsthand the progress made under the new NNPC Limited.”

Reacting to the invitation in an interview with Saturday PUNCH, Obasanjo through his media aide, Kehinde Akinyemi, said such an open invitation was disrespectful to his office and person, and why not formal invitation.

“Is that the right way to invite a former president of the country? Who says Baba has even seen the statement or read the news? It is a total disrespect for the office of the former president.

“Ask the NNPCL that as of January 2, have they written to him? Is there any official letter addressed to him, inviting him to the refinery? It is an absolute insult, and the former president cannot dignify such with a response,” Obasanjo’s aide stated.

title: Osun State: Death Sentence For Stealing a Fowl Pardoned convict returned home with mental disorder
content:
Recalls the widespread attention on a case involved a young man in Osun State, Mr. Sunday Morakinyo who was reportedly arrested in 2010 and sentenced to death by hanging in 2014 after being convicted of stealing a fowl.

The case which caught the attention of the state governor, Ademola Adeleke, expressed his concern over the reported death sentence for stealing a fowl, directing the state’s attorney general and commissioner for justice to launch a full investigation into the case and initiate processes to grant the young man a prerogative of mercy.

The family of the Pardoned convict has confirm the returned home of the young lad but with mental disorder.

According to the family, Morakinyo was in good and stable condition before his arrest by the police in November 2010 for allegedly stealing fowl and eggs in Oyan, Osun State. But upon release,  he returned home with a mental illness which was reportedly developed after his arrest.

They appealed to the government and well-meaning individuals for assistance in addressing the mental illness he has been battling.

Speaking on behalf of the family to Punch, Morakinyo’s uncle, Ojo Olaide, refuted claims that the ex-convict had been suffering from a mental disorder before his arrest, asserted that he was healthy and mentally stable at the time of his arrest.

“Nothing was wrong with him before his arrest. He was hale and hearty and mentally stable. He was arrested at the market in Oyan and taken to the police station for allegedly stealing fowl and eggs, which he denied.

“Later, Segun Olowookere was also brought to the station, having been arrested at his father’s shop. We wanted to pay for their bail that day, but our children insisted that we shouldn’t because they hadn’t committed any crime.

“The following day, the two of them were transferred to the Okuku Police Division, then to Osogbo. That was how the case escalated. Our children were eventually arraigned in court for robbery, a crime they did not commit.

“During the trial, the policeman who arrested them testified in court that Sunday and Segun were not involved in the theft of fowls and eggs. Those who actually committed the crime were taken to welfare homes in Osogbo, and I later learnt they were released.

“The police, not our children, wrote the so-called statements of confession. I can defend that claim anywhere. The police implicated our children.

“on the issue of mental status, I was told Sunday was tortured severely, and that led to his mental illness. I visited him regularly at the Ilesa Correctional Centre, bringing him clothes, but by my next visit, he would have torn them. That was how I came to know about his condition. Sunday was in a very stable condition before his arrest. Unfortunately, he returned home with a mental disorder. He doesn’t recognize people again,” he explained.

“I deeply appreciate Governor Ademola Adeleke for pardoning both Segun and Sunday. However, we are appealing to the government to assist us in treating Sunday’s condition and facilitating his rehabilitation. We plan to take him to the hospital by Monday,” he added. 

On January 30, 2013, the police arraigned Morakinyo and his co-accused, Segun Olowookere, before Justice Jide Falola of the Osun State High Court in Ikirun, on charges of conspiracy, robbery, and stealing.

They were accused of conspiring in November 2010 to rob one Oguntade Faramade of fowls and eggs worth N20,000.

Morakinyo and Olowookere were convicted and sentenced to death by the Osun State High Court on December 17, 2014, for conspiracy to commit armed robbery, robbery, and stealing.

title: Nnamdi Kanu’s: Ohanaeze expressed optimism about his release as Tinubu visits Enugu today
content:
In a statement issued by the Secretary to the Enugu State Government, Prof. Chidiebere Onyia, on Friday, confirming the planned visitation of the President Bola Tinubu to Enugu State today and the commission exercise of some projects executed by Governor Peter Mbah’s administration during the one-day visit by the number citizen of the country, the Ohanaeze Ndigbo Worldwide, the apex Igbo socio-cultural group, has expressed optimism for the release of the leader of the proscribed Independent People of Biafra, Nnamdi Kanu.

The group in a statement by its National Publicity Secretary, Alex Ogbonnia, expressed delight over the gradual attitudinal change of the federal government towards the Ndigbo, while charging the president to use his office to order the release of Mazi Nnamdi Kanu.

Ohanaeze has insisted that national peace, unity, patriotism and sustainable economic development of any country are the outcomes, effects or products of equity, and social justice.

“In other words, there is hardly any society or group that can be complacent under severe existential threats such as orchestrated marginalisation, relative deprivations, and external instigation of insecurity, conflagrations and crises.

“It is therefore hoped that with the Enugu visit, President Tinubu will write his name with gold in the hearts of Ndigbo and all the well-meaning Nigerians, if he orders for the release of Mazi Nnamdi Kanu,” the statement read.

title: CBN: 1,000 Retired Staffs, Not Force But Voluntary
content:
The CBN governor, Olayemi Cardoso, when appeared yesterday before the House of Representatives ad-hoc committee investigating the forceful retirement of 1,000 CBN Staffs said the organization did not force them to leave the system but that the affected did it voluntarily.

The House had on December 3, 2024 resolved to investigate the planned mass retirement at the apex bank to ascertain the criteria, process, and legality of the exercise and examine the N50 billion pay-off scheme to ensure transparency, accountability and proper utilisation of funds.

Cardoso who was represented by the CBN’s deputy director, corporate services, Bala Bello, during the investigative hearing said: “You are very much aware, chairman, that the entire world is going through a process of digitizing its operations, and then once that is done, a lot of opportunities are created, just like a lot of redundancies are also equally created.

“And you have had instances in which in the past, the request for staff to actually exit the bank voluntarily actually emanated on the part of the staff. And I believe the Central Bank is not necessarily the first organization to have done that.

“I’m very happy to mention, Mr chairman and members of the committee, that the early exit programme of the Central Bank is 100 percent voluntary. It’s not mandatory. Nobody has been asked to leave, and nobody has been forced to leave. It’s a completely voluntary programme that has been put in place.

“I believe several organizations across the world, and even within this country, both in terms of the private sector and the public sector, are undertaking similar exercises. So nobody has been asked to leave. But people who are based on popular demand, I have to be humble, with a lot of humility, to tell you that this same program that is taking place is not at the instance of the bank itself.

“Of course, we have our own challenges, and we know where we want to take the bank to. That’s Cardoso and his team, myself included. But this popular request actually came from the staff. In the past, you have had instances in which cases of stagnation and lack of career progression appear.

“It gets to the level where you have, for example, 30 departments in the Central Bank. You cannot have 60 directors, manning 30 departments. It’s not going to work. So, once those vacancies are filled, it gets to a level where some people, even though they are very qualified, they are very able, and they are very willing, but the vacancies are not there. And then they got to a level where they are stagnated for a period of time.

“There are several instances in which similar exercise took place in the Central Bank, which has happened several times. This is not the first time. It’s not the second time. It’s not the third time. It’s several times. You’ve had instances in which people at the top request that, look, it’s going to take me X number of years to actually aspire to become a director in an organization. But right now, there’s no vacancy. And the person sitting next to me probably has eight years to go. Meanwhile, I have seven.

So there’s no career growth.”

On his part, committee’s chairman, Hon. Kumo said the panel will be fair to all the parties involved in the investigation.

title: Portable Run For His Life Amid Ibadan Concert Panics
content:
Habeeb Okikiola Badmus popularly known by his stage name Portable, has failed to show up in Ibadan, the Oyo State capital at the concert organised by Fuji star, Alhaji Taye Akande Adebisi, famously known as Taye Currency on Thursday over his controversial comments about Ibadan and Oyo state people of not having Plaster-of-Paris (PoP) in their homes.

In the heat of a conflict between him and his ex-lover, Queen Dami, the ex-wife of late Alafin of Oyo late last year in a viral video made a provocative statement about Ibadan and Oyo people of not owning buildings with Plaster-of-Paris (PoP) when showing the apartment he rented for his estranged lover with POP embellishment, saying such facilities were not obtainable in their state.

The comment which do not go down well with the people of the state threaten him never to step his foot in Oyo state unless he’s ready to face the consequences.

Fearing the consequences of his earlier utterances, the singer failed to show-up for the Fuji sensation’s New Year Concert schedule for January 2, 2025 having begged for forgiveness prior to the concert.

title: Mikel Praises Ola Aina Game Qualities
content:
Former Super Eagles skipper John Mikel Obi on a Podcast has heaped praises on Nottingham Forest defender Ola Aina for an outstanding performance. Describes Aina phenomenal qualities game and scoring abilities superb.

"He has had a good season so far. One thing he has added to his game this season is that he’s defending well. He is putting in a lot of crosses now and, of course, chipping in a couple of goals as well, which is absolutely fantastic to see".

“Listen, we all knew he was a fantastic player at the club. He has gone to Forest and has been playing well since returning to the Premier League from Italy,” Obi said.

Aina has become a big revelation in the premier League this season following his outstanding performance for the former European champions.

The 27-year-old has scored twice in 19 league appearances for the Tricky Trees in the current campaign.
