title: P’Harcourt refinery Scam, operations halts After Four Days
content:
After claims of successful revitalization of the Port Harcourt refinery by Nigeria National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL) which also marked by the official commencement of petroleum product loading on November 26, 2024, its all looks scam as operation shutdown after four days and loading bay empty.

The resumption of activities at the Port Harcourt Refining Company on Tuesday bring heartfelt and hope of greater tomorrow to Nigerians but this may have melted away due to the latest development which seems align with the allegation that the plant do not any produce any product but mere selling old products in the storage tanks.

There was no activity on site when a reporter visited the refinery on Friday. Some workers met on the site claimed that the refinery was undergoing calibration which might last till next week.

Recalls, after the Group Chief Executive Officer of the Nigeria National Petroleum Company Limited, Melee Kyari, inaugurated the new plant on Tuesday showcasing petrol trucks loading from the plant, there were skepticism as reports circulated that the trucks were loaded with old products in the storage tanks.

Upon visiting the Port Harcourt Refinery Area 5,  no signs of activity. An official, who spoke on condition of anonymity, revealed that the loaded trucks contained “dead stock”, Punch reporter stated.

The official said, “Before the refinery was shut down between 2015/2016, we had dead stock left in the tank, including some Premium Motor Spirit (petrol) DPK (kerosene), and Automated Gas Oil (diesel).

“So, these products were in large quantities in stores in those tanks. During the rehabilitation of the Port Harcourt Refinery, Old Area 5, those products were evacuated from the tanks for storage.

“But for DPK, it is in large quantity but they have not pushed it from the tank where it was kept after refined ready for commercial purposes.

“So, the product that was loaded was dead stock, that is the old product that was in the system. So, after these dead stocks, they will have to clean the tank, remove all the debris before pumping the new project into that tank, and redye it.

“But what they are trying to do at the Port Harcourt Refinery is manual, which cannot match the new digital pumps. Most of the pumps used for the event were refurbished.

One of the workers meet on site when asked about the lack of loading activity said, “They are de-watering, removing the water under the PMS. Maybe there will be loading after that, but we don’t know what time today.”

While another worker at the loading bay said, “They are calibrating the meters,” which may responsible for the halts in production.

title: New NIMC Multipurpose ID Card Benefits To Nigerians
content:
In a sensitization video posted on X by President Bola Ahmed Tinubu Media Centre on Wednesday, the Presidency in regards to its new NIMC Multipurpose ID Card has outline the numerous benefit associate with the soon-to-be-launched general multipurpose identity card of the National Identity Management Commission (NIMC).

The card is said to provide easy access to government interventions, obtain loans from the government and various financial institutions, serve a prerequisite to apply for government jobs as well as private sector jobs, and give employers confidence in the profile of the job seekers as verified citizens without questionable records.

“The National ID Card aims to bring over 100 million Nigerians into the banking sector as it automatically bestows on them an inclusion that has evaded more than half of the country’s population for a very long time.

“The card will provide easy access to government interventions, reflecting efforts to enhance transparency in social contracts with citizens.

“The cardholders can readily obtain loans from the government and various financial institutions, as their verifiable credit scores are derived from their historical financial records.

“Though the NIN is already a prerequisite for obtaining an international passport and driver’s license, the new NIMC Multipurpose ID Card will be required to apply for government jobs as well as private sector jobs, as it would give employers confidence in the profile of the job seekers as verified citizens without questionable records.

“Users have the option of requesting either credit or debit cards,” It said.

The Head of Card Management Services at NIMC, Dr. Peter Iwegbu, during a media workshop in Lagos last week, discussed the processes involved in distributing the cards while noting that the multipurpose card would soon be available to the general public,

He said though the National Identification Number (NIN) is required for all Nigerians, individuals who desire the multipurpose card must submit a request to obtain it. Noting that the requesting and collecting processes of the card would be made easy for Nigerians because NIMC will be decentralized as NIMC is working with banks across the country, which will make it possible for people to walk into any bank closest to them and request a card, adding that the Commission would also ensure that the cards are issued at uniform price across the banks.

title: Finnish Authorities Fixed Date For Simon Ekpa’s Trial
content:
Following the arrest of the Pro-Biafran agitator of Indigenous People of Biafra (IPOB), Mr. Simon Njoku Ekpa and detained in Finnish District Court of Päijät-Häme on probable cause for publicly inciting crimes with terrorist intent, the district court had scheduled May 2025 as the deadline for prosecutors to present possible charges against him.

PUNCH claims that a Senior Detective Superintendent at Finland’s National Bureau of Investigation, Mikko Laaksonen, confirmed the development to them via email on Tuesday, but said could not disclosed further details due to the ongoing investigation.

“The date for bringing up possible charges by the prosecution was set by the district court to May 2025.

“In a basic situation regarding the remand, the next possible hearing can be held no earlier than two weeks from the previous hearing, should the parties in question seek for the matter to be re-evaluated by the district court.

“International cooperation is part of the investigation due to the nature of the case but no further comments can be given on the subject at this point,” Laaksonen explained.

The federal government of Nigeria in a statement issued on Friday by the acting spokesman of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kimiebi Imomotimi Ebienfa,also said, the government is monitoring  the legal proceedings of the case and will provide further updates on the arrested and detained of the fugitive leader of the Indigenous People of Biafra (IPOB), Simon Ekpa, in Finland for inciting terrorism and promoting violence.

title: Sheroes Cup 2024: Remo Stars Coast In Triumph
content:
2024 Sheroes Cup FIFA Goal Project, Abuja came to an end with Remo Stars Ladies defeated Abia Angels 6-4 on penalties shootout to emerge champion after both sides couldn’t find the winning goal.

Abia Angels leads in the first half of the game with a wonderful goal in the 11th minute from Ekozie Dikachi. But the scorecard change in the second half specifically 46th minute after an equalizer goal from Kehinde Deborah as they all play according to  coach instructions which change the game tempo.

The competition also saw Naija Ratels emerged victorious against Bayelsa Queens, after winning 5-4 on penalties in the third-place match.

Super substitute Arit Titus opened the scoring for the visitors in the 20th minute before Nwachukwu Adana leveled the scores for the hosts, Naija Ratels.

Wemimo Mathew, the head coach of Remo Stars Ladies, was adjudged the best coach of the competition. While Abia Angels striker, Lucky Mary was awarded Most Valuable Player of the tournament. Ziporah Ziperrekheke, a striker for Naija Ratels, was recognized as the Highest Goal Scorer, Honey Badgers FC won the Fair Play trophy, and Remo Stars goalkeeper Adjei Charlotte was awarded the title of Best Goalkeeper.

title: Ogun Assembly Summons Dangote Over Abuse
content:
On Tuesday, the Ogun State House of Assembly, after a report by the joint House Committees on Trade, Commerce and Investment, and Environment, chaired by Adebisi Oyedele, has resolved to summon the management of Dangote Cement Company to provide comprehensive plans addressing environmental degradation, haphazard parking, and other environmental issues arising from its operations at its Ibese cement plant in the Yewa North Local Government Area.

“The committee found the company culpable of the allegations levelled against it. The committee observed the lackadaisical approach and nonchalant attitude of the company to the livelihood of the people, having constructed a cement factory for decades without a trailer park and deliberately causing havoc on the host communities, as well as commuters plying the road, among others.

“The Dangote Group must avail the House with the Ibese cement plant master plan, reflecting all its adjuring facilities, including the trailer park and industrial drainage channel, in line with international best practices,” the report read.

Company pro-activeness in fulfilling its Corporate Social Responsibility obligations to the host communities is very important, the Assembly stated.

title: Africa Military Games: Libya, Algeria Run Riot With Nigeria
content:
At the Africa Military Games 2024 still ongoing, Team Nigeria proofing Preparedness has they continued to extends lead on medals table with outstanding performance in  taekwondo, wrestling and shooting.

Before the end of proceedings on Tuesday, November 26th, 2024, Nigeria has a massive haul of 121 medals including 60 Gold, 34 Silver and 27 Bronze medals. 

Algeria battling for supremacy but still 2nd on the log with 53 medals, while Libya never loss hope in their 3rd position with 13 medals.

Tuesday game also saw Nigeria move up the ladder from their 5th position in volleyball table with an impressive win over Burkina Faso.

The match was a one-sided affair, with Nigeria showcasing their strength, especially through SLT Seiyefa Dikiyai’s powerful spikes to defeated Burkina Faso 3-0 (25-10, 25-16, 25-19) in the men’s volleyball event at the African Military Games 2024, held in Abuja on Tuesday.

This victory against Burkina Faso marked Nigeria's second win at the tournament, with SLT Seiyefa Dikiyai awarded the Most Valuable Player of the match.

The head coach MWO Solomon Zango expressed satisfaction with the team's performance after a comeback from first game defeat.

title: President Tinubu Celebrates Revival Of Port Harcourt Refinery
content:
President Bola Tinubu extends his heartfelt congratulations to the Nigeria National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL) on the successful revitalization of the Port Harcourt refinery, marked by the official commencement of petroleum product loading on November 26, 2024.


The President acknowledges the pivotal role of former President Muhammadu Buhari in initiating the comprehensive rehabilitation of all our refineries and expresses gratitude to the African Export-Import Bank for its confidence in financing this critical project.


Furthermore, President Tinubu commends the leadership of NNPC Limited's Group Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Mele Kyari, whose unwavering dedication and commitment were instrumental in overcoming challenges to achieve this milestone.


With the successful revival of the Port Harcourt refinery, President Tinubu urges NNPC Limited to expedite the scheduled reactivation of both the second Port Harcourt refinery and the Warri and Kaduna refineries. 


These efforts will significantly enhance domestic production capacity alongside the contributions of privately-owned refineries and make our country a major energy hub, with the gas sector also enjoying unprecedented attention by the administration. 


The President underscores his administration's determination to repair the nation’s refineries, aiming to eradicate the disheartening perception of Nigeria as a major crude oil producer that lacks the ability to refine its own resources for domestic consumption.


Highlighting the values of patience, integrity, and accountability in the rebuilding of the nation’s infrastructure, President Tinubu calls upon individuals, institutions, and citizens entrusted with responsibilities to maintain focus and uphold trust in their service to the nation.


In alignment with the Renewed Hope Agenda focused on shared economic prosperity for all, the President reaffirms his administration's commitment to achieving energy sufficiency, enhancing energy security, and boosting export capacity for Nigeria.

title: African Military Games 2024: Nigeria sited 5th In The Men’s Volleyball Table, Behind Rivalry Country
content:
Thrilling, entertainment, passion, unexpected trails the opening games of men’s volleyball competition at the second African Military Games (AMGA) 2024 in Abuja with host nation fall to Algeria, Kenya after staged comeback got victory over Ghana, while Burkina Faso humiliate Serra Leon.

The event that took place at the Package B indoor sport complex of Moshood Abiola Stadium's saw Burkina Faso wins 3-0 against Serra Leon in the first game of the day with (25-15, 25-15, 25-21) in the three set respectively. Kenya, in an epic comeback, staged a stunning recovery against Ghana, winning 3-2 (15-25, 20-25, 25-21, 25-22, 15-11) after initially defeat by two sets. While the last game of the day between Nigeria and Algeria, saw Algeria triumphed over host nation with 3-1 victory (26-24, 25-19, 22-25, 25-22) in the three set respectively despite the energetic support from the home fans.

After match press briefing, the head coach of the Nigeria Armed Forces Volleyball team, Solomon Zango, acknowledged the challenge but was optimistic about the team's prospects going forward.

"We have to refocus and concentrate on the upcoming matches. There’s no room for complacency. Our next goal is to make sure we don’t drop any more points.

“Every match counts. We’ll adjust and come back stronger,” he said, emphasizing the importance of not letting the loss to Algeria define their campaign,” Zango said.

Burkina Faso sit at top in the log, follow by Algeria, then Kenya, Ghana is 4th, Nigeria 5th, while Serra Leon is at bottom. The volleyball competition continues on Monday, with Burkina Faso facing Kenya at noon, followed by a crucial match between Algeria and Kenya at 2 pm. Host Nigeria will aim to bounce back when they take on Sierra Leone at 4 pm.

Meanwhile in another sport event, Nigeria’s football team won the third place match against the opponents, Equatorial Guinea with 4-0 victory to claimed bronze medal in men category.

First half saw Nigeria lead by a goal to nil, and in the second half, the Nigerians increased the tally to 4-0.

In the basketball, team Nigeria female basketball in the final match with Cameroon ended 47-86 in favour of neighbour Cameroon.

At the end of first half and second quarter Nigeria trailed Cameroon 32-37 in the first half and second quarter of the game but by the end of third quarter, Nigerian team was 40-65 against Cameroon, and by the end of the match, Cameroonians clinched the victory with 86-47.

Also, in the men’s 51kg class of boxing event, Nigeria’s Damilola Salwudeen lost to his Algerian counterpart Touareg Mohammed.

Nigeria teams are however optimistic of coming back strong in rest of the games.

title: We Won’t Serve Father And Son - Concerns Lagosians Tells Tinubu
content:
The recent endorsements of Seyi Tinubu as a potential successor to Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu in 2027 by some groups has continue to generate mix-reaction among the people of Lagos State.

Mr. Seyi was first endorsed to be the next Governor of Lagos State in 2027 by a socio-political group know as Friends of Seyi Tinubu, describing him as a visionary leader with a rare combination of intellect, empathy, and strategic acumen.

Similarly, another group called, the Coalition of Nigerian Youth Leaders, issued an endorsement on Tuesday in Owerri, Imo State, suggesting that Seyi who is the son of Bola Tinubu, the current President of Nigeria would be welcomed to run for governor in Osun or Imo states, where his family is reportedly from if Lagos fails to hands him mantle of leadership in the state.

However, their endorsements have drawn criticism from various stakeholders.

The Lagos State chapter of the Peoples Democratic Party spokesperson, Hakeem Amode, in a chat with Sunday PUNCH  rejected the idea and declared that citizens would resist any attempts to impose Seyi Tinubu, son of President Bola Tinubu, as the next governor of the state because Lagos will not serve the father and still serve the son. It is not an inheritance.

He questioned whether governorship should become an , suggesting that it was inappropriate for a son to inherit such a role from his father.

“Governorship is not a gift, nor an inheritance. It will be inappropriate for a son to inherit such a role from his father, Lagos will not serve the father and still serve him. if Tinubu camp were to resort to tactics similar to those used in Ondo and Edo states in the past, it would be met with resistance. In the last presidential general election, Lagosians did not vote his father which was an indication that they would not support his son for governor,” he said.

Reacting, the Coalition of Lagos Indigenous Youths also condemned the idea of a Tinubu family member taking over the governorship, insisting that non-indigenes should not be allowed to govern Lagos State.

Meanwhile, the spokesperson for the All Progressives Congress in Lagos, Seye Oladejo, dismissed the conversation about the 2027 elections as premature. He said, “It is too early to be discussing the 2027 elections, people should focus on supporting current government both at state and federal level to advance development.”

title: List Of Donors Griped With Fear As Enugu Govt Ready To Provide Finland Evidence Of Ekpa’s Atrocities
content:
Following the arrest of the separatist leader of Indigenous People of Biafra (IPOB), Mr. Simon Njoku Ekpa and detained in Finnish District Court of Päijät-Häme on probable cause for publicly inciting crimes with terrorist intent, experts have said individuals donating funds to Simon Ekpa can be charged with terrorism, as Enugu govt prepared to provide Finland with evidence of ekpa’s atrocities.

In a statement by the Secretary to the Enugu State Government, Chidiebere Onyia, on Friday, said the arrest was in line with the demands of Governor Peter Mbah-led administration to Finnish authorities and ready to furnish the Finland authority with evidence of atrocities allegedly perpetrated in South-east Nigeria by pro-Biafra agitator, Simon Ekpa.

“His arrest and trial will no doubt go a long way in strengthening peace, security, and stability in all parts of the South-east. Ekpa has for long. and unfortunately from Finland, made a living by creating a siege climate and mentality in the South-east, destroying lives, property, and the Igbo trademark of entrepreneurship and hard work. He thrives on manipulating, exploiting, and extorting the people on the pretext of fighting for their interest and for the restoration of Biafra,” the SSG said.

Despite the arrest and detention of the separatist leader, some members of the outlawed Indigenous People of Biafra have continued to persuade donors never to stop in donating money to embattled leader.

Reacting to this development, a Senior Advocate of Nigeria, Kunle Edun, said individuals financing terrorism will be found guilty.

“Sections 2, 21 and 22 of the Act are clear that terrorism and financing of terrorism are prohibited in Nigeria. Any person that financially supports or makes his resources, services or facilities available to persons knowingly engaged in terrorist activities is equally liable and offence under the Terrorism Act can attract up to the maximum life imprisonment but if death occurs while committing the act, death penalty will apply. An attempt to do any of the foregoing is equally an offence under the Act. It is critical that the intent of the suspects must be proved to commit or support acts of terrorism.

“It is in this wise, that the alleged crowdfunding organized by Simon Ekpa whereby donors were said to made funds available to him, becomes very concerning. If it is established either by direct or circumstantial evidence that the donors were aware or ought to have been aware of the purpose of the crowdfunding and the activities of Simon Ekpa they could be charged for financing terrorism. Therefore, a thorough investigation will be required to gather these evidence, as the burden is on the Prosecution to prove the charge,” he said.

title: FG Will  Monitor Simon Ekpa’s Legal Proceedings In Finland And Provide Further Updates
content:
The federal government in a statement issued on Friday by the acting spokesman of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kimiebi Imomotimi Ebienfa, has said, the government will monitor the legal proceedings and provide further updates on the arrested and detained of the fugitive leader of the Indigenous People of Biafra (IPOB), Simon Ekpa, in Finland for inciting terrorism and promoting violence.

“The Ministry of Foreign Affairs wishes to confirm the arrest of Mr. Simon Njoku Ekpa, a Nigerian-Finnish citizen and prominent leader of the proscribed Indigenous People of Biafra (IPOB), by Finnish authorities on Thursday, 21 November 2024. He was charged with inciting terrorism and promoting violence.

“The Finnish District Court of Päijät-Häme ruled to detain him on probable cause for publicly inciting crimes with terrorist intent.

“The arrest of Mr. Simon Njoku Ekpa follows sustained diplomatic pressure by the Nigerian government on Finland, to take action against his activities, which were linked to violence and instability in the South-East of Nigeria. The request for action was featured during high-level engagements between countries.

“The ministry wishes to affirm that the arrest of Mr. Simon Ekpa is a significant development in addressing the activities of IPOB, and also neutralising the influence of transnational actors and their impact on our national security,” the statement partly read.

title: ACF Suspended Chairman For criticizing Tinubu
content:
Following the ACF NEC meeting held on Wednesday, November 20, 2024, at its headquarters in Kaduna where its chairman of the National Executive Council, Mr. Mamman Mike Osuman, SAN make series of comments about President Tinubu policies has backfire.

In less than 24 hours of Mr. Mamman SAN criticizing the policies of President Bola Tinubu administration and disclosing its choice of candidates in the next 2027 elections, the apex northern sociocultural group, Arewa Consultative Forum (ACF), has suspended him.

“The statements were made by the NEC Chairman without consulting or discussing with other leaders and members of the ACF and thus, reflected Mr. Osuman’s personal opinion only.

“ACF rejects Mr. Mamman Mike Osuman’s statements in their entirety. For this reason, the leadership of the ACF’s Board of Trustees (BOT) and that of its NEC has decided to place Mr. Mamman Mike Osuman on suspension with immediate effect. A committee has been constituted for further investigations,” as disclosed in a statement jointly signed by Alhaji Bashir Muhammad Dalhatu (Wazirin Dutse) and Alhaji Murtala Aliyu (Matawallen Gombe), ACF Board of Trustees chairman and Secretary General, respectively.

title: NSC Announce Enugu AS The Host Of 23rd National Sports Festival
content:
The National Sports Commission (NSC) after the top-level meeting of the Commission’s management, in its selection to reflects fairness and commitment to expand the reach of the biennial National Sports Festival across Nigeria has officially announced Enugu State popularly known as the Coal City State as the host of the 23rd edition for the Festival.

Enugu State selection marked the first time the South-Eastern state will stage the prestigious event since the festival’s inception in 1973.

The Coal City State emerged as the winner from a competitive bidding process following a National Sports Commission top management meeting. With this final resolution, Enugu is poised to deliver a world-class event that upholds the festival’s legacy of excellence, inclusiveness, and sports talents discovery.

“Enugu’s selection reflects our commitment to expanding the reach of the festival across Nigeria. The Coal City has shown the capacity and readiness to host an event of this magnitude. We are confident they will deliver a tournament that will raise the bar for future editions,” Mr. Kola Daniel, Media Adviser to the Director General of the NSC stated while speaking on the verdict.

Enugu State Governor, Peter Mbah, in response to the announcement, expressed excitement about the opportunity to host the games. Assured the NSC and Nigerians excellent outing.

“We are honored to host the 23rd National Sports Festival. This is a momentous occasion for Enugu State, and we are determined to deliver a festival that will remain memorable for all. Our preparations will begin immediately, and we are focused on leaving a lasting legacy,” Governor Mbah stated.

The last edition of the festival was held in Asaba, Delta State, where over 11,000 athletes competed in various sports.

title: 2nd Africa Military Games: Algeria Trading In Distance 2nd Position To Nigeria In Medals
content:
The 2024 Africa Military Games in Abuja (AMGA) currently ongoing at the Moshood Abiola Stadium has saw Team Nigeria coast in a total of 64 medals as of yesterday, the third of the events.

Team Nigerian first claimed two golds are in handball competition for both men and women’s category. Thereafter, followed by an impressive performance in wrestling competition with 30 medals consisting of 11 gold 12 silver and 7 bronze. Participation in Taekwondo games won them four gold medals by Mohammed Yusuf- men's 54kg category, Bisallah Rejoice - women's 46kg, Ibeh Nancy in women's 49kg, and Anam Glory in women's 53kg.

1,625 athletes from different 21 African countries are taking part in the 2nd edition of the Africa Military Games which commenced on Monday, competing for medals in 20 different sporting events.

title: NASS Approves Tinubu’s N1.77trn Loan Request Hurriedly
content:
Less than 2 days of President Tinubu’s new external loan request of N1.767 trillion ($2.209 billion) in the 2024 Budget (Appropriation Act) as contained in a letter entitled “Request for a Resolution of the National Assembly for the Implementation of the New External Borrowing of N1.767 trillion (About $2.209 billion) in the 2024 Appropriation Act” and addressed separately to the Senate President, Godswill Akpabio and the Speaker of the House, Rt Hon Abbas Tajudeen, it has swiftly got approval of the National Assembly  despite the displease of many Nigerians, Civil Society Organizations (CSOs) and other experts for the borrowing.

The loan was approved in the Senate, presided over by Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin, after the Senate Committee on Local and Foreign Debts, chaired by Senator Wammako Magatarkada (APC, Sokoto North), presented its report at the exchange rate of USD1.00/800 in the 2024 Appropriation Act, with the amount to be raised from one or more sources.

The fresh loan is expected to increase the federal government’s debt servicing spending of $3.58 billion to service foreign debt in the first nine months of 2024 which represents a 39.77 per cent increase from the $2.56bn spent during the same period in 2023.

title: 10th National Industrial Summit Will Declare Open In Kwara By President Bola Tinubu
content:
The director general of MINILS, Comrade Issa Aremu, during a news conference in Ilorin yesterday has made known that President Bola Tinubu on Tuesday will declare open the 10th national industrial labour relations summit in Ilorin, Kwara State as part of an efforts to set agenda for industrial harmony in the country.

At the conferences which was  organized by the Michael Imoudu National Institute For Labour Studies (MINILS), Ilorin, both the minister of State for Labour and Employment, Dr. Nkeiruka Onyejeocha and chairman of the Nigeria Governors’ Forum, Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq of Kwara State will serve as hosts.

Comrade Issa emphasis the need for the submit themed, ‘The Future of Work and Renewed Hope Agenda: Issues and Perspectives’ which he believed its capable of engendering peace, increased productivity and boost economic development in the country.

“Hundreds of participants drawn from organized labour, employers of labour women, youths, and people living with disabilities, students of labour relations and civil society from private and public sectors are expected at the historic summit hosted by the the MINILS’ director general and management of this institute.

The discussants will include the president of the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC), Comrade Joseph Ajaero, president of the Trade Union Congress (TUC), Comrade Festus Osifo, director general of NECA, Mr. Adewale Smatt-Oyerinde, while the moderator is Prof. Dafe Otobo,” he said.

title: Kwara At It Again; Beat every other states To Become Champion For 3rd Time In A Row
content:
The representatives of Kwara State at the President’s School Debate Championship has again brought honour to the state after winning the competition yesterday in Abuja, the capital city to marked their 3rd time victory in a row of the Championship.

Team Kwara beat Benue State at the finals of the championship, having earlier outperformed many other states in the preliminaries.

Reacting to the development, the Kwara State governor, AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq, celebrate with the four public school pupils, Ajibulu Esther, 10-year-old of Tanke LGEA School B. Ilorin South LGA; Akanbi Al-Amin, 12-year-old of St. Cyprian LGEA Primary School, Offa, Offa LGA; Paul Unity, 12-year-old of Bishop Smith LGEA School A. Ilorin East LGA; and Abdulrahman Fatimoh, 12-year-old of Okesuna LGEA primary School A. in Ilorin East LGA for their outstanding performance in winning the trophy for the third time in a row under his watch, to underscores the steady progress in the primary education sector. 

In his words, “this feat, like the previous ones, strengthens our commitment to continue to invest in public school education — the surest way to secure a place for the Kwara child among their peers worldwide. These feats reassure us that we are on the right path, and we thank our pupils, teachers, parents, and all stakeholders in the public school system for their hard work and support. Specifically, I thank Prof. Sheu Raheem Adaramaja and his SUBEB team for their hard work. This, again, is another win for everyone, and we cannot drop the ball.

“I looked forward to seeing you at the top and prayed to God to grant you good health, long lives and grace to achieve your lofty dreams.”

title: 2024 Africa Military Games in Abuja (AMGA): Nigeria Team Leading In Medalist
content:
The  2024 Africa Military Games in Abuja (AMGA) after the opening ceremony on Wednesday’s has saw Nigerian Armed Forces team won two gold medals and one silver on Thursday.

Team Nigerian claimed the two golds in handball competition for both men and women’s category, leaving opponent Ghana to settling for silver in both outing.

Only two teams Nigeria and Ghana featured in the event that took place at the indoor hall of the Moshood Abiola National Stadium, Package B, which saw Nigeria dominates their counterpart with massive win as Nigeria male team beat Ghana 28-18 on score line.

Meanwhile, Nigeria also won a silver medal in the men’s 87kg Greco-Roman Wrestling event which had four fighters registered to compete with a round-robin format. Tochukwu Okeke in his quest for gold medal only settlingfor silver medal after defeated his Tunisia’s opponent Sobri Mmosria 7-5 in his final game of the event.

Nigeria men’s football third place match against Equatorial Guinea may saw another silver medal for team Nigeria after 1-0 loss to Cameroon and Equatorial Guinea 2-0 defeated to Algeria  in the semi-final encounter. Meanwhile only team Nigeria has female football team as the rest shows no interest.

title: Your policies Is Anti-North’s Development  – Arewa Tells Tinubu
content:
The pan-northern socio-political organisation, Arewa Consultative Forum in a communique released to newsmen at the end of its National Executive Council meeting in Kaduna, on Wednesday which was signed by its National Publicity Secretary, Prof Tukur Muhammad-Baba, has expressed dissatisfaction with the current economic policies of president Tinubu which they claimed have worsened the condition of the Northern Nigeria. And urged the President to review all his administration’s policies to ensure hardship reduction, address insecurity, education, and economic development in northern Nigeria.

“The policies of the current Federal Government have continued to make matters much worse, with little indications of needed sensitivity to the precarious existential conditions of Arewa people.

“The time to think big is now. Notwithstanding the parlous state of Arewa’s glaring challenging economic conditions, the policies of the current Federal Government have continued to make matters much worse.

“Those whose responsibility it is to provide security saying they are doing their best is unacceptable. The minimum duty of the government is to safeguard life and property, and doing anything less is a failure.

“Statistics of out-of-school children, of which Arewa has an overwhelming proportion, are cogent pointers to the situation.

“Despite the dire economic conditions in Arewa, the policies of the current Federal Government have continued to worsen the situation, showing little sensitivity to the precarious existential challenges faced by the Arewa people.

“Succinctly stated, economic reforms, while indeed desirable, should not impoverish the same people they are meant to serve; the people may not be alive to reap the putative benefits.

“In view of the above, the meeting resolved as follows: calls on the Federal Government under the leadership of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu to review, reassess, reevaluate and re-order the direction of its economic policies with a view to giving it the needed human face.

“Strongly calls on the governors of the northern states to adopt a strong, coordinated approach to policy planning and implementation, as these relate to security, education, skills acquisition, agricultural production, health services, etc.

“Calls on the Federal Government to be receptive to criticisms, suggestions, etc., not only in line with the principles of democracy but also because they improve, not retard the policy process for the ultimate benefit of the people.

“Calls on the northern elite, in all spheres of life, to take it upon themselves to counter negative narratives about the North and also imbibe the spirit of community service, individually and collectively. The interests of the North will be best served by northerners.

“The growing food crisis with every through short and long term measures, including imports where needs be, but the ultimate solution is to achieve food self-sufficiency.

“People should take responsibility for our fast-growing population. Public policy and the law should be adopted to achieve a balance.

“Poor electricity supply will continue to hamper efforts to ameliorate poverty, unemployment and underdevelopment in the region. These have to be addressed with utmost urgency,” the ACF said.

title: WAEC Blacklists 14 Supervisors And Bans 13 Schools In Kogi  State
content:
The West African Examination Council has place banned on not fewer than 13 schools in Kogi State and  blacklists another 14 Supervisors from the West Africa Secondary School Certificate Examination following their engagement in  exam malpractices during the 2023/2024 WASSCE.

Mr. Wemi Jones, Kogi state’s Commissioner for Education, disclosed this during a meeting with affected schools, principals and supervisors who were indicted by WAEC.

Jones stated that “examination malpractices remained a criminal offence and would be treated in accordance with the law. The offenders would be prosecuted according to the Kogi State Education Law and Other Matters Connected Therewith, 2020. Our  government has vowed to sanction school principals, teachers and supervisors who engaged or aided examination malpractices in the state.

“Kogi State has invested so much in education and will no longer tolerate the attitude of the ‘bad eggs’ drawing back the gains already made in the education sector. We set up a committee to be headed by the ministry’s Permanent Secretary to investigate personalities indicted by WAEC.”

title: Unite To Address Insecurity - Tinubu Charge Military As He Declared Opens 2nd Africa Military Game
content:
The President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, Bola Ahmed Tinubu, who was represented by Vice President Kashim Shettima, while speaking during the opening ceremony of the 2nd African games, Abuja has urged the military across Africa to carried out the main aims of the games which is skills showcasing, strengthen cooperation, unity, partnership and lasting relationships among African Armed Forces, to address insecurity and other threats to the continent’s unity and stability.

He charge the Africa Military to use the platform to foster unity, camaraderie, and military cooperation across the continent. Noting that no single nation can tackle its security challenges alone.

The 2nd African Military Games,  theme: “Enhancing military cooperation in Africa through sports,” after series of postponement, finally settled to officially kicks off on Wednesday, 20th November 2024 at Moshood Abiola Stadium, Abuja.The Games marks a revival of the tradition initiated over 20 years ago in Nairobi, Kenya.

In a statement by Shettima’s spokesman, Stanley Nkwocha, Tinubu said: “Our collective safety and the well-being of our people demand that we stand together, shoulder to shoulder, as one united Africa,” acknowledging the significance of the Games in strengthening Africa’s collective security efforts.

“This occasion is more than a gathering of extraordinary athletes; it is an undeniable reminder of the cooperation that binds the military institutions across our continent.

“Today, we reaffirm the promise of what we can achieve when we stand together—not just as neighbors, but as guardians of a continent that depends on your valor, sacrifices, and unyielding dedication.”

Reflecting on the legacy of the game, Tinubu commended the Chief of Defence Staff, General C.G. Musa, and the President of the Organisation of Military Sports in Africa (OSMA), Major General M. Abdullahi, for their leadership in reviving the event.

Earlier the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS), Gen. Christopher Musa, on Monday, while briefing correspondents on the 2nd African Military Games hosting in Nigeria between Nov. 18 to Nov. 30, 2024, at the Moshood Abiola Stadium, Abuja, has assured Nigerians and interested countries express to take part in the event an adequate security, fairness, hospitality, and amusement.

The games is expected to be a convergence of military personnel from across the continent of Africa to compete in different sporting events for military kinetic development, skills showcasing, strengthen cooperation, partnership and lasting relationships among African Armed Forces. 

Also in his remarks, the Chief of Defence of Staff, Gen. Musa said, the competition apart from physical and skills development, it will project Nigeria level of safety as against those negatives projected on social medias, it will showcase Nigeria culture, as they have already partnering with cultural organizers in Nigeria for display. More also, it will bring economic and sports development, global recognition, and pride to FCT and Nation at large.

The opening ceremony featured a calisthenics display, performances by different artists, hoisting of the OSMA and AMGA flags, an oath-taking ceremony by the athletes and officials, as well as the symbolic lighting of the game torch by the Vice President.

title: Dapo Sotuminu Demise Is A Colossal Loss To Nigeria Sport Federation - NSC DG, Hon. Bukola Olopade
content:
The Director General of the National Sports Commission (NSC), Hon. Bukola Olopade, has expressed deep sorrow over the passing of veteran journalist and communications expert, Dapo Sotuminu.  

Hon. Olopade while reflecting on the magnitude of the loss said, "why now, Dapo! We had great things to do together. You’re a rare gem. Words fail to capture the devastation of this loss. You are more than a journalist, both us share a long-standing working relationship worked. You are not just a journalist; you are a brother and friend to me, a workaholic whose contributions to this industry will never be forgotten. Your dedication and unparalleled work ethic have left an indelible mark on the sports sector."

The Nigeria Football Federation through it General Secretary, Dr. Mohammed Sanusi also commiserated with the family of veteran journalist who died in Lagos on Wednesday morning at the hospital to which he was rushed after he suddenly fell ill at home.

NFF , said: “This is really shocking. I have known Dapo for more than two decades and have always been impressed with his zest for thoroughness and of course, his passion for women’s football from the beginning of the game in Nigeria.

“Words are not enough to describe his stature as a professional and someone who showed immense respect and regard to fellow professionals and other human beings. We pray that the Almighty will grant him eternal rest, and also grant his family, friends and the sports-writing fraternity the fortitude to bear the big loss.”

Sotuminu, a sapient and prolific professional for the several decades he was in the trade, worked at, among other media houses, TNT Newspapers (Deputy Sports Editor), New Telegraph Newspapers (Deputy Sports Editor) and Compass Newspapers (Sports Editor). He also served as the Director of Communications of Nigeria Women Football League and Media Director of Access Bank Lagos City Marathon.

Sotuminu, a respected media professional, was known for his impactful work in advancing sports marketing and journalism.

The late journalist’s legacy in sports media remains a testament to his dedication and passion, and his contributions will continue to inspire professionals in the industry.

title: CSO, Experts Opposed N1.767trn New external Loan Request In Addition To N20.1trn Borrowed By Tinubu
content:
Following President Tinubu’s new external loan request of N1.767 trillion ($2.209 billion) in the 2024 Budget (Appropriation Act) as contained in a letter entitled “Request for a Resolution of the National Assembly for the Implementation of the New External Borrowing of N1.767 trillion (About $2.209 billion) in the 2024 Appropriation Act” and addressed separately to the Senate President, Godswill Akpabio and the Speaker of the House, Rt Hon Abbas Tajudeen, Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) and other experts has faulted the plan, labels it insensitive.

Part of the letter read, “The Right Honourable Speaker may wish to recall that the 2024 Appropriation Act approved the sum of N7,828,529,477,860.00 as new borrowings to part-finance the 2024 budget deficit of N9.179 trillion. The total new borrowings of N7.828 trillion was further subdivided into new domestic borrowing of N6.061 trillion and new external borrowing of N1.767 trillion which were designed to stabilize the economy and put it on the path of sustainable growth and development.

The CSOs explain their stand in opposing the borrowing, speaking through their leader, Auwal Musa Rafsanjani, the CSOs said “the President’s request to the National Assembly for a fresh external borrowing of N1.767 trillion to finance the 2024 budget deficit of N9.7 trillion raises significant concerns and not good at this time given to Nigeria’s escalating debt profile.

“Since assuming office, President Tinubu’s administration has borrowed N20.1 trillion, further straining the nation’s fiscal sustainability.

“The Central Bank of Nigeria’s report highlights an alarming rise in debt servicing costs, with $3.58 billion spent in just the first nine months of 2024, a 39.77 per cent increase compared to 2023.

“This trend underscores the growing burden of Nigeria’s foreign debt obligations, exacerbated by rising exchange rates and fluctuating oil revenues. Considering these factors and the limited timeframe left in the current budget cycle, approving such a loan may deepen fiscal vulnerabilities without guaranteeing immediate economic relief.

“Efforts should instead focus on addressing structural issues, diversifying revenue streams, and implementing fiscal reforms to reduce reliance on borrowing.

“Invest in infrastructure and key sectors such as agriculture, manufacturing, and technology to reduce over-reliance on oil revenues. There should also be exchange rate stability. The government should develop policies that support naira appreciation, including boosting exports and attracting foreign direct investment (FDI). Engage with creditors to negotiate more favourable terms, such as extending loan tenures and reducing interest rates. Expenditure Efficiency: Prioritise critical sectors while reducing non-essential spending to reduce the budget deficit.

“Continuous borrowing without corresponding structural reforms undermines fiscal stability and risks pushing Nigeria into a debt trap. Government should establish an independent oversight mechanism to ensure debt procurement and usage accountability. More also, a strategic shift towards self-reliance and fiscal discipline is critical to safeguard the economy and future generations.”

Also speaking, the head of Financial Institutions Ratings at Agusto & Co, Ayokunle Olubunmi, while pointing out that the borrowings, as stated, are part of the plan for implementing the 2025 budget, said the borrowing plan is expected to increase the debt service cost and raise the debt burden on the country. But the maturity of one of the Eurobonds in November 2025 is expected to give some respite, if not refinanced by another borrowing.

title: Four Nigerian Students Jailed In Uk For Street Fight
content:
Destiny Ojo, Habib Lawal, Ridwanulahi Raheem, and Joshua Davies-Ero of Nigerian students in the United Kingdom got sentenced to prison for their involvement in a street fight on November 4, 2021 at New Park Street, Leicester

An investigation by the Leicester City Police authorities identified the culprits through CCTV footage, phone tracking, and public assistance.

The six-week trial concluded in October, and the sentences were handed down on November 14.

According to the report published on the Leicester police website onThursday, Destiny Ojo was sentenced to seven years for violent disorder, attempted grievous bodily harm, and GBH with intent. Lawal received five years for similar charges. Raheem got three years for violent disorder and possession of a bladed article. While Davies-Ero was sentenced to two years for violent disorder. The fifth defendant, 22-years-old Justin Asamoah, pleaded guilty to possession of a bladed article and will be sentenced on November 22.

“This incident underscores the grave dangers of violent disorder. It is fortunate that the injuries sustained were not more severe or fatal. This could have been a very different investigation.

“We thank everyone who supported the investigation. As a force, our priority is public safety. Violent behaviour will not be tolerated in our communities, and we will continue to take decisive action against offenders,” Detective Constable Sean Downey stated while commenting on the case.

title: Libya Participation In The African Military Games Hosting In Nigeria, Not A Problems-(CDS) Gen. Musa
content:
The Chief of Defence Staff (CDS), Gen. Christopher Musa, on Monday, while briefing correspondents on the 2nd African Military Games hosting in Nigeria between Nov. 18 to Nov. 30, 2024, at the Moshood Abiola Stadium, Abuja, has assured Nigerians and interested countries express to take part in the event an adequate security, fairness, hospitality, and amusement.

The 2nd African Military Games after series of postponement, finally settled to officially kicks off on Wednesday, 20th November 2024 at Moshood Abiola Stadium, Abuja. The games is expected to be a convergence of military personnel from across the continent of Africa to compete in different sporting events for military kinetic development, skills showcasing, strengthen cooperation, partnership and lasting relationships among African Armed Forces.

According to the CDS, Gen. Musa, 25 countries have expressed interest to participate the Games, while 8 has already arrived as at the time of the briefing.

He then thanks President Bola Tinubu, FCT Minister, Nyesom Wike, Military personnel, Media houses, and every individuals for their support while urging the Nigerian military to make the nation proud at the week-long event by showcasing and displaying their sporting skills and talents.

He failed not to mention the economy benefits of the event, as he said, the competition apart from physical and skills development, it will project Nigeria level of safety as against those negatives projected on social medias, it will showcase Nigeria culture, as they have already partnering with cultural organizers in Nigeria for display. More also, it will bring economic and sports development, global recognition, and pride to FCT and Nation at large.

“The hosting of the African military games in Abuja is a testament to Nigeria’s commitment to promoting peace and security in the region and an opportunity to demonstrate our capabilities as a host nation, while assure you of our commitment and readiness to conduct the best historical event with your support.

“The games will provide a platform for our armed forces to compete at an international level, exchange best practices with their counterparts from other African countries, and build lasting relationships that will contribute to the overall security and stability of the continent. Apart from these, the event will project Nigeria level of safety as against those negatives projected on social medias, it will showcase Nigeria culture, as we have already in partnership with cultural organizers in Nigeria for display. As you can see, business includes small ones around the venue will witness high sales the evidence which already obvious. So it is also about economic and sports development, global recognition, and pride to FCT and Nation at large.

“We urge all Nigerians and friends to come out en masse and show their support for the armed forces as they prepare to compete in the African Military Games. And to demonstrate the hospitality mentality we known for as a Nigeria and Nigerians as we  ensure a hitch-free event.

“Federations are also working with us. All the officials are drawn for the 19 federations in Nigeria. Also, some world bodies sent their judges and referees to participate in this competition.

“There will be dope tests to ensure this game is done fairly. Vehicles will be made available to organise people to the national stadium.

“Let me use this opportunity to once again deeply appreciate our President and the Commander-in-Chief of the Nigerian Armed Forces, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for his persistent backing and encouragement to Armed Forces in attaining this enviable feat. My special thanks also goes to our host, the Honourable Minister of the FCT, Nyesom Ezenwo Wike for his unflinching support to host this auspicious event in the FCT even at a very short period, as well Media houses, and every other individuals for their support.

“Let us therefore come together to ensure a hitch-free event,”  General Musa said.

While responding to the question regarding participating countries includes Libya if show interest after treatment melted out on Super Eagles players, he said, “ we are not politician, we are military, united across Africa and this games is to foster unity, corporation, partnership, development and sport skills.”

title: 25 Countries To Compete As Nigeria Host 2nd African Military Games
content:
At least 25 countries will be participating in the 2nd African Military Games being hosted by Nigeria from Monday, 18th to Saturday, 30th November, 2024 at the Moshood Abiola National Stadium, Abuja.

Briefing the press on Monday in Abuja, Nigeria’s Chief of Defence Staff (CDS), General Christopher Musa, said the Games is expected to be a convergence for military personnel from across the continent to compete in different sporting events as well as well as strengthening military cooperation and partnership and build lasting relationships among African Armed Forces.

The CDS, while thanking President Bola Tinubu and the FCT Minister, Nyesom Wike for their support, urged the Nigerian military to make the nation proud at the week-long event by showcasing and displaying their sporting skills and talents.

“We are here to review and celebrate the exciting opportunity for Nigeria to host African Military Games in Abuja this November. As the Chief of Defence Staff, I’m pleased to announce that Nigeria will host the African Military Games, a prestigious event that brings together military personnel from across the Africa continent to compete in various sporting discipline. This event will hold from 18th to 30th November 2024 present a unique opportunity for Armed Forces to showcase their skills, foster camaraderie among participants and strengthening military cooperation and partnership.

“The hosting of the African Military Games in Abuja is not only a testament to Nigeria’s commitment to promoting peace and security in the region but also an opportunity to demonstrate our capability as the host nation. The Games will provide a platform for our Armed Forces to compete at international level, exchange best practices with their counterparts from other African countries and build lasting relationships that will contribute to the overall security and stability of the continent.

“I’m also pleased to announce the finalisation of preparations for the Games including ensuring that necessary infrastructure and logistics support are put in place to host this prestigious event. I’m confident that our Armed Forces will rise up to the occasion and make the nation proud with their performances on and off the field. It’s envisage that this noble opportunity to host the continent will bring significant benefits to the Federal Capital Territory and the nation at large including economic and sports development, global recognition and national pride.

“Let us therefore come together to ensure a hitch-free event. Let me use this opportunity to once again deeply appreciate our President and the Commander-in-Chief of the Nigerian Armed Forces, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for his persistent backing and encouragement to Armed Forces in attaining this enviable feat. My special thanks also goes to our host, the Honourable Minister of the FCT, Nyesom Ezenwo Wike for his unflinching support to host this auspicious event in the FCT even at a very short period,” General Musa said.

Sporting Tribune reports that eight countries have arrived for the Games with others being expected on Tuesday. The countries on ground are host Nigeria (474 athletes), Algeria (160 athletes), Tunisia (40 athletes), Uganda (26 athletes) and Tanzania (16 athletes). Others are Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso. Athletes will compete in 19 sporting events.

The first African Military Games were held in Nairobi, Kenya between April 7 and 17, 2002.

title: Stop Using Social Media For Reporting - Inspector General Of Police Warn Nigerians
content:
Kayode Egbetokun, Inspector General of Police, while speaking at the PPROs/Police Communication Experts’ Conference in Asaba, Delta State, on Monday, has advice Nigerians against the use of social media as a means to report police officers conducts instead of direct complaints to the Police Complaints Response Unit responsible for complaints handling.

According to him, Police Complaints Response Unit provide a more structured and accountable process for addressing any complaints, instead of the over dependant use of social medium by Nigerians as a means of reporting misconducts of officers which often leads to misinformation and undermines the integrity of the police force.

“We appeal to the public not to resort to social media when reporting the conduct of police officers but rather use the Police Complaints Response Unit which provide a more structured and accountable process for addressing complaints.

“Though the role social media plays in shaping public opinion can not be overemphasis but unverified information often create false perceptions.

“I’m glad to address the PPROs/Police Communication Experts’ Conference. I thank the governor for hosting this conference. This conference is part of police reform, aimed at building trust and respect, which will, in turn, help us gain public trust,” IGP Egbetokun said.

On his part, the hosting Governor, Gov Sheriff Oborevwori of Delta State, in his remarks said, “I want to thank the IGP for his good work. As an officer who served in Lagos as CP, he is capable of policing Nigeria. Delta and Lagos States are very tough states to police; therefore, any officer who served in Delta or Lagos as CP will police Nigeria well.

title: Ondo Poll: I Won’t Forgive Peter Obi And NLC For The Role They Played For My Defeat - LP Candidate
content:
Following the just concluded Ondo state governorship election which saw Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa of the ruling All Progressives Congress as the winner by the Independent National Electoral Commission declaration after sweeping the 18 local government areas in Ondo state with a total polled of 366,781 votes to defeat Agboola Ajayi of the PDP, who got 117,845 votes. Olorunfemi the LP candidate in the election during an interview with PUNCH vowed not to forgive the former LP presidential candidate and the NLC for the role they played in scuttling his Ondo governorship campaign.

Recalls, after weeks of legal battle between Olorunfemi and Peter Obi anointed candidate Ebiseni, the former later got relief after Court of Appeal in Abuja vacated an earlier judgment made by the Federal High Court which order the electoral umpire to recognise Olusola Ebiseni, Obi’s anointed candidate.

He said, “I have Peter Obi and the NLC to thank for that. They have scuttled my aspirations and chances to win this Ondo election. These people spoilt things for us with that PDP reject they wanted to force on the party. Their insistence on having Ebiseni on the ballot ruined everything for me.

“They just capitalised on the crisis between the Labour Party and the Nigeria Labour Congress to create problems. Can you imagine that Ebiseni wrote a letter to the court in my name without my knowledge, saying I have withdrawn from the race? They cannot exclude me from such a position.

“Thank God we got an appeal judgment and my name is back in the INEC portal. The good thing here is that the truth has prevailed. Withdrawal must be voluntary. You cannot force someone to withdraw. What they have done was an attempt to force me behind my back.

“Again, it wasn’t the party that submitted it. It was the handiwork of the former President of the NLC and head of the National Transition Committee, Abduwaheed Omar. What they did is criminal.

“In fact, I am planning to petition the Inspector General of Police to probe how they wrote that letter, put my signature and presented it before the court. We will deal with that later. For now, we are still doing our underground work and doing our best for this election.”

title: Victor Osimhen January clause, Open Doors – Galatasaray
content:
Okan Buruk, Galatasaray technical director, during an interview on their official website on Sunday has stated that the clause in Osimhen’s loan transfer allows him to join any clubs during January transfer window markets

”Osimhen has the intention of staying here until the end of the season. He also wants to stay; he said the same thing at the beginning.

“There is a clause there, but it doesn’t matter; he said he will stay. There is a clause about transfers in January. This clause has different things.

“The important thing is the player. The player who decides. That’s why Osimhen says he will stay here. He said the same thing when he came.”

“We went to Milan. I go there when I have permission. I lived there for three years. I know the place; it’s food and drink… Gardi is my friend.

“We didn’t talk about football. We just sat there and had dinner. We met for two days. I went to Inter Milan; I didn’t go to the facility but to the club. We had dinner. There is someone who was in the infrastructure during my time and is now a senior manager.

“He knows all of our players. All of the players’ names were mentioned. These kinds of meetings are good. Gardi told me there was such and such a thing about Osimhen. It didn’t seem realistic at first.

“Then there was our Adana Demirspor match. We had a video call at the airport after the match. We evaluated it with the transfer committee. We took it to the president. We got the president’s approval. Then the transfer took place.”

Osimhen joined Galatasaray on the last day of the summer transfer window after late transfer negotiations with Chelsea and Al Ahly fell through. He quickly settled into life in Istanbul, having noticed eight goals and four assists in nine appearances across all competitions for the club,” he stated.

title: Support Tinubu Tax Reform Bills At The Expense Of Your Political Ticket - Govs Threatening Reps
content:
Hon. Philip Agbese, Nigeria  House of Representatives deputy spokesman has made some revelation about the threatening House members received from their state governors if they support executive Tax Reform Bills transmitted on September 3, 2024 to the National Assembly for consideration by President Bola Tinubu’s

President Tinubu had set up the Presidential Committee on Tax and Fiscal Policy Reform in August 2023, headed by Taiwo Oyedele for the review of existing tax laws with an objective of reposition the economy for better productivity and efficiency and make the operating environment for investment and businesses more conducive.

The Committee worked for over a year and received inputs from various segments of society across the geopolitical zones, including trade associations, professional bodies, different Ministries and Government Agencies, Governors, traders, students, business owners, and the organised private sector.

Upon transmitted the four tax reform bills to the National Assembly for consideration as concluded by the committee on September 3, there have been controversies ever since then.

At the heart of the debate is the proposed shift to a derivation-based model for Value Added Tax distribution, which would allocate tax revenue to the states where goods and services are consumed, rather than where companies have their headquarters.

The bills were rejected by the 19 northern governors and traditional rulers. The governors, under the aegis of the Northern Governors’ Forum, rejected the new derivation-based model for VAT distribution, insisting that the contents of the bills did not align with the interests of the North and other subnational entities.

National Economic Council (NEC) as well submitted a recommendation to President Bola Tinubu for withdrawn of the Tax Reform Bills sent to the National Assembly for further consultation. The advise which the president rejected while appreciating them for their work.

The bills transmitted to the National Assembly for consideration are;

The Nigeria Tax Administration Bill (NTAB): This Bill proposes new rules governing the administration of all taxes in the country. Its objective is to harmonise tax administrative processes across federal, state and local jurisdictions to ease taxpayers’ compliance and enhance the revenue for all tiers of government.

The Nigeria Revenue Service (Establishment) Bill: The Bill seeks to re-establish the Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS) as the Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS) to better reflect its mandate as the revenue agency for the entire federation, not just the Federal Government.

The Joint Revenue Board Establishment Bill: This Bill proposes creating a Joint Revenue Board to replace the Joint Tax Board, covering federal and all state tax authorities.

The fourth bill seeking establish of the Office of Tax Ombudsman under the Joint Revenue Board to protect taxpayers’ interests and facilitating dispute resolution.

In an exclusive interview with The PUNCH in Abuja, Agbese said some governors are holding meetings ahead of National Assembly resumption to consider the tax bills and other important legislations.

He said, “Some of these governors are threatening members from their states. They have even gone far to threaten that they would deny members return tickets in 2027 if they support the bills.

“As far as we are concerned in the House of Representatives, nobody can stop us from supporting President Bola Tinubu’s bid to reboot the economy to work for the country.

“We are united across party lines to make sure the country works. This is the disposition of Speaker, Tajudeen Abass.

“The difference between the new crop of politicians in the House of Representatives is that we are intellectually sound, progressive-minded and pro-Nigeria.

“We were not elected by the governors but our constituents and as far as the legislation (bills) will work for those that elected us, we will support them unequivocally, wholeheartedly and powerfully to see the light of the day.”

“We are engaging Taiwo Oyedele and other tax experts on Monday.

“We have made copies of the bills available to every lawmaker to study, dissect and make inputs when we bring them up for debate,” he stated, adding that the proposed legislation was likely to scale through but with some amendments where necessary.

“I see the 10th House Congressmen passing the bills with minor adjustments to polish them with a touch of patriotism and intellectualism. That’s the trademark when you have a teacher leading a parliament anywhere in the world,” he added.

title: Tech Bootcamp Open In Lagos To Empower Women
content:
Glovo in its commitment to advance gender diversity and creating pathways for women to thrive in tech-driven roles has partner with Lagos State and She Code Africa to unveiled ‘Women in Tech Bootcamp Programme’ with aimed of fostering tech inclusion, providing skills training, and empowering women to build successful careers in technology.

At the event held in Lagos, the general manager of Glovo Nigeria, Lamide Akinola stated the company bootcamp objective, she said “at Glovo, we believe in a future where women are integral drivers of innovation, especially in tech. We recognize that the challenges women face in tech go beyond technical skills; they include barriers rooted in access, opportunity, and sometimes, the confidence to take bold steps.

“Today’s event is our way of saying; we see those barriers, and we are here to help break them down with you. As the leading multicategory app with a vision to build the largest online marketplace to give everyone access to anything in their city within minutes; we believe that empowering women with digital skills is essential, not only for driving innovation and growth but for building communities where everyone can thrive.”

On her part, Ada Oyom, Founder of She Code Africa, stated the importance of the program, “as the technical partners of the Women in Tech Bootcamp Program, we are thrilled to collaborate with Glovo and the Lagos State government to run this 12-week intensive program and create impactful pathways for women in tech.

“Glovo’s commitment to gender diversity is commendable, and we call on like-minded companies to invest in initiatives that empower the future of women in technology,” she said.

The second partners, Lagos State through the commissioner, Ministry of Commerce, Cooperatives, Trade, and Investment, Folashade Ambrose-Medebem explain their driven agenda as she stated that, “today’s gathering signifies more than just advocacy; it is a rallying cry to re-imagine the future of innovation by ensuring no one is left behind, particularly women, who represent half of our population.”

“in Lagos State, a hub of innovation and economic activity, we understand that inclusion is a catalyst for sustainable growth. However, achieving this requires intentional strategies and robust partnerships. We are excited to work with Glovo and She Code Africa to deliver a program that opens doors for women to excel, innovate, and lead.

“Studies revealed that bridging the gender gap in technology could add up to $12 trillion to global Gross Domestic Product (GDP) by 2025. This staggering figure underscored that empowering women in tech is not just a moral imperative; it is an economic necessity.”

title: Write Me To Inherit You If Your Son(s) Shows No Interest - Singer Ruger Begs Wizkid

title: Ayra Starr And Her Team Disappoints Me – Jaywon
content:
Singer Jaywon In a recent interview with News Central has expressed how he feels about Ayra Starr’s and her team’s  silence on their strained relationship stemming from a viral photo that sparked mocking from trolls, while called it calculated move by her management to keep the attention on her which is very disheartening to him.

I took the picture to show support and celebration for Ayra Starr’s success, considering her an amazing artist making Nigerians proud but the photo was misinterpreted and trolls began mocking me. The situation is unfortunate and we are not cool. People don’t get it. What would make me, Jaywon want to take a picture with Ayra Starr?

“Of course, she’s an amazing artist who has been making us [Nigerians] proud. So, it’s just love. I only wanted to support and celebrate her for the good work she’s doing.

“People also support and celebrate me, too. So when I see a young artist doing good, I want to be part of that celebration.

“We took a picture and it went viral, expecting you and your management to address the trolls and clear up any misconceptions but choose never to say anything about it. The only thing your management did was to promote the picture back to back. Nobody is dumb.

“We know how the [music] industry works. People are saying she didn’t say anything about the picture. Of course, she didn’t say anything about the picture but she saw it trending everyday. Why would she not say something about it?

“Oh yeah, because that is how they roll. I don’t blame them. They feel like if they say something, they are going to stop the picture from trending. They enjoy it. No problem. Everybody has their time,” Jaywon Said.

title: Edo Politics: Governor Okpebholo freezes All State Accounts, Cancel Ministry Created By Obaseki
content:
Monday Okpebholo, the Governor Edo State, as it was disclosed in statements by the Chief Press Secretary to the Governor, Fred Itua on Thursday, has ordered the freezing of all state bank accounts with immediate effect, until further notice for scrutiny and accountability while compel commercial banks, heads of ministries, departments and agencies to comply with the order without delay.

He said, “All bank accounts in all the commercial banks have been frozen. Commercial banks must comply with the order and ensure that not a dime is taken out of the confers of government until there is further notice.

“Heads of ministries, departments and agencies must comply with this order and ensure that there is a full compliance without any further delays.

“After the necessary investigations and reconciliations, the governor will do the needful and decide on the way forward. For now, this order stands.”

The governor asked the relevant government agencies to reverse the Ministry of Roads and Bridges to the Ministry of Works since it failed to deliver it mandates

“It is funny how you can call a government institution the Ministry of Roads and Bridges. Ironically, no single bridge was built by the same administration. Not even a pedestrian bridge.

“In the coming days, we will look at more actions taken by the previous administration and more decisions will be taken that will be done in the best interest of the state,” Governor Okpebholo stated.

title: President Tinubu Appoints Bukola Olopade As National Sports Commission Director General
content:
While many sports journalists hailed Shehu Dikko’s appointment as chairman of the National Sports Commission as the ultimate choice, few anticipated that an even greater gem was yet to come. President Tinubu’s appointment of Hon. Bukola Olawale Olopade isn’t just a top-tier selection; it’s the crowning jewel—a decision that has brought to the commission a man renowned for his ability to work wonders against all odds.

Olopade first entered the Nigerian sporting sphere as Commissioner for Sport in Ogun State under Governor Gbenga Daniel, during which Ogun State hosted the National Sports Festival. But his journey didn’t end there; venturing into the private sector, he transformed the sporting industry into a vibrant hub, breathing new life into events and demonstrating resilience in an arena where even angels fear to tread. With over two decades as a seasoned sports journalist and an expert in sports administration and entrepreneurship, Olopade has consistently raised the bar. His nearly decade-long success in organizing the Access Bank Marathon with steady private sector support is a testament to his skill and tenacity—an achievement many thought impossible.

Olopade’s proven track record of elevating the Nigerian sports landscape, his expansive global network, and his experience in managing multimillion-dollar budgets and assets will prove invaluable in his new role. He is equipped to transform the National Sports Commission into a shining beacon of excellence.

President Tinubu has indeed made a monumental choice for Nigerian sports. The future shines brighter, and we look forward to an era of remarkable progress for the industry.

title: Victor Osimhen Equals Legendary Olusegun Odegbami Record
content:
Nigeria secured a ticket to participate in the Africa Cup of Nations finals (the continent’s flagship football championship) for the 21st time after a 1-1 draw with Benin Republic in Abidjan on Thursday that still put the Cheetahs’ prospects for qualification on the wire.

The game played under driving rain inside the Stade Felix Houphouet-Boigny produced a number of interesting moments, but the biggest was when Victor Osimhen celebrated wildly as his 81st minute header that sailed past goalkeeper Marcel Dandjinou not only secured Nigeria’s first place in the group, but also put him at par with the legendary Olusegun Odegbami in goals’ tally for Nigeria. Both are now joint second to the top man, Rashidi Yekini (of blessed memory) who scored 37 goals in 58 matches.

Osimhen’s goal, in which he profited from a pinpoint cross from Moses Simon, and restored parity on the night after Mohamed Tijani’s goal for the Cheetahs in the 16th minute, was his 23rd for the senior team. Odegbami, the former captain of the team who took the 1980 Africa Cup of Nations finals by the scruff, scored his 23 goals in 46 matches.

The downpour ushered the two teams into a game of two halves, with the Cheetahs keeping possession and running rings round the Super Eagles for large swathes of the first period. However, Tijani’s header from a cross by the vibrant Junior Olaitan that found the net by going through the legs of goalkeeper Stanley Nwabali, was against the run of play.

Minutes earlier, Alex Iwobi had miscued when Osimhen headed down the ball for him from Bruno Onyemaechi’s cross, and Osimhen himself was foiled by Dandjinou just before the Cheetahs struck at the other end.

Nwabali was alert to punch away as Olaitan broke loose three minutes later, and it was ding-dong until four minutes before the break, when Osimhen should have scored from a brilliant Onyemaechi cross, only to watch the ball roll away from goal after his header.

In the 55th minute, Ademola Lookman and Osimhen caused anxious moments at the Benin Republic rear, but Olaitan also got close after Captain William Ekong and Olaoluwa Aina fumbled with the ball down the line. Onyemaechi, coming forward a lot, saw his shot roll agonizingly away from goal just after the hour, and Osimhen headed wide away in the 74th minute as the Cheetahs began to nurse hopes of a win.

Osimhen had other ideas. His goal sent the Super Eagles to Morocco 2025 as group winners, and ensured the Eagles remain unbeaten in the AFCON qualification campaign going into their last game of the series, against Rwanda in Uyo on Monday.

Rwanda, with five points from their five games after an unexpected 1-0 loss to Libya in Kigali also on Thursday, must beat the Super Eagles in Uyo and hope that Libya overwhelm Benin Republic in Tripoli on Monday, to spring to second place and collect the second ticket to the finals from Group D.

“It was a tough game and I congratulate the players for a spirited display in the second half that earned us the equalizer. The downpour made the game difficult for both teams, but I am happy we have the AFCON finals ticket in the bag ahead of the final game of the series against Rwanda in Uyo on Monday,” Coach Augustine Eguavoen said.

title: HOUSE COMMITTEE ON SPORTS CONGRATULATES THE SUPER EAGLES AFTER SECURING 2025 AFCON QUALIFICATION
content:
Chairman House Committee on Sports Honourable Kabiru Amadu has Congratulated the Nigeria senior national team, the Super Eagles for securing qualifications for the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco.

The Super Eagles qualification was confirmed on Thursday after Libya defeated Rwanda 1-0 in Kigali to guarantee Nigeria one of the top two spots in their Group.

According to Honourable Amadu, who represents Gusau/Tsafe Federal Constituency in the House of Representatives from Zamfara state said " the early qualification of the team is a testament to the quality of the team and how determined the players have been since the start of the Qualifiers.

"This is really very good for Nigeria and I want to thank the players and the coaches for a job well done and for showing that reaching the AFCON final earlier this year was not a fluke.

"We must also give kudos to the NFF for how they have managed the team without any chaos or crises throughout the qualifiers and it's a testament to the good work the board is doing.

"I think it's now time for us to shift attention to the World cup Qualifiers and I am optimistic that the boys can turn things around by winning all their remaining matches, especially with the quality we have in the team."

Meanwhile the Super Eagles ensured it secured top spot in her Group, having already qualified for the AFCON, with a one all draw against Benin Republic in Abidjan, on Thursday night.

title: BREAKING: NNPCL Shakeup Cabinet for efficiency and corporate governance
content:
The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) in statement on Wednesday night has announced changes in its top management team for operational efficiency and corporate governance enhancement to reflecting NNPC’s commitment to long-term success in Nigeria’s energy sector.
